These results show that paraphrase robustness is a core requirement for reliable VLM-based reward modeling in robotics.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型正越来越多地被用作机器人学习的奖励函数，该角色要求模型具备复述不变性：即相同的机器人轨迹在语义等价的目标描述下应当获得相同的奖励。本文研究发现当前的视觉语言奖励模型普遍不满足该特性：仅对指令进行复述改写就可以大幅改变模型预测的进度得分，甚至可以让完全相同的机器人行为的评价结果在失败和成功之间翻转。为了量化该失效模式，本文提出ROBORMBENCH基准数据集，包含2390条真实机器人轨迹、真实进度标注，以及覆盖词汇改写、句法改写、动作-目标改写三类场景的21673条经过验证的复述样本。在多款商用和开源视觉语言模型上的测试结果表明，复述引发的不稳定性普遍且严重，改写差异越大不稳定性越强，模型规模扩张或引入显式推理机制都无法可靠降低该类不稳定性；而基于轨迹真值监督训练的专用奖励模型的稳定性则显著更高。上述结果表明，复述鲁棒性是机器人领域基于视觉语言模型的奖励建模实现可靠运行的核心要求。

title: Development of a Humanoid Robot Prototype for Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction
title_zh: 面向多模态人机交互的仿人机器人原型开发
authors: Thang Tran Viet, Thanh Nguyen Canh, Huy Uong Gia, Phuc Dinh Van, Son Tran Duc 等 (7 人)
abstract: Human-robot interaction (HRI) enables intuitive and intelligent collaboration between humans and robots in real-world environments. This paper introduces a humanoid robot prototype designed as a flexible testbed for developing and integrating artificial intelligence (AI) modules in HRI tasks. The system features a 12 degree-of-freedom (DOFs) dual-arm mechanism and a 2 DOFs head with an expressive LCD screen to express facial emotions. All hardware components are controlled by a custom-designed controller board with real-time AI processing supported by an onboard Jetson module. The system incorporates three AI modules: (1) gesture recognition using MediaPipe Pose and an LSTM classifier, (2) object detection with YOLO and 3D localization, and (3) voice-command processing through speech recognition and large language model(LLM)-based semantic parsing. The platform is validated through experiments on positioning accuracy, with results showing average manipulation errors of approximately 1.83 cm. To demonstrate its versatility, experimental results show over 90% task accuracy, with gesture recognition reaching 96%, speech recognition reaching 92%. The results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed system as a reproducible and accessible humanoid platform for research and prototyping in HRI.
summary_zh: 人机交互（HRI）可实现真实环境中人与机器人的直观智能协作。本文介绍了一款专为HRI任务中的人工智能模块开发与集成设计的柔性测试床型仿人机器人原型系统。该系统搭载12自由度双机械臂结构、2自由度头部结构，头部配备可展示面部情绪的高表现力LCD屏幕；所有硬件组件由定制设计的控制板管控，板载Jetson模块支持实时AI运算。系统集成三大AI模块：1）基于MediaPipe Pose（媒体管道姿态估计模型）和LSTM（长短期记忆网络）分类器的手势识别模块；2）基于YOLO（单阶段目标检测模型）的目标检测与3D定位模块；3）融合语音识别与LLM（大语言模型）语义解析的语音指令处理模块。通过定位精度实验对平台进行验证，结果显示其平均操作误差约为1.83cm；多场景实验结果显示系统整体任务准确率超过90%，其中手势识别准确率达96%，语音识别准确率达92%。研究结果证实该系统可作为可复现、易获取的仿人机器人平台，支撑人机交互领域的相关研究与原型开发工作。

title: Adaptation Needs in Robotic Systems: Assessing Behavior Trees and Their Enhancement
title_zh: 机器人系统的适配需求评估：行为树（Behavior Trees, BTs）及其增强方案研究
authors: Mehran Rostamnia, Gianluca Filippone, Ricardo Caldas, Patrizio Pelliccione
abstract: Robotic systems increasingly operate in dynamic, uncertain, and open-ended environments, where design-time assumptions may no longer hold, and adaptation becomes necessary to maintain effective and safe operation. Behavior Trees (BTs) are widely used in robotic control architectures due to their modularity, readability, and reactivity. This raises a central question: are BTs sufficient to meet the adaptation needs of modern robotic systems?This paper investigates this question through a literature-driven study complemented by empirical validation. First, we derive a classification of robotic adaptation needs from the literature, organizing them into six categories: Knowledge, Perception, Actuation, System, Mission, and Environment. Then, we analyze the capabilities and limitations of classical BTs with respect to these needs. Then, we characterize BT-based approaches for adaptation from the existing literature and organize them into four primary families, i.e., generation, extension, evolution, and refinement, including approaches that combine multiple families.Our analysis shows that the modularity, flexibility, and reactivity of classical BTs are insufficient for adaptation needs involving runtime restructuring, reasoning under uncertainty, mission reinterpretation, learning, or integration with external knowledge and planning mechanisms. Enhanced BT approaches address several of these limitations, but to different extents and often with limitations of their own. Our findings relate adaptation needs to both the capabilities and limitations of classical and enhanced BTs, providing guidance on when classical BTs are sufficient, when enhanced mechanisms are needed, and which challenges remain or emerge for adaptive robotic control architectures.
summary_zh: 当前机器人系统越来越多地在动态、不确定、开放的环境中运行，设计阶段预设的假设往往不再成立，系统必须具备适配能力才能维持高效安全的运行。行为树（BTs）凭借其模块化、可读性强、响应速度快的特性，被广泛应用于各类机器人控制架构中。由此引出一个核心问题：经典行为树是否足以满足现代机器人系统的各类适配需求？本文通过文献调研结合实证验证的方式对该问题展开研究：首先从现有文献中梳理出机器人适配需求的分类体系，将其划分为知识类、感知类、驱动类、系统类、任务类、环境类六大类别；随后针对上述适配需求逐一分析经典行为树的能力边界与局限性；之后对现有文献中基于行为树实现适配的相关方法进行梳理，将其划分为四大主流类别：生成类、扩展类、演化类、优化类，其中也包含融合多类思路的复合方法。分析结果表明，经典行为树的模块化、灵活性和响应性不足以支撑涉及运行时重构、不确定性下推理、任务重解释、学习能力、外部知识与规划机制集成的适配需求；各类增强型行为树方法可在不同程度上解决上述部分局限性，但各类方案本身也存在固有缺陷。本文研究明确了适配需求与经典行为树、增强型行为树的能力、局限性之间的对应关系，可为判断经典行为树的适用场景、判断何时需要引入增强机制、明确自适应机器人控制架构仍待解决的核心挑战提供指导。

title: FIRE-LIVWO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry via Failure-Immune mmWave Radar Enhancement
title_zh: FIRE-LIVWO：基于抗故障毫米波雷达增强的鲁棒激光-惯性-视觉-轮式里程计
authors: Kun Hu, Menggang Li, Kaidi Wu, Zhiwen Jin, Yingjie Zhao 等 (8 人)
abstract: Achieving robust SLAM in large-scale underground coal mines with complex structures and severe degeneracies remains highly challenging. Dense smoke and dust cause substantial loss of visual information and degrade LiDAR point-cloud features, while long, self-similar corridors induce geometric degeneration, leading to pronounced odometry drift. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-LIVWO: Failure-Immune mmWave Radar-Enhanced LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry, a tightly coupled multi-modal odometry framework based on an iterated error-state Kalman filter (IESKF). The framework fuses 4D mmWave radar, LiDAR, and visual features within a unified VoxelMap and jointly constructs LiDAR-radar point-to-plane residuals and sparse visual photometric residuals. In smoke-filled environments, we exploit the strong penetration of 4D mmWave radar and introduce pointwise Doppler velocity constraints to preserve state observability. In geometrically degenerate corridors, we tightly couple wheel odometry using non-holonomic constraints (NHC) and online lever-arm compensation to reduce drift. Our central contribution is a degeneration detection and adaptive fusion model switching strategy grounded in geometric and visual observability analysis, which quantifies observability online and dynamically adjusts modality weights. Real-world experiments in underground coal mines demonstrate that FIRE-LIVWO accurately identifies failure boundaries, enabling reliable modality switching under extreme conditions. Compared with baselines, it achieves superior accuracy and robustness (average localization error of 5.677m). We open source our code on Github to benefit the robotics community.
summary_zh: 在结构复杂、退化严重的大规模地下煤矿场景中实现鲁棒同步定位与建图（SLAM）仍然极具挑战性：浓密的烟尘会大幅损失视觉信息、劣化激光点云特征，而长距离自相似走廊会引发几何退化，最终导致里程计出现显著漂移。为解决上述问题，本文提出FIRE-LIVWO框架：即基于抗故障毫米波雷达增强的激光-惯性-视觉-轮式里程计，是一款基于迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波器（IESKF）的紧耦合多模态里程计框架。该框架在统一的体素地图中融合4D毫米波雷达、激光、视觉特征，联合构建激光-雷达点到平面残差与稀疏视觉光度残差。在充满烟尘的环境中，利用4D毫米波雷达的强穿透特性，引入逐点多普勒速度约束保障系统状态的可观测性；在几何退化的走廊场景中，通过非完整约束（NHC）与在线臂杆补偿紧耦合轮式里程计，降低漂移。本文的核心贡献是提出基于几何与视觉可观测性分析的退化检测与自适应融合模型切换策略，可在线量化可观测性并动态调整各模态的权重。在地下煤矿开展的真实场景实验表明，FIRE-LIVWO可精准识别失效边界，在极端条件下实现可靠的模态切换；与基线方法相比，其定位精度与鲁棒性更优，平均定位误差仅为5.677m。本文已在Github上开源相关代码，供机器人领域研究者使用。

title: Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT) for Robot Navigation in Dense and Uncertain Crowds
title_zh: 面向密集不确定人群场景下机器人导航的人人交互-人机交互Transformer（H2INT）
authors: Ao Shen, Kaixi Chen, Shiwei Liu, Fang Deng, Chen Chen
abstract: Safe robot navigation in dense crowds requires reasoning about pedestrian motion and how it may change in response to a robot. However, many learning-based approaches generate pedestrian motion independently of the robot or assume uniform reciprocity, omitting an important source of interaction uncertainty. This paper presents a Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT), a reinforcement learning framework that retains robot-conditioned changes in pedestrian motion during policy learning while allowing responsiveness to vary across pedestrians. Responsiveness affects the crowd dynamics when the robot is visible but is not supplied as a policy input; the policy must instead infer its consequences from robot-centered relative positions. A two-stage gated Transformer progressively encodes human-human and human-robot relations, while a recurrent policy captures their temporal evolution. A curriculum gradually reduces pedestrian responsiveness to increase interaction difficulty. Simulation experiments demonstrate improved navigation safety and robustness over representative baselines across response conditions and crowd densities, and show transfer without retraining to structurally distinct crowd-flow layouts. Ablations support the hierarchical relational encoding and gated updates. Real-robot deployment further verifies that the learned policy can operate with sparse observations in a physical environment.
summary_zh: 在密集人群中实现安全的机器人导航，需要对行人运动规律、以及行人针对机器人做出的运动变化进行推理。但现有很多基于学习的方法要么独立于机器人生成行人运动轨迹，要么假设所有行人的交互互惠性一致，忽略了交互不确定性的重要来源。本文提出人人交互-人机交互Transformer（H2INT），这是一款强化学习框架，在策略学习过程中保留行人运动随机器人状态变化的特性，同时允许不同行人的响应程度存在差异。行人响应程度会在机器人进入视野后影响人群动态，但该变量不会作为策略的输入，策略需要从以机器人为中心的相对位置信息中推断出其影响。框架采用两阶段门控Transformer逐步编码人人交互关系与人机交互关系，同时通过循环策略捕捉上述关系的时序演化规律；通过课程学习机制逐步降低行人的响应程度，提升交互场景的难度。仿真实验结果表明，与代表性基线方法相比，该框架在不同行人响应条件、不同人群密度下的导航安全性与鲁棒性均有提升，且无需重新训练即可迁移到人群流动布局结构完全不同的场景。消融实验验证了分层关系编码与门控更新机制的有效性，真实机器人部署实验进一步证实，学习得到的策略可在物理环境中仅依靠稀疏观测正常运行。

title: Temporal Tactile Encoding and Compliance for Intent-Aware Robot-to-Human Bimanual Handover
title_zh: 面向意图感知的机器人向人类双手递接任务的时序触觉编码与柔顺控制
authors: Pasquale Marra, Stefano Berti, Gabriele Mario Caddeo, Lorenzo Natale
abstract: Reliable robot-to-human handover requires the robot to infer when the person is ready to receive the object, and release it safely, comfortably, and at the right time. This is challenging because visual observations alone may not disambiguate clear taking intent from accidental contact, weak grasping, wrong-direction forces, or transient interactions. In this work we treat human-robot handover as an intrinsically multimodal problem. Our approach couples a VLA model with a compliance controller that reduces interaction forces during object transfer. We finetune the VLA model with human demonstrations using RGB observation, temporally encoded tactile feedback and proprioception. We evaluate the complete system in a human-subject study against two baselines: one without tactile feedback and one using tactile feedback without compliance control. We hypothesize that combining compliance and temporal tactile encoding yields the most reliable and comfortable handovers, as compliance facilitates physical interaction while tactile history captures sustained taking intent. Performance is measured through objective metrics and an ad-hoc questionnaire. The results show that the two components provide complementary benefits and substantially outperform the baselines. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 可靠的机器人向人类递接物体任务，要求机器人能够推断出人类准备接取物体的时机，在合适的时刻安全、舒适地释放物体。仅依靠视觉观测很难区分人类明确的接取意图与意外接触、弱抓取、反向作用力、瞬时交互等干扰情况，因此该任务极具挑战性。本文将人机递接任务视为典型的多模态问题，将视觉语言动作（VLA）模型与柔顺控制器相结合，在物体传递过程中降低交互作用力。本文使用包含RGB观测、时序编码触觉反馈与本体感知的人类演示数据对VLA模型进行微调。通过真人受试者实验将完整系统与两个基线方案进行对比：一个基线方案不使用触觉反馈，另一个基线方案使用触觉反馈但未引入柔顺控制。本文提出假设：将柔顺控制与时序触觉编码相结合可实现最可靠、最舒适的递接效果，原因是柔顺控制可优化物理交互体验，而触觉历史信息可捕捉人类持续的接取意图。研究通过客观指标与定制化问卷对系统性能进行评估，结果表明两个组件可形成互补优势，性能大幅优于基线方案。相关代码与数据集将在论文录用后开源发布。

title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
title_zh: TacPAC：面向富接触操作的世界-动作模型中触觉预测与实时动作校正
authors: Zipei Ma, Xiaofei Wei, Junzhe Jiang, Shunlin Lu, Li Zhang
abstract: World-action models guide action generation with predicted future observations, but vision-centric predictions miss the local contact cues that decide contact-rich manipulation. However, naively predicting future tactile observations as additional views recovers only a third of the achievable gain in our experiments. This gap reflects a timing mismatch: predictions precede execution, while tactile feedback arrives during it. We introduce TacPAC, which turns tactile prediction into real-time action correction. Once the base model has planned an action chunk, TacPAC caches the predicted contact that plan was conditioned on together with the plan's own representation, and a tactile expert reads each newly observed tactile image against that cache to correct the actions not yet executed. Feedback is thus interpreted against what the plan anticipated rather than in isolation, and one correction is a single pass over that cache, $20.7\times$ cheaper than regenerating the chunk. On five real-robot tasks spanning precision insertion, fragile-object handling, object reorientation, and long-horizon manipulation, TacPAC leads every task and raises the average from 22% for its vision-only base model to 64%. Code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型可通过预测未来观测值指导动作生成，但以视觉为核心的预测方式会缺失决定富接触操作效果的局部接触线索。而在实验中发现，直接将未来触觉观测作为额外视图进行预测的朴素方案，仅能实现理论最优收益的三分之一。该差距来源于时序不匹配问题：动作预测发生在执行阶段之前，而触觉反馈在执行过程中才会产生。本文提出TacPAC框架，将触觉预测转化为实时动作校正机制：当基础模型规划出一段动作序列后，TacPAC会缓存该规划所依赖的预测接触信息与规划自身的表征，触觉专家模块将每帧新观测到的触觉图像与缓存内容进行比对，对尚未执行的动作进行校正。该机制对反馈的解读基于规划的预期而非孤立判断，单次校正仅需遍历一次缓存，计算开销仅为重新生成整段动作序列的1/20.7。在覆盖精密插入、易碎物体操作、物体重定向、长时序操作的5项真实机器人任务中，TacPAC在所有任务上的表现均优于基线方案，将仅使用视觉的基础模型的平均任务成功率从22%提升至64%。相关代码可通过文中给出的链接获取。

title: One Word, Different Action: A Real-Robot Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Embodied Reasoning
authors: Yiwei Liu, Luwei Yang, Shunbo Lei
abstract: Natural-language instruction changes can directly alter robot behavior. A reliable embodied system should preserve its action when the task is unchanged and update it correctly when the task itself changes. We introduce One Word, Different Action, a real-robot benchmark built on physical decision states and executable actions, using task-preserving and task-changing instruction pairs to jointly evaluate Decision Invariance and Decision Sensitivity, with further evaluation under multi-constraint reasoning and real-RGB grounding. Experiments show that modern models are near saturation on single-constraint instruction changes, yet several models degrade noticeably when multiple task constraints must be integrated into one executable decision. These results suggest that the more salient remaining challenge is no longer recognizing an isolated instruction change, but reliably composing multiple task requirements into a correct robot action decision.

title: Morphology and actuation as inductive biases in robotic hand manipulation
title_zh: 形态与驱动作为机器人手操作中的归纳偏置研究
authors: Zalán Tari, Eszter Birtalan, Péter Polcz, Miklós Koller
abstract: Robotic hands vary widely in anatomical fidelity and mechanical complexity, and these structural choices influence the coordination of joint motions and the difficulty of controlling the system. A unified framework is presented in which the kinematic and actuation stages are analysed separately and in composition, through the conditioning of the task Jacobian, the actuation matrix, and their product. It is applied to two hands representing opposing design philosophies, the Shadow Dexterous Hand and the Anatomically Correct, Biomechatronic Hand, along four morphological aspects: joint axis geometry, actuator-to-DOF ratio, coupling architecture, and authority distribution. All parameters are derived from the hands' canonical digital representations. Anatomical fidelity carries no uniform advantage: oblique axes improve thumb conditioning but leave the long fingers worse conditioned than the orthogonal-axis design, while the branching tendon network improves the effective control mapping at every long finger and worsens it significantly at the thumb, where actuator authority is concentrated on thumb opposition. Predictions derived from these metrics are evaluated against reinforcement learning experiments using PPO, DDPG+HER, and TQC+HER, across three different tasks.
summary_zh: 不同机器人手的解剖保真度与机械复杂度差异极大，这类结构选择会直接影响关节运动的协调难度与系统控制难度。本文提出统一分析框架，通过任务雅可比矩阵、驱动矩阵及其乘积的条件数，分别对运动学阶段、驱动阶段以及二者的组合特性进行分析。将该框架应用于两款代表对立设计理念的机器人手：Shadow Dexterous Hand（影子灵巧手）与Anatomically Correct, Biomechatronic Hand（解剖学精度生物机电手），从关节轴几何形态、执行器与自由度比值、耦合架构、权限分布四大形态维度展开分析，所有参数均提取自两款机器人手的标准数字表征。研究发现解剖学保真度并不具备统一优势：倾斜关节轴设计可提升拇指的条件数，但长手指的条件数表现反而劣于正交关节轴设计；分支肌腱网络可优化所有长手指的有效控制映射，但会显著劣化拇指的控制映射，该设计下执行器权限集中于拇指对向动作。基于上述指标得到的预测结果，通过使用PPO、DDPG+HER、TQC+HER三类强化学习算法的三项不同任务实验得到了验证。

title: Risk-Aware Optimal Control with Rulebooks
title_zh: 基于规则手册的风险感知最优控制
authors: Tichakorn Wongpiromsarn
abstract: We consider safety-critical control problems involving multiple requirements with different priorities and uncertainty in their evaluation. We represent these requirements using risk-aware rulebooks, where each requirement is assigned a risk measure and an acceptable threshold, and a priority relation is defined among the requirements. Each requirement induces a risk-evaluation function that maps a policy to the risk associated with its violation. We formulate risk-aware optimal control with rulebooks as a lexicographic optimization problem over excess risks and develop an anytime filtering and branch-and-bound algorithm that progressively tightens the certified optimality gap while characterizing the corresponding set of policies at each priority level. The algorithm returns a policy together with these gaps, which bound its suboptimality. We prove that these gaps are valid for any finite computational budget and, under additional assumptions, converge to zero as the computational budget increases. We evaluate the algorithm on a synthetic benchmark with a known optimum and a realistic highway-merging simulation with CVaR-based collision, rear-braking, headway, and comfort rules.
summary_zh: 本文研究面向安全关键控制问题，这类问题包含多个优先级不同、评估过程存在不确定性的约束要求。本文使用风险感知规则手册对这类约束进行表征：为每条约束分配对应的风险测度与可接受阈值，同时定义不同约束之间的优先级关系。每条约束对应一个风险评估函数，可将控制策略映射为该策略违反该约束的风险值。本文将基于规则手册的风险感知最优控制建模为超额风险上的字典序优化问题，开发了任意时刻可用的过滤与分支定界算法，可逐步收紧已验证的最优性间隙，同时刻画每个优先级层级对应的策略集合。该算法可同时返回控制策略与对应的最优性间隙，用于界定策略的次优程度。本文从理论上证明，该间隙在任意有限计算预算下均有效，且在附加假设条件下，随着计算预算提升可收敛至零。分别在已知最优解的合成基准数据集、基于CVaR（条件风险值）定义碰撞规则、后车制动规则、车距规则、舒适性规则的真实高速并线仿真场景中对算法进行了验证。

title: LIBERO-RECOVER: Beyond Task Success Towards Failure Recovery in Robotic Manipulation Models
title_zh: LIBERO-RECOVER：超越任务成功，面向机器人操作模型的故障恢复
authors: Lin Liu, Zhicheng Bao, Lu Zhang, Ziying Song, Wu Yang 等 (8 人)
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) or World Action (WAM) models have recently demonstrated remarkable performance in robotic manipulation. On LIBERO, SOTA method have achieved nearly 100\% success rates, seemingly suggesting that the models are ready for deployment in real world. However, near perfect performance on existing benchmarks can be misleading: success under ideal conditions does not imply real world robustness. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate task completion from predefined initial states, while real world interactions inevitably involve failures such as failed grasps, collisions, and unintended object movements. A robot must therefore not only execute tasks successfully, but also recognize and recover from failures to continue the task. Yet this capability remains largely unmeasured, revealing a critical gap between benchmark performance and real world reliability. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Recover Benchmark, a large scale benchmark for failure recovery in robotic manipulation. Built upon LIBERO, we collect real execution failures from SOTA embodied models and construct 1,000+ scenarios across four recovery levels: (1) Action Retry, (2) Action Adaptation, (3) Object State Recovery, and (4) Environmental Recovery. We evaluate four core capabilities: spatial understanding, object structure reasoning, interaction understanding, and topological reasoning. As the first large-scale benchmark for embodied failure recovery, LIBERO-Recover shifts evaluation from \emph{Can the robot succeed?''} to \emph{Can the robot recover after failure?''}, promoting robust and generalizable embodied agents. The project will be avaible in \textcolor{blue}{this https URL}.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型或世界动作（World Action, WAM）模型近期在机器人操作任务中展现出优异性能。在LIBERO基准测试集上，当前最优（SOTA）方法的任务成功率已接近100%，这似乎表明相关模型已具备现实部署条件。但现有基准上的近乎完美表现存在误导性：理想条件下的任务成功并不等同于现实场景下的鲁棒性。现有基准主要基于预定义初始状态评估任务完成度，而现实交互过程中不可避免会出现抓取失败、碰撞、物体意外移位等故障。因此机器人不仅要能成功执行任务，还需要识别故障并从故障中恢复以继续完成任务。但目前该能力尚未得到充分度量，暴露出基准测试性能与现实场景可靠性之间的关键差距。为解决这一问题，本文提出LIBERO-Recover基准，面向机器人操作故障恢复的大规模基准测试集。该基准基于LIBERO构建，收集了当前最优具身模型的真实执行故障，构建了覆盖4个恢复层级的1000余个场景：(1)动作重试、(2)动作适配、(3)物体状态恢复、(4)环境恢复。本文对空间理解、物体结构推理、交互理解、拓扑推理4项核心能力开展评估。作为首个面向具身智能故障恢复的大规模基准，LIBERO-Recover将评估方向从「机器人能否成功完成任务」转向「机器人能否在故障后完成恢复」，可推动鲁棒性强、泛化性好的具身智能体研发。项目相关资源将在指定链接开放。

title: APEX-RBD: Mixed-Precision Exploration Framework for Hardware-Efficient Robot Dynamics Accelerator Design
title_zh: APEX-RBD：面向硬件高效机器人动力学加速器设计的混合精度探索框架
authors: Xingyu Liu, Hanwei Fan, Chaofang Ma, Jiawei Liang, Guangyu Hu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Rigid Body Dynamics (RBD) forms the computational core of real-time robotic control, but its immense computational complexity creates a performance bottleneck that necessitates dedicated hardware accelerators. However, the substantial hardware resource and power costs of these accelerators make their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms highly challenging. While quantization offers a promising path to optimize RBD hardware for edge computing, existing uniform-precision approaches remain inefficient by ignoring the diverse quantization sensitivities of different variables. Although mixed-precision offers a superior alternative, its exploration is intractable due to a vast search space and the prohibitive cost of closed-loop simulation for motion accuracy evaluation.To address these challenges, we introduce APEX-RBD, an automated framework that makes mixed-precision exploration computationally tractable while effectively identifying hardware-efficient configurations. Specifically, it performs physics-driven search space pruning via variable grouping and sensitivity analysis, and employs a data-efficient, prior-informed surrogate model to enable rapid trajectory error prediction. This formulation guides a hybrid optimizer to identify area- and power-efficient designs under user-defined accuracy and performance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that APEX-RBD discovers designs achieving up to 1.9$\times$ area reduction and 1.8$\times$ power savings compared to uniform-precision baselines across diverse robotic platforms.
summary_zh: 刚体动力学（Rigid Body Dynamics, RBD）是实时机器人控制的计算核心，但其极高的计算复杂度形成了性能瓶颈，必须使用专用硬件加速器才能满足需求。但这类加速器的硬件资源与功耗成本极高，导致其在资源受限边缘平台上的部署面临巨大挑战。量化是优化边缘计算场景下RBD硬件的可行路径，但现有统一精度方法忽略了不同变量的量化敏感度差异，效率较低。混合精度是更优的替代方案，但由于搜索空间极大、运动精度评估的闭环仿真成本过高，混合精度配置的探索难以落地。为应对上述挑战，本文提出APEX-RBD自动化框架，可大幅降低混合精度探索的计算复杂度，同时高效识别硬件高效的配置方案。具体而言，该框架通过变量分组与敏感度分析实现物理驱动的搜索空间剪枝，采用数据高效、先验信息引导的代理模型实现轨迹误差的快速预测。该机制引导混合优化器在用户定义的精度与性能约束下，识别面积与功耗高效的设计方案。实验结果表明，在多种机器人平台上，与统一精度基线方案相比，APEX-RBD得到的设计最高可实现1.9倍的面积缩减与1.8倍的功耗节省。

title: A Schema Bounded Language Model for Refining Robot Policies Without Destabilizing Local Learning
title_zh: 基于模式约束的语言模型：在不干扰局部学习的前提下优化机器人策略
authors: Chongwen Dong, Mithun Paul Saint-Germain, Pinjari Asif, Carlo R. daCunha
abstract: This paper addresses navigation by composite heterogeneous robots in a decentralized system when policy reasoning and local control operate at different update levels. In a NetLogo--Python implementation, three robots share motion dynamics but use different LLM backends. Each robot independently combines a large language model (LLM) policy agent, an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandit, and a Double Deep Q-Network (Double DQN) controller; no central LLM generates team actions. LLM inference is confined to round-level policy generation and refinement rather than tick-level action selection. The robots perform cross-LLM communication through a shared round summary containing policies, outcomes, and learning feedback. UCB performs refinement-mode selection, and the policy-conditioned Double DQN performs tick-level action selection from navigation variables, active policy parameters, and the LLM action prior. Each of the four configurations was evaluated over 30 rounds. In the fixed simulation, the complete configuration reached the goal in all 90 correlated robot--round records and achieved the lowest median completion time (42 ticks) and P90 (73.2 ticks); its median was 25.0--39.1\% lower than those of the other configurations. These observations provide descriptive, configuration-level evidence from the evaluated configurations.
summary_zh: 本文针对去中心化系统中异构复合机器人的导航问题开展研究，该场景下策略推理与局部控制运行在不同的更新层级。在NetLogo-Python实现环境中，3台机器人共享运动动力学，但使用不同的大语言模型（LLM）后端。每台机器人独立集成大语言模型策略智能体、上置信界（Upper Confidence Bound, UCB）赌博机与双深度Q网络（Double Deep Q-Network, Double DQN）控制器，不存在生成团队动作的中心大语言模型。大语言模型推理仅用于回合级的策略生成与优化，不用于时间步级的动作选择。机器人通过共享的回合摘要实现跨大语言模型通信，摘要内容包含策略、执行结果与学习反馈。UCB负责优化模式选择，基于策略条件的Double DQN结合导航变量、激活策略参数与大语言模型动作先验，完成时间步级的动作选择。本文对4种配置方案各开展30轮评估。在固定仿真环境中，完整配置方案在全部90条关联机器人-回合记录中均到达目标，中位完成时间为42个时间步，P90完成时间为73.2个时间步，其完成时间中位数比其他配置方案低25.0%~39.1%。上述观测结果为不同配置方案的性能差异提供了描述性的配置级实证依据。

title: ToPos: Automated Optimal Positioning on Topographic Manifolds using Constrained Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition
title_zh: ToPos：基于约束测地线Voronoi分解的地形流形自动最优定位框架
authors: Rajesh Raveendran, Akseli Vanhamaa, Jaakko Suutala, Antti Tikanmäki, Juha Röning
abstract: Reliable autonomous mapping, environmental sampling, last-mile logistics, and infrastructure deployment depend on the optimal surface area-balanced distribution of Spatial Reference Sites (SRS). Conventional 2D Euclidean methods often fail in high-relief environments by neglecting topographic variations and physical obstructions. This leads to significant planimetric distortion, spatial clustering, and the placement of targets in inaccessible or shadowed regions, compromising both data integrity and operational safety. This paper introduces ToPos, an automated framework for TOPography-aware Optimal Sampling on topographic manifolds. We treat the terrain as a discrete 2-dimensional manifold embedded in 3D Euclidean space and replace standard flat-map distances with non-Euclidean geodesic distances that follow the actual surface geometry. The point distribution is formulated as an optimization problem using a Constrained Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition, solved via a Riemannian Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG) engine. Our approach restricts target locations to a feasible "safe zone," accounting for non-traversable slopes, vegetation, environmental occlusions, etc. Through evaluations on non-convex sinusoidal manifolds, we show that ToPos mitigates planimetric distortion by utilizing geodesic metrics. This approach results in a $\sim$74% improvement in optimal surface area-balanced distribution, as measured by the coefficient of variation (CV) of the Voronoi cell areas. The framework is architected as a Geographic Information System (GIS)-ready micro-service to bolster the mentioned applications.Index Terms: Topographic Manifolds, Geodesic Voronoi Decomposition, Infrastructure Deployment, 3D Mapping, Spatial Sampling, and Non-Euclidean Optimization.
summary_zh: 可靠的自主建图、环境采样、最后一公里物流与基础设施部署都依赖于空间参考站点（Spatial Reference Sites, SRS）的最优表面积均衡分布。传统二维欧几里得方法忽略地形变化与物理障碍物，在高起伏环境中往往失效，会导致严重的平面畸变、空间聚类，甚至将目标点布置在不可达或遮挡区域，损害数据完整性与运行安全性。本文提出ToPos框架，面向地形流形的地形感知最优采样自动化框架。该框架将地形视为嵌入在三维欧几里得空间中的离散二维流形，采用贴合实际表面几何的非欧几里得测地距离替代传统平面地图距离。点分布问题被建模为基于约束测地线Voronoi分解的优化问题，通过黎曼Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）引擎求解。该方法将目标位置限制在可行的「安全区域」内，充分考虑不可通行坡度、植被、环境遮挡等约束。在非凸正弦流形上的评估结果表明，ToPos通过使用测地度量缓解了平面畸变问题，基于Voronoi单元面积变异系数（CV）度量的最优表面积均衡分布性能提升约74%。该框架被设计为可直接对接地理信息系统（GIS）的微服务，可为前述各类应用提供支撑。

title: Reasoning Without Inference Cost: Latent Semantic Scaffolding for Robot VLA Policies
title_zh: 无推理成本推理：面向机器人VLA策略的潜在语义脚手架
authors: Andrew Ting Yan Li, Zhuo Li, Zhelin Yang, Zhipeng Dong, Quentin Rouxel 等 (6 人)
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained by imitation and capture what action to take but not why; adding causal reasoning improves manipulation, but current methods pay for it at inference time - generating reasoning tokens or rolling out predicted future states at every step, a cost that compounds over long horizons. We ask whether this benefit can instead be captured during training and discarded before deployment. We introduce Latent Semantic Scaffolding (LSS), an auxiliary loss applied during human-demonstration pretraining that aligns a VLA's action-token representations to text embeddings of physical-reasoning rationales through a small projection head. The head is dropped at inference, leaving the unmodified base policy with zero added cost. Our central finding concerns alignment granularity: aligning each action token to the rationale of its own manipulation phase (Dense LSS) rather than to a single pooled episode-level embedding (Pooled LSS) yields representations that transfer markedly better to held-out tasks. Dense LSS attains both the best in-distribution success and the best transfer to tasks unseen during alignment, whereas pooled alignment over-specializes to the training task. A representational probe shows Dense LSS induces roughly twice the per-phase separability in the backbone, supporting that phase-local alignment is the operative mechanism.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型通过模仿学习训练，仅能输出应执行的动作，无法解释动作背后的逻辑。引入因果推理可提升操作性能，但现有方法会在推理阶段产生额外开销：每一步都需要生成推理令牌或推演预测的未来状态，该开销会随任务时长累积。本文探索是否可以在训练阶段获取因果推理的收益，在部署前移除相关开销。本文提出潜在语义脚手架（Latent Semantic Scaffolding, LSS），这是一种应用于人类演示预训练阶段的辅助损失函数，通过小型投影头将VLA的动作令牌表示与物理推理论据的文本嵌入对齐。在推理阶段可直接移除该投影头，无需修改基础策略，不会产生任何额外开销。本文的核心发现与对齐粒度相关：将每个动作令牌与对应操作阶段的推理依据对齐（密集型LSS），而非与单个池化的回合级嵌入对齐（池化型LSS），得到的表示对未见过任务的泛化性能会显著提升。密集型LSS同时实现了最优的分布内任务成功率与最优的未对齐阶段未见任务泛化性能，而池化对齐方法会出现对训练任务的过拟合问题。表示探测实验表明，密集型LSS可将骨干网络中各阶段的特征可分性提升约1倍，证明阶段局部对齐是该方法生效的核心机制。

title: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
title_zh: 融合控制与无线世界模型的高可靠远程机器人控制
authors: H.P. Madushanka, Sumudu Samarakoon, Mehdi Bennis
abstract: Remote robotic systems operating over wireless networks must maintain reliable control despite limited communication resources, changing channel conditions, and environmentalthis http URL, continuously transmitting high-dimensional sensory observations, such as camera images, increases communication overhead and energy consumption while reducing robustness under unreliablethis http URLaddress these challenges, this paper proposes a resilient communication-aware remote robotic control framework based on coupled control and wireless Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models that jointly capture robot dynamics and wireless channel evolution from visual observations and a combination of raw and structured radio frequency (RF) representations based on spectrograms and Persistence Images(PIs).The learned latent representations enable predictive communication scheduling by jointly forecasting future robot states and wireless conditions, thereby reducing unnecessary uplink transmissions while maintaining reliable controlthis http URL, an adaptive resilience mechanism detects latent prediction discrepancies and efficiently adapts perception embeddings to accommodate wireless and visual environmental changes without retraining the complete controlthis http URLproposed framework is evaluated in a synchronized Gazebo-Robot Operating System (ROS)-Sionna robot-wireless simulation environment under diverse wireless propagation and perceptionthis http URLresults demonstrate significant improvements in communication efficiency, robustness, and resilience while maintaining navigation performance compared with conventional Proportional Integral Derivative (PID), model-free Deep Q-Network (DQN), and predictive approaches based on Vision Transformers(ViTs).
summary_zh: 运行在无线网络中的远程机器人系统需要在通信资源有限、信道条件动态变化的场景下维持可靠控制。持续传输相机图像等高维传感观测会大幅提升通信开销与能耗，同时降低不可靠网络下的鲁棒性。为应对上述挑战，本文提出一种融合通信感知能力的远程机器人控制框架，该框架基于耦合控制与无线联合嵌入预测架构（Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture, JEPA）世界模型，可从视觉观测与基于频谱图、持久化图像（Persistence Images, PIs）的原始+结构化射频（RF）表示中，同时学习机器人动力学与无线信道演化规律。学习得到的潜在表示可同时预测未来机器人状态与无线条件，支撑预测式通信调度，在维持可靠控制的前提下减少不必要的上行传输。此外，自适应鲁棒机制可检测潜在预测偏差，在不对完整控制策略进行重训练的前提下高效调整感知嵌入，适配无线与视觉环境的变化。本文在同步集成Gazebo、机器人操作系统（ROS）与Sionna的机器人-无线仿真环境中，在多种无线传播与感知场景下对所提框架开展评估。结果表明，与传统比例积分微分（PID）、无模型深度Q网络（DQN）、基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的预测类方法相比，该框架在维持导航性能的同时，通信效率、鲁棒性与抗毁性均得到显著提升。

title: Strict Modes Everywhere - Bringing Order Into Dynamics of Mechanical Systems by a Potential Compatible With the Geodesic Flow
title_zh: 全域严格模式：基于与测地流兼容的势场为机械系统动力学引入秩序
authors: Arne Sachtler, Alin Albu-Schäffer
abstract: Strict nonlinear normal modes provide very regular families of oscillations within conservative mechanical systems. However, a strict normal mode will generally be an isolated curve within the configuration space of the system. In this letter, we design a potential that will densely fill the configuration space with strict normal modes such that each configuration belongs to one mode and each mode passes through a common point, the equilibrium. As the potential can be realized by (nonlinear) elastic elements it can be used to execute a variety of periodic trajectories very efficiently. Most of the required torques will come from the elastic elements in the system and not from the actuators. We also design a controller stabilizing the system to a desired target mode and a controller performing swing-up and compensating dissipated energy. Finally, we showcase the approach for a two DoF manipulator. The experiments show that the approach performed well for the example system.
summary_zh: 严格非线性正模可在保守机械系统中生成高度规律的振荡序列，但严格正模通常是系统配置空间内的孤立曲线。本文设计了一种势场，可在配置空间内密集填充严格正模，使得每个配置点都属于某一个模式，且所有模式都经过作为公共点的平衡点。由于该势场可通过非线性弹性元件实现，因此可用于高效执行各类周期性轨迹，所需的大部分力矩由系统中的弹性元件提供，而非驱动器提供。本文还设计了两类控制器，一类可将系统稳定到目标模式，另一类可实现摆起动作并补偿耗散的能量。最后在二自由度机械臂上验证了该方法，实验结果表明该方法在测试系统上表现优异。

title: HaptiNet: Networked Haptic Robots Enable Physical Co-presence in Geographically-Unconstrained Rehabilitation
title_zh: HaptiNet：网络化触觉机器人为无地域限制康复场景提供物理共在能力
authors: Chenyang Sun, Mingjie Dong, Haodong Deng, Yudong Liu, Yi-Feng Chen 等 (21 人)
abstract: Cooperative rehabilitation enhances engagement, task performance, and social-motor interaction, yet it demands physical co-presence: users must transmit forces, coordinate movements, and infer intent through haptic contact. Telerehabilitation promises to expand access for patients constrained by distance, mobility, or clinical disparities, yet current techniques remain predominantly audiovisual while leaving users haptically and physically isolated. Here, we introduce HaptiNet, a networked haptic robotic system enabling physical co-presence for geographically distributed users via force-mediated interaction. Each robotic terminal features a low-inertia, long-stroke design with high force-feedback capacity, tailored for haptic rendering in upper-limb training. Building on these terminals, HaptiNet creates a distributed haptic network with an imitation-learning-based delay compensator, enabling users to physically perceive and coordinate with one another over distance. We validated HaptiNet in 284 healthy participants and 111 patients with neurological impairments across progressively realistic settings, including laboratory tests, cross-city deployments, and clinical applications. HaptiNet preserved task-level force rendering consistency across single-user and multi-user scenarios. Compared with solo and visual cooperative training, haptic cooperation improved task performance by 24% and 22%, respectively, while also boosting engagement and interpersonal motor synchrony. Across three intercity links totaling approximately 4,000 km, HaptiNet maintained stable haptic interaction among patients with neurological impairments, producing a 3.87-fold greater baseline-to-training score improvement and a 106% higher patient-applied effort over the solo condition.
summary_zh: 协作式康复可提升用户参与度、任务表现与社交运动交互能力，但该模式要求物理共在：用户需要通过触觉接触传递力信号、协调动作、推断意图。远程康复有望为受距离、移动能力或医疗资源差异限制的患者提供服务，但现有远程康复技术大多仅支持音视频交互，用户在触觉与物理层面仍处于隔离状态。本文提出HaptiNet网络化触觉机器人系统，可通过力介导交互为地理分布的用户提供物理共在能力。每个机器人终端采用低惯量、长行程设计，具备高力反馈能力，专为上肢训练的触觉渲染场景定制。基于这类终端，HaptiNet构建了集成模仿学习延迟补偿器的分布式触觉网络，支持用户跨距离实现物理感知与动作协调。本文在逐步贴近真实场景的环境下完成验证，包含实验室测试、跨城市部署与临床应用，共覆盖284名健康受试者与111名神经功能障碍患者。HaptiNet在单用户与多用户场景下均保持了任务级力渲染的一致性。与单人训练、视觉协作训练相比，触觉协作分别将任务表现提升24%与22%，同时提升了用户参与度与人际运动同步性。在总长度约4000公里的3条城际链路中，HaptiNet可维持神经功能障碍患者之间的稳定触觉交互，其基线到训练阶段的评分提升幅度是单人训练场景的3.87倍，患者主动施加的力比单人训练场景高106%。

title: Continuous Cognitive Coverage for Autonomous Robots via Event-Dependent Cognitive Treatment and Learning
title_zh: 基于事件依赖认知处理与学习的自主机器人连续认知覆盖
authors: Hong Su
abstract: Autonomous robots continuously encounter objects, changes, and situations, and every event admitted into cognition should receive an appropriate cognitive treatment rather than remain untreated until an explicit task requires attention. However, existing task-driven, reactive, or fixed-reasoning approaches generally process only selected events or apply predefined reasoning procedures, making it difficult to provide continuous cognitive coverage with differentiated treatment. This paper proposes a continuous cognitive coverage framework in which every cognitively admitted event is assigned an event-dependent cognitive treatment according to its state, context, and history. Different events may therefore invoke description, memory, risk prediction, planning, diagnosis, analogy, or other learned treatments. Familiar events can be processed automatically by learned mechanisms, whereas unfamiliar or uncertain events invoke explicit deliberation or fallback reasoning. Multiple cognitive processes can be suspended, resumed, and interleaved so that cognitive processing continues as new events arrive or existing events await evidence. Validated experiences are continuously learned to automate, refine, and revise event-specific treatments. Experiments achieve 96.76% structured treatment accuracy with 93.66% automatic processing, 92.64% cognitive coverage under bursty-delayed workloads, and 79.53% continual-learning joint accuracy, with novel-event reuse reaching 100% automatic processing.
summary_zh: 自主机器人会持续遇到各类物体、变化与场景，所有进入认知流程的事件都应当得到适配的认知处理，而非等到显式任务触发时才被处理。但现有任务驱动、反应式或固定推理方法通常仅处理选定的事件，或应用预定义的推理流程，难以实现差异化处理的连续认知覆盖。本文提出一种连续认知覆盖框架，所有进入认知流程的事件都会根据其状态、上下文与历史信息，分配事件专属的认知处理逻辑。不同事件可触发描述、记忆、风险预测、规划、诊断、类比等各类学习得到的处理流程。熟悉的事件可通过学习得到的机制自动处理，而陌生或不确定的事件则触发显式决策或 fallback 推理。多个认知进程可被挂起、恢复与交错执行，确保新事件到达或现有事件等待证据时认知处理不会中断。系统可持续学习已验证的经验，实现事件专属处理逻辑的自动化、优化与修正。实验结果表明，该框架的结构化处理准确率达96.76%，自动处理占比达93.66%，在突发延迟工作负载下认知覆盖率达92.64%，持续学习联合准确率达79.53%，新事件的自动处理占比可达100%。

title: Dressing in Motion: A Human Motion-Aware Diffusion Policy for Robot-Assisted Dressing
title_zh: 动态穿戴：面向机器人辅助穿戴的人体运动感知扩散策略
authors: Haoxiang Sun, Fangyuan Wang, Songhao Huang, Justina Y. W. Liu, Jihong Zhu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Robotic dressing assistance is a promising solution for supporting older adults with physical impairments in daily living. However, dressing under human motion remains challenging, as complex garment--human contact and occlusions make it difficult to generate actions aligned with arm movements. In this letter, we propose a visuomotor policy that learns dressing skills from static expert demonstrations and generalizes to dynamic user-motion scenarios. A diffusion policy tailored to garment--human interaction geometry learns from partially observed point clouds with varied arm postures. We then introduce an object-centric representation based on PDE diffusion to capture the axial distribution of the arm. By sampling motion-relevant regions and registering them across consecutive observations, the proposed method approximates arm motion and reactively adapts the executed trajectory. We evaluate our method in simulation and a real-world human study involving nine participants, three garment types, and six arm-motion patterns. Results show that our method outperforms baselines in dressing progress, freedom of movement, and user comfort. The project website isthis https URL.
summary_zh: 机器人辅助穿戴是帮助存在肢体功能障碍的老年人完成日常生活活动的极具前景的方案。但在人体运动过程中完成穿戴任务仍存在挑战：复杂的衣物-人体接触与遮挡问题导致机器人难以生成与手臂运动对齐的动作。本文提出一种视觉运动策略，可从静态专家演示中学习穿戴技能，并泛化到用户动态运动场景。本文针对衣物-人体交互几何定制扩散策略，可从包含不同手臂姿态的部分观测点云中学习。随后提出基于偏微分方程（PDE）扩散的物体级表示，用于捕捉手臂的轴向分布。通过对运动相关区域采样并在连续观测之间完成配准，该方法可估计手臂运动，对执行轨迹进行反应式自适应调整。本文在仿真环境与真实人体研究中对所提方法开展评估，共包含9名受试者、3类衣物与6种手臂运动模式。结果表明，该方法在穿戴进度、用户活动自由度与用户舒适度方面均优于基线方案。项目主页可访问指定链接。

title: Pack It My Way: Triadic Human-Robot Collaboration for Personalized Autonomous Packing
title_zh: 按我的方式打包：面向个性化自主打包的三元人机协作
authors: Sandeep Chowdary Kotapati, Yanxin Gao, Tsung-Chi Lin
abstract: Personalized autonomous packing requires robots to account for resident preferences that cannot be inferred from scene geometry alone. Expert teleoperators can interpret these preferences and translate them into feasible robot actions, but continuous expert involvement limits scalable deployment. In this paper, we investigate triadic human-robot collaboration among a resident, a correction mediator, and a robot by comparing human-expert and voice-agent mediation. We evaluate the two conditions in a user study across Protection, Compactness, andGrouping tasks, using a Show-Correct-Generalize process to assess preference correction and subsequent generalization after the surrounding objects are rearranged. Results show that voice-agent mediation achieves outcomes comparable to human-expert mediation in two of the three preference categories, despite receiving shorter and less detailed instructions. Both mediators are similarly easy to use, although the human expert is perceived as more reliable. These findings demonstrate the potential of voice agents to reduce expert involvement while identifying perceived reliability and preference generalization as remaining challenges.
summary_zh: 个性化自主打包要求机器人考虑仅通过场景几何信息无法推断出的居住者偏好。远程操作专家可以解读这些偏好并将其转化为可行的机器人动作，但专家的持续参与限制了方案的规模化部署。本文通过对比人类专家中介与语音智能体中介两种模式，研究了居住者、校正中介与机器人三者构成的三元人机协作机制。我们在涵盖防护任务、紧凑性任务与分组任务的用户研究中对两种模式进行评估，采用「演示-校正-泛化」流程，评估偏好校正效果以及周边物体重排后的后续泛化能力。结果表明，尽管语音智能体中介收到的指令更短、细节更少，但在三类偏好类别中的两类上取得了与人类专家中介相当的效果。两种中介的易用性相近，不过人类专家在感知层面被认为可靠性更高。上述发现证明了语音智能体在降低专家参与度方面的潜力，同时也指出感知可靠性与偏好泛化是仍待解决的挑战。

title: Open-Set 3D Scene Graphs for Field Robotics: An Outdoor Case Study
title_zh: 面向野外机器人的开集3D场景图：户外案例研究
authors: Chad R. Samuelson, Gabriel R. Slade, Joshua G. Mangelson
abstract: Three-dimensional scene graphs (3DSGs) have emerged as a promising approach for building geometrically grounded, semantically informed, hierarchical general-purpose maps to support high-level robotic reasoning. However, the behavior of 3DSGs in real-world outdoor deployments remains poorly understood, particularly when combined with open-set vision-language models (VLMs). In this field report, we analyze the components common to most 3DSG representations across five outdoor robotic datasets to characterize challenges that arise in complex outdoor environments. Using the recently proposed Terra 3DSG as a case study, we investigate semantic point embeddings, place-node graph navigation, region-level understanding, and memory size across the five diverse datasets. We additionally introduce novel consistency metrics to evaluate whether semantic and structural graph properties remain stable across repeated traversals of the same environment. Our analysis reveals that outliers and multiple modes are common in VLM point embeddings across all tested datasets with outlier ratios above $0.1$ for around $30\%$ of points. We demonstrate the feasibility of outdoor 3DSGs for navigation-based object retrieval, achieving success rates near $70\%$, though performance is limited by traversability failures and inefficient routing, with trajectories averaging approximately $66\%$ suboptimal path efficiency. Region-level understanding remains challenging in complex natural environments, with low average F1 scores around $0.359$. Overall, our results show that outdoor 3DSGs can maintain compact (less than $600$MB for multi-kilometer trajectories) and relatively consistent large-scale environment representations, while highlighting open challenges in handling multiple semantic modes, incorporating traversability into graph structures, and improving higher-level region understanding.
summary_zh: 三维场景图（3DSGs）是一类极具前景的技术方案，可构建具备几何基础、语义信息的层级化通用地图，支撑机器人的高层推理任务。但3DSG在真实户外部署场景下的表现仍未得到充分研究，尤其是与开集视觉语言模型（VLMs）结合后的特性尚不明确。本领域报告中，我们分析了5个户外机器人数据集下多数3DSG表示共有的组件，梳理复杂户外环境中出现的各类挑战。以近期提出的Terra 3DSG为案例，我们在5个不同数据集上研究了语义点嵌入、地点节点图导航、区域级理解与内存占用特性。我们还提出了全新的一致性指标，用于评估同一环境多次遍历后图的语义属性与结构属性是否保持稳定。分析结果显示，所有测试数据集的VLM点嵌入中普遍存在离群点与多模态现象，约30%的点的离群点占比高于0.1。我们验证了户外3DSG用于导航类目标检索的可行性，成功率接近70%，但性能受可通行性故障与低效路由限制，轨迹的平均路径效率仅为最优路径的约66%。在复杂自然环境中区域级理解任务仍存在挑战，平均F1分数仅为0.359。总体而言，我们的结果表明户外3DSG可生成轻量化（数公里轨迹的占用内存小于600MB）、相对一致的大规模环境表示，同时也明确了当前仍待解决的开放挑战：处理多语义模态、将可通行性信息融入图结构、提升高层级区域理解能力。

title: NavArena: Automated Construction of Goal-Oriented Navigation Benchmarks from 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstructions
title_zh: NavArena：基于3D高斯溅射重建的面向目标导航基准集自动化构建框架
authors: Junhui Wang, Wei Yang, Xinyao Li, Ningjing Fan, Yuehao Yin 等 (7 人)
abstract: Fixed 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructions provide realistic novel views but lack the traversability constraints, valid goals, and closed-loop protocols required for navigation evaluation. We introduce NavArena, an automated framework that transforms fixed 3DGS reconstructions into benchmarks for goal-oriented visual navigation. NavArena integrates a frozen 3DGS model for egocentric RGB-D rendering, an occupancy costmap derived from Gaussian density and height statistics for reachability and collision queries, and semantic goal candidates lifted from multi-view open-vocabulary masks. These components support the automatic generation and unified closed-loop evaluation of goal-oriented navigation episodes. Across more than 2{,}000 scenes, NavArena generates 22.2 million expert trajectories. Spatial and semantic evaluations assess the derived navigation representations, while policy rollouts demonstrate the diagnostic value of the unified evaluation protocol. NavArena enables scalable and reproducible navigation evaluation on large-scale 3DGS reconstructions, and all benchmark-generation tools, evaluation protocols, and derived assets will be released publicly.
summary_zh: 固定的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）重建结果可生成逼真的新视角图像，但缺少导航评估所需的可通行性约束、有效目标与闭环协议。本文提出NavArena这一自动化框架，可将固定3DGS重建结果转化为面向目标的视觉导航基准集。NavArena集成了用于第一视角RGB-D渲染的冻结3DGS模型、基于高斯密度与高度统计生成的用于可达性与碰撞查询的占用代价地图，以及从多视图开放词汇掩码中提取的语义目标候选集。上述组件可支持面向目标导航片段的自动生成与统一闭环评估。在超过2000个场景中，NavArena可生成2220万条专家轨迹。空间与语义评估验证了生成的导航表示的有效性，同时策略滚动测试证明了统一评估协议的诊断价值。NavArena可支持大规模3DGS重建场景下可复现的规模化导航评估，所有基准生成工具、评估协议与衍生资源将全部对外开源。

title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
title_zh: 面向部署后物理人工智能的持续野外自适应模型（CFAMs）
authors: Amarjot Singh, Tanmay R. Pancholi, Jainam Kothari, Shrirang Mahajan, Ketan Bansal 等 (10 人)
abstract: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence.We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. The Capsule Field stores field learning one-shot and gradient-free as Competence Capsules. Skill installation is few-shot in the lab and continual in the field; open-world novelty is outside scope.We evaluate CFAM across five embodiments: manipulator, quadruped, humanoid, quadrotor, and off-road vehicle. Baselines (pi0, CogACT, SpatialVLA) use the same in-house multi-embodiment dataset for physical-platform comparisons. CFAM reaches the operating point of a standard policy trained on the full prior-training dataset using 40% of the data, or 2.5x fewer trajectories. At test time, autonomous capture of verified near-OOD cases improves action success by 13.9 percentage points. In sequential simulation, backward transfer is -0.5 percentage points versus -11.4 for LoRA. CFAM therefore provides a bounded form of post-deployment physical intelligence: few-shot skill learning, autonomous field growth from verified near-OOD experience, and retention of prior competence.
summary_zh: 无人值守交互式自主系统——即替代人类进入危险环境、使用人类工具完成任务的机器——仍是关键任务场景中缺失的核心能力。这类场景下训练数据稀缺，且仅能搭载机载计算资源，已部署的系统必须在不遗忘已有能力的前提下应对未知新场景。本文提出持续野外自适应模型（CFAMs），该模型可在实验室阶段高效学习，并在部署后通过自主、无梯度、设备端更新的方式持续学习。CFAM采用互补学习架构，包含冻结的慢学习组件与快速学习的胶囊场。慢学习组件包含三个皮层模块：传感器模块，将多模态输入映射到基于3D几何的表示；推理模块，将任务分解为子技能并评估执行结果；动作模块，执行几何技能。胶囊场以能力胶囊的形式实现单样本、无梯度的野外学习。技能学习在实验室阶段为少样本模式，在野外阶段为持续模式，不涉及开放世界未知场景的处理。我们在5种不同实体平台上对CFAM进行评估：机械臂、四足机器人、人形机器人、四旋翼无人机与越野车辆。基线方法pi0、CogACT、SpatialVLA均使用相同的自研多实体平台数据集进行物理平台性能对比。CFAM仅使用全量预训练数据集40%的数据（轨迹数量减少2.5倍）即可达到在全量数据集上训练的标准策略的性能水平。测试阶段，自主采集经过验证的近分布外案例可将动作成功率提升13.9个百分点。在顺序仿真测试中，CFAM的反向迁移性能下降仅为-0.5个百分点，而LoRA的性能下降为-11.4个百分点。因此CFAM提供了一种有边界的部署后物理智能能力：支持少样本技能学习、基于验证后的近分布外经验实现自主野外能力增长，同时保留原有能力。

title: Achieving Asymptotic Near-Optimality Without $δ$-Similarity
title_zh: 无需δ相似性实现渐近近最优性
authors: Michael Moncton, Eric Frew
abstract: Sampling-based motion planning algorithms are a popular class of trajectory planning algorithm due to their speed in complex, high-dimensional environments and ability to handle kinodynamic constraints, specifically through the use of forward dynamics propagation. Many such planners claim to achieve asymptotic near-optimality by proving the almost sure sampling of trajectories that are close to an optimal trajectory in the state space, known as $\delta$-similar trajectories. This paper shows that the proof behind asymptotic $\delta$-similarity relies on an unstated assumption that $\delta$-similar trajectory segments will always be kept once sampled. This assumption does not hold in general. A problematic case, referred to as ``crowding out,'' is described, where locally low-cost paths prevent trajectories that are $\delta$-similar to the optimal trajectory from being added to the tree. It is shown, however, that asymptotic near-optimality guarantees can still be achieved without guarantees of $\delta$-similar solution trajectories when crowding out is properly accounted for. An example environment and system are provided where crowding out is shown to occur, demonstrating a scenario where inductively sampling a $\delta$-similar solution trajectory is impossible.
summary_zh: 基于采样的运动规划算法是一类主流的轨迹规划算法，凭借其在复杂高维环境下的运行速度优势，以及通过前向动力学传播处理运动动力学约束的能力得到广泛应用。许多这类规划器声称可通过证明几乎必然采样到状态空间中与最优轨迹接近的轨迹（即δ相似轨迹），实现渐近近最优性。本文指出，渐近δ相似性的证明依赖一个未明确说明的假设：即一旦采样到δ相似轨迹片段，该片段就会被永久保留。该假设在一般场景下并不成立。本文描述了一种被称为「挤出效应」的问题场景：局部低成本路径会阻止与最优轨迹δ相似的轨迹被添加到搜索树中。但本文同时证明，在合理处理挤出效应的前提下，即便无法保证存在δ相似的解轨迹，仍然可以实现渐近近最优性的理论保证。本文提供了存在挤出效应的示例环境与系统，证明了在该场景下通过归纳采样得到δ相似解轨迹是不可能的。

title: Game-Theoretic Drone Swarm Defense: A Case Study in Applied Differential Game Theory
title_zh: 博弈论无人机集群防御：应用微分博弈论案例研究
authors: Ross E. Allen
abstract: This technical report is a study of the use of differential game (DG) theory to solve the target-assignment and midcourse guidance problems of drone swarms tasked with intercepting opposing swarms in defense of high-value assets. The game-theoretic tactics---which treat the intruder swarm as a rational agent and seek a Nash equilibrium between defenders and intruders---are compared against baseline tactics that model the defense problem as a unilateral optimization of the defenders' maneuvers. Monte Carlo simulation and Bayesian analysis show that the game-theoretic approach has a higher probability of successfully intercepting all intruders than the baseline techniques. This improvement in successful defense probability is most pronounced when the intruder swarm is capable of evasive maneuvers: relative to baseline optimization tactics, differential-game tactics increase estimated defense success from 94.6% to 96.8%, closing approximately 41% of the remaining gap to perfect defense. To add statistical credibility to this result, a paired-trial Bayesian analysis assigns a 99.9% posterior probability that differential-game tactics have a higher probability of successful asset defense than baseline tactics in this scenario.
summary_zh: 本技术报告研究了如何使用微分博弈（DG）理论解决无人机集群的目标分配与中段制导问题，该类无人机集群的任务是拦截敌方集群以保护高价值资产。该博弈论战术将入侵集群视为理性智能体，求解防御方与入侵方之间的纳什均衡，我们将其与将防御问题建模为防御方机动单边优化的基线战术进行对比。蒙特卡洛仿真与贝叶斯分析结果表明，相比基线技术，博弈论方法成功拦截所有入侵者的概率更高。当入侵集群具备规避机动能力时，防御成功率的提升效果最为显著：相比基线优化战术，微分博弈战术将估计防御成功率从94.6%提升至96.8%，将与完美防御的剩余差距缩小了约41%。为进一步提升该结果的统计可信度，配对试验贝叶斯分析得出后验概率为99.9%，即在该场景下微分博弈战术的资产防御成功率高于基线战术。

title: Scalable Edge-assisted Fusion and Path Prediction for Connected Autonomous Vehicles
title_zh: 面向网联自动驾驶汽车的可扩展边缘辅助融合与路径预测
authors: Tyler Landle, Jackson Isenberg, Abhijit Chatterjee, Alexandros Daglis, Umakishore Ramachandran
abstract: The planning algorithms inside an Autonomous Vehicle (AV) rely on information from on-board sensors whose line of sight is limited by emerging traffic conditions and occlusions. Edge-assisted creation of a unified world model fusing information from AVs and Road Side Units (RSUs) in a geographical locale, and the prediction of AVs' future trajectories, can enhance theplanning algorithms inside AVs to improve quality metrics, such as better traffic flow and collision prevention. AVs participating in such enhancements are called Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs). However, such information generated by the edge (world model and motion predictions) must reach the planners within a tight Age of Information (AoI) time budget to beuseful. The state of the art fuses per-CAV information: each AV fuses inputs from other actors locally, which limits both scalability with actor count and quality of results.We present Conductor, an edge-based solution for creating a unified world model from the perspective of a fixed anchor (e.g., an RSU) in a locale and predicting future trajectories of AVs in that locale. Our solution adheres to the AoI time budget by dynamically limiting the number of AVs that would lead to the best quality of results. Specifically, we introduce anocclusion-aware selector that favors information contribution by AVs that detect objects in the locale not covered by RSUs. We pair this selector with a runtime controller that adapts both the number of AV inputs to fuse and the amount of trajectory predictions in each cycle to stay within the AoI time budget. Evaluation on CAV simulation infrastructure shows our jointselector-controller meets the AoI safety bound across traffic scenarios with up to 31 CAVs, with fusion fidelity close to an Oracle and much better than a random selector under the same AoI constraint.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶汽车（AV）内部的规划算法依赖车载传感器采集的信息，而传感器的视场会被动态交通状况与遮挡物限制。通过边缘辅助生成统一世界模型，融合特定地理区域内所有自动驾驶汽车与路侧单元（RSU）的信息，并预测自动驾驶汽车的未来轨迹，可增强自动驾驶汽车内部的规划算法性能，提升交通流畅度、碰撞防护等核心指标。参与这类增强能力的自动驾驶汽车被称为网联自动驾驶汽车（CAV）。但边缘生成的世界模型与运动预测信息必须在严格的信息年龄（AoI）时间预算内送达规划器才能发挥作用。当前的主流方案是融合单台CAV的信息：每台自动驾驶汽车在本地融合其他参与方的输入，这既限制了随参与方数量扩展的可扩展性，也限制了结果质量。本文提出Conductor，这一基于边缘的解决方案可从区域内固定锚点（例如路侧单元）的视角生成统一世界模型，并预测该区域内所有自动驾驶汽车的未来轨迹。我们的方案通过动态限制参与计算的自动驾驶汽车数量以获得最优结果质量，满足AoI时间预算要求。具体而言，我们提出了遮挡感知选择器，优先选择可检测到路侧单元未覆盖区域内目标的自动驾驶汽车提供信息。我们将该选择器与运行时控制器结合，动态调整每一轮中需要融合的自动驾驶汽车输入数量与轨迹预测数量，确保运行过程始终处于AoI时间预算范围内。在CAV仿真基础设施上的评估结果表明，我们的选择器-控制器联合方案在最多包含31台CAV的各类交通场景下均满足AoI安全边界要求，融合精度接近理想基准（Oracle），在相同AoI约束下性能远优于随机选择器。

title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
title_zh: VLA-Precision：面向视觉-语言-动作模型高效真实世界在线强化学习的非对称协同自举方法
authors: Chenyu Su, Zhaolong Shen, Yuan Qian, Chen Qian, Rui Zhang 等 (11 人)
abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability. Applying real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) to VLA post-training enables autonomous trial-and-error improvement beyond demonstrations alone, but exposes two bottlenecks: 1) unreliable value signals can induce policy drift; 2) large-VLA overhead constrains throughput and sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we present VLA-Precision, an efficient real-world online RL framework featuring the Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping (ACoB) algorithm and the ACoB-Stream architecture. Specifically, ACoB establishes asymmetric co-bootstrapping across timescales: early intervention-guided behavioral learning rapidly improves policy performance while enhancing online experience quality. As autonomous experience accumulates, global return propagation and local preference ranking progressively calibrate value estimates, yielding relative action advantages for reference-regularized policy improvement while suppressing drift. To enable ACoB on large VLAs, we develop ACoB-Stream, a closed-loop experience--policy architecture that establishes invariant-state decoupling and on-demand streaming as design principles, delivering up to 10.9$\times$ improvements in throughput and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on nine high-precision chemistry tasks across four categories and four robot embodiments show that VLA-Precision achieves 98.3\% mean success rate in 45.8 min/task, with 27.6 s episodes running at 1.2$\times$ and 1.8$\times$ the speeds of VLA and RL baselines. Resources are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可支持广泛的机械操作任务，但在对精度与可重复性要求较高的任务中仍不可靠。在VLA预训练后引入真实世界在线强化学习（RL），可在仅使用演示数据的基础上进一步实现自主试错优化，但该方法存在两个瓶颈：1）不可靠的价值信号会引发策略漂移；2）大尺寸VLA的计算开销限制了吞吐率与样本效率。为解决上述挑战，本文提出VLA-Precision，这一高效的真实世界在线RL框架集成了非对称协同自举（ACoB）算法与ACoB-Stream架构。具体而言，ACoB在不同时间尺度上建立非对称协同自举机制：早期的干预引导行为学习可快速提升策略性能，同时提升在线经验的质量。随着自主经验的不断积累，全局回报传播与局部偏好排序可逐步校准价值估计，生成相对动作优势用于参考正则化的策略优化，同时抑制策略漂移。为在大尺寸VLA上部署ACoB，我们开发了ACoB-Stream这一闭环经验-策略架构，将不变状态解耦与按需流式处理作为核心设计原则，将吞吐率与计算效率提升最高达10.9倍。我们在4类共9项高精度化学任务、4种不同机器人实体平台上开展的大量评估表明，VLA-Precision的平均任务成功率可达98.3%，单任务平均耗时45.8分钟，单轮片段时长27.6秒，运行速度分别是VLA基线与RL基线的1.2倍与1.8倍。相关资源已发布至对应公开链接。

title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
title_zh: Diffusion TV：通过有形具身交互体验扩散模型
authors: Sihwa Park
abstract: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. Rather than providing explicit technical explanation, the work presents an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI that invites exploratory engagement with and reflection on generative technologies.
summary_zh: Diffusion TV是一款交互式AI艺术装置，通过改装的显像管（CRT）电视为用户提供有形的具身化扩散模型体验。用户可通过物理方式调节电视天线，控制AI生成图像与声音的清晰度，以隐喻的方式复现扩散生成底层的去噪过程。用户还可通过调节旋钮切换三个频道，分别展示来自过去（已灭绝物种）、现在（濒危物种）与未来（虚构生物）的AI生成动物，将交互过程置于时间与生态叙事的语境下。通过连续的视听反馈与物理交互，Diffusion TV将生成过程置于比最终输出更核心的位置，让用户可以探索中间状态并将其作为体验素材。该作品没有提供明确的技术解释，而是提出了一种全新的具身化可解释AI模式，引导用户探索生成式技术并对其进行反思。

title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
title_zh: RegionFed：面向异构零售环境中个性化查询理解的联邦学习框架
authors: Quoc H. Nguyen, Ali Lafzi, Abhijeet Phatak, Siddharth Pratap Singh, Rohit Upadhyay 等 (7 人)
abstract: Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserving training and model personalization. Federated learning offers a natural solution for privacy, but standard FL methods produce global models that sacrifice regional performance, while existing personalized FL approaches operate at the parameter level and catastrophically collapse on modern transformers (below 10\% accuracy on T5) due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm interactions. We introduce RegionFed, an \textit{architecture-robust} federated learning framework that sidesteps this failure by operating entirely at the gradient level. RegionFed uses the $\ell_2$ conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal that (i) diagnoses heterogeneity, (ii) routes each region to the cheapest sufficient personalization strategy, and (iii) adaptively controls personalization strength. Because it treats models as differentiable black boxes, RegionFed deploys on T5-Small, T5-3B, RoBERTa, and CNN with zero code changes, providing large gains on transformers (where parameter-level methods collapse) and consistent improvements on CNNs. Across three public datasets (Amazon ESCI, Amazon Reviews, LEAF-FEMNIST) and four architectures, RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27\%, closing the gap to the privacy-violating centralized upper bound (Centralized + Regional Weighting: 92.04\%, $\Delta$=0.23pp, within 1$\sigma$) while providing $(\epsilon{\approx}0.60)$-differential privacy and $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence.
summary_zh: 零售搜索系统服务于不同地理区域，不同区域的查询模式、词汇体系与产品偏好差异显著，带来了严重的数据异构性问题，给隐私保护训练与模型个性化都带来了挑战。联邦学习是天然的隐私保护解决方案，但标准联邦学习方法生成的全局模型会牺牲区域性能，而现有的个性化联邦学习方法均在参数层面操作，由于嵌入绑定与层归一化（LayerNorm）的交互效应，在现代Transformer模型上会出现灾难性崩溃（在T5模型上准确率低于10%）。本文提出RegionFed，这一架构鲁棒的联邦学习框架完全在梯度层面操作，可规避上述故障。RegionFed使用区域梯度与全局梯度之间的ℓ₂冲突作为统一信号，实现三大功能：（1）诊断异构性程度，（2）为每个区域路由到成本最低的适配个性化策略，（3）自适应控制个性化强度。由于该框架将模型视为可微黑盒，无需修改任何代码即可部署在T5-Small、T5-3B、RoBERTa与CNN模型上，在参数级方法出现崩溃的Transformer模型上实现了大幅性能提升，同时在CNN模型上也实现了稳定的性能提升。在3个公开数据集（Amazon ESCI、Amazon Reviews、LEAF-FEMNIST）与4种架构上的实验结果表明，RegionFed-Meta的准确率可达92.27%，与违反隐私约束的集中式方法上界（集中式+区域加权：92.04%，差值为0.23个百分点，处于1σ范围内）的差距极小，同时可提供ε≈0.60的差分隐私保证，以及O(1/√T)的收敛速度。

title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
title_zh: 面向带标注无线信号合成的深度生成模型
authors: Yuxiao Li, Keke Hu, Santiago Mazuelas, Yuan Shen
abstract: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenged by significant measurement and labeling costs. Traditional methods for synthesizing labeled wireless signals typically rely on environmental models, leading to extensive hyper-parameter tuning and inadequate realism for comprehensive model training purposes. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel deep learning (DL)-based method, namely Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), to generate realistic labeled wireless signals. The generated signals are particularly adaptive to different environment scenarios and well-suited for various model training tasks, including distance estimation and environment identification. We have conducted extensive experiments on public Ultra-Wideband (UWB) datasets to evaluate the realism and utility of the generated signals. The results demonstrate that the signals generated by IIns-GAN mirror the physical characteristics of real-world measurements, and significantly contribute to the improvement of model training in diverse wireless sensing tasks.
summary_zh: 具备位置相关标签的无线信号是无线感知领域性能评估与模型训练的核心基础。但获取真实场景数据集通常面临极高的测量与标注成本。传统的带标注无线信号合成方法通常依赖环境建模，需要大量超参数调优，且生成信号的真实度不足以支撑全场景模型训练需求。为解决上述局限，本文提出一种基于深度学习（DL）的全新方法：实例间生成对抗网络（Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks, IIns-GAN），用于生成高真实度的带标注无线信号。生成的信号可适配不同环境场景，能够很好地支撑距离估计、环境识别等各类模型训练任务。研究团队在公开超宽带（Ultra-Wideband, UWB）数据集上开展了大量实验，验证生成信号的真实度与实用价值。实验结果表明，IIns-GAN生成的信号能够复现真实测量数据的物理特性，可显著提升各类无线感知任务的模型训练效果。

title: Multi-Step Tool-Calling over Korean Open Public APIs: A Benchmark and a Data-Synthesis Recipe
title_zh: 面向韩国开放公共API的多步工具调用：基准测试集与数据合成方案
authors: Dain Kim, Eungi Cho, Kyumin Kim, Shinyeong Noh, Kyuseong Lim
abstract: Data-sovereignty regulations increasingly require public institutions to deploy open-source, on-premise LLM agents that chain multiple tool-calls across live government APIs. However, open-source models consistently underperform in this multi-step setting, and no existing benchmark measures the gap. We introduce the Korean Open Public API Benchmark (KOPA-Bench), comprising 145 real-world tasks. To close this gap, we present EDGE, an Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph for tool-calling data synthEsis driven by live execution. EDGE builds a graph of how each tool's output can feed another's input, keeps only the links that succeed when actually called against the live APIs, and traverses these verified links to synthesize executable multi-step trajectories. Fine-tuned via GRPO on the resulting dataset, our 9B model nearly matches the untuned 27B model from the same family, improving substantially not only on KOPA-Bench but also on the BFCL benchmark.
summary_zh: 数据主权相关法规正逐步要求公共机构部署开源、本地化的大语言模型智能体，这类智能体需要串联多步工具调用对接实时政府API。但当前开源模型在这类多步调用场景下的表现始终不佳，且尚无现有基准测试集能够量化该性能差距。本文提出韩国开放公共API基准测试集（Korean Open Public API Benchmark, KOPA-Bench），包含145项真实场景任务。为填补性能差距，本文提出EDGE框架：由实时执行驱动的面向工具调用数据合成的执行导向动态图（Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph for tool-calling data synthEsis, EDGE）。EDGE构建工具输出与后续工具输入的关联图，仅保留对接实时API时可成功调用的链路，遍历这些经过验证的链路合成可执行的多步调用轨迹。在EDGE生成的数据集上使用GRPO方法微调后，本文开发的9B参数模型性能几乎与同系列未微调27B参数模型持平，不仅在KOPA-Bench上性能大幅提升，在BFCL基准测试集上也取得了显著进步。

title: Necessary or Sufficient? Evaluating LLM Explanations With Behavioural Evidence
title_zh: 必要还是充分？基于行为证据的大语言模型解释评估
authors: Urja Pawar, Rajitha Ramanayake, Nabeel Kemal, Ashwin Kandath, Owen O'Neill 等 (7 人)
abstract: LLM decision components that can operate within agent workflows often produce action-relevant recommendations or judgements together with explanations. Operators may use the named factors to monitor a system, diagnose errors, or decide when to escalate an output. Such use assumes that the explanations agree with the component's observable decision behaviour. We test two interpretations of the named factors: necessity, meaning that changing a factor would change the output, and sufficiency, meaning that retaining it while removing other changeable information would preserve the output. We evaluate these interpretations in two synthetic use cases: recommending advisors to clients and judging prompts for harmfulness or risk. Models return an output and the top three factors that most influenced it. Controlled black-box interventions estimate a necessity score for each factor by measuring how often changing it changes the output, and a sufficiency score by measuring how often retaining it preserves the output. Across eight models from the Claude, GPT, and Gemini families, the mean Spearman correlations between the cited ranking and the necessity and sufficiency scores are 0.349 and 0.354 for advisor recommendation, and 0.431 and 0.580 for prompt monitoring. Furthermore, an uncited factor scores above the lowest-scoring cited factor in 57.6% of advisor responses under necessity and 58.1% under sufficiency; the corresponding prompt-monitoring rates are 25.8% and 8.9%. The cited top three contain useful information but do not reliably identify the three factors with the strongest measured influence under necessity or sufficiency. The framework provides a black-box reliability check for explanations used in agent oversight while remaining scoped to individual LLM decisions.
summary_zh: 可在智能体工作流中运行的大语言模型决策组件通常会输出与动作相关的推荐或判断，同时附带解释内容。操作人员可借助解释中提及的要素监控系统运行、诊断错误，或决定何时需要升级输出结果。这类使用场景默认解释内容与组件可观测的决策行为完全一致。本文对解释中提及的要素开展两类验证：必要性，即改变该要素就会改变输出结果；充分性，即保留该要素、移除其他可变更信息时，输出结果保持不变。研究在两类合成用例中验证上述两类特性：为客户推荐顾问、判断提示词的危害性或风险。模型输出结果的同时，返回对结果影响最大的前三位要素。通过受控黑盒干预，统计改变某要素时输出结果发生变化的频率得到该要素的必要性得分，统计仅保留该要素时输出结果保持不变的频率得到该要素的充分性得分。针对Claude、GPT、Gemini系列共8款模型的测试结果显示，在顾问推荐场景下，模型给出的要素排序与实测必要性、充分性得分的平均斯皮尔曼相关系数分别为0.349和0.354；在提示词监控场景下，该数值分别为0.431和0.580。此外，在顾问推荐场景下，57.6%的非引用要素必要性得分高于得分最低的引用要素，58.1%的非引用要素充分性得分高于得分最低的引用要素；提示词监控场景下上述比例分别为25.8%和8.9%。模型给出的前三位引用要素包含有效信息，但无法可靠识别出实测影响最强的三个必要性/充分性要素。本文提出的框架可为智能体监管场景下使用的解释提供黑盒可靠性校验，且校验范围可覆盖单个大语言模型的每一次决策。

title: Molecular Déjà Vu: Digit-Level Retrieval of Published Values in Frontier Language Models
title_zh: 分子似曾相识：前沿语言模型中已发表数值的数位级检索行为研究
authors: Matthias Busch, Marius Tacke, Sviatlana V. Lamaka, Mikhail L. Zheludkevich, Christian J. Cyron 等 (7 人)
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated on molecular property benchmarks, but accuracy cannot distinguish a model that predicts a property from one that retrieves a published number. We audit 22 frontier models on 12 regression benchmarks for verbatim retrieval and find that it is widespread but relatively benchmark-specific: on five datasets more than $50\%$ of the LLMs show verbatim retrieval, while on the remaining datasets it appears only in isolated cells. We run our experiments at two reasoning levels and find that reasoning changes retrieval. The same experiments, on the same molecules and with the same prompt, are flagged $89\%$ more often at the higher reasoning level than at the lowest one. Finally, we test a way to interrupt retrieval in our most contaminated cases, and find that the strongest models in some cases still recognise a combination of transformed SMILES strings and original labels. Furthermore, suppressing retrieval moves the prediction errors of the different models closer together in relative terms, while their differing use of verbatim retrieval spreads them apart. This indicates that the general predictive capability of an LLM is not determined solely by the amount of memorised values. This work provides an overview of the amount and depth of verbatim retrieval in molecular regression benchmarks using LLMs.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）在分子属性基准测试集上的评估越来越多，但仅靠预测准确率无法区分模型是通过推理预测得到属性值，还是直接检索已发表的公开数值得到结果。本文针对22款前沿大模型在12个回归基准测试集上的逐字检索行为开展审计，发现该现象十分普遍但存在明显的基准集特异性：在5个数据集上，超过50%的大模型存在逐字检索行为，其余数据集上该现象仅在个别样本中出现。研究在两个不同推理层级开展对照实验，发现推理过程会显著改变检索行为：针对完全相同的分子、完全相同的提示词，高推理层级下的检索行为检出率比低推理层级高89%。最后本文测试了在检索行为最突出的场景下打断检索的方法，发现部分最强性能的模型仍可识别经过变换的简化分子线性输入规范（SMILES）字符串与原始标签的组合。此外，抑制检索行为后，不同模型的预测误差相对差距会缩小，而不同模型逐字检索行为的差异会拉大预测误差差距，这说明大语言模型的通用预测能力并不完全由其记忆的数值总量决定。本文全面梳理了大语言模型在分子回归基准测试任务中的逐字检索行为的发生规模与深度。

title: CUA-Universe: A Scalable and Dynamic Environment for Hybrid GUI+CLI Agents
title_zh: CUA-Universe：面向GUI+CLI混合智能体的可扩展动态环境
authors: Haoting Shi, Wenhao Wang, Weicheng Fang, Yaozhong Liang, Tian Jin 等 (9 人)
abstract: Computer-use agents have advanced on benchmarks like OSWorld and AndroidWorld, but still act mostly through the GUI, often producing inefficient trajectories. Real-world computer work is hybrid, combining visual-state inspection with precise, high-throughput command-line operations, so capable agents must coordinate both modalities over shared application state. Yet scalable hybrid environments remain scarce because supporting both GUI and CLI over real applications typically requires substantial manual engineering for each application. Existing agents also struggle to use the two interfaces complementarily: CLI-native agents lack visual perception for tasks involving interface state or layout, while GUI-native agents are inefficient for operations better executed through commands. We introduce CUA-Universe, a scalable environment-to-data pipeline that turns real desktop software into hybrid GUI+CLI environments. App-Forge adapts applications into reproducible VMs and command-line surfaces it discovers, wraps, or generates, scaling to 16 applications; Task-Weave synthesizes diverse hybrid tasks of controllable difficulty from reusable operations over seed files; and Path-Steer steers rollouts along efficient hybrid paths and harvests verified trajectories for post-training. Training on this data shifts behavior from inefficient GUI interaction and brittle CLI scripting toward effective GUI+CLI orchestration. Our 9B model improves both success and efficiency on CUA-Verse (Score +39.3 pts; -37% steps, -60% tokens), OSWorld (SR +16.8 pts; -57% steps, -44% tokens), and OSWorld-MCP (Score +7.84 pts; -27% steps, -30% tokens). CUA-Universe provides a scalable path toward more capable and efficient computer-use agents.
summary_zh: 计算机操作智能体已在OSWorld、AndroidWorld等基准测试集上取得进展，但这类智能体大多仅通过图形用户界面（GUI）执行操作，生成的运行轨迹效率很低。真实场景下的计算机工作是混合模式的，同时包含视觉状态检查和精准、高吞吐量的命令行（CLI）操作，高性能智能体必须在共享应用状态下协同两类操作模式。但当前可扩展的混合操作环境十分稀缺，因为同时支持真实应用的GUI和CLI通常需要为每款应用投入大量人工开发工作。现有智能体也难以实现两类接口的互补使用：原生CLI智能体缺乏视觉感知能力，无法处理涉及界面状态或布局的任务；原生GUI智能体在适合用命令执行的操作上效率极低。本文提出CUA-Universe，这是一套可扩展的从环境构建到数据生成的流水线，可将真实桌面软件转化为GUI+CLI混合操作环境：其中App-Forge模块将应用适配到可复现虚拟机中，自动发现、封装或生成命令行接口，目前已支持16款应用；Task-Weave模块基于种子文件的可复用操作，合成难度可控的各类混合任务；Path-Steer模块引导智能体沿高效混合路径完成操作，采集经过验证的轨迹用于后续训练。基于该数据集训练后，智能体的行为从低效的GUI交互、鲁棒性差的CLI脚本转向高效的GUI+CLI协同调度。本文开发的9B参数模型在CUA-Verse基准上得分提升39.3分，操作步数减少37%，token消耗减少60%；在OSWorld基准上成功率提升16.8个百分点，操作步数减少57%，token消耗减少44%；在OSWorld-MCP基准上得分提升7.84分，操作步数减少27%，token消耗减少30%。CUA-Universe为开发性能更强、效率更高的计算机操作智能体提供了可扩展的实现路径。

title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less
title_zh: 你只需要设计文档：面向AI原生的机器学习性能工具
authors: Chang Liu, Edward Raff, Kristopher Micinski
abstract: Decompilation recovers high-level source from compiled machine code and serves as a foundation for security tasks such as vulnerability detection and malware analysis. Traditional decompilers like Ghidra and Hex-Rays expose whatever they cannot resolve as visible placeholders and often emit pseudocode that will not compile or execute; LLM-based decompilers produce clean, idiomatic C and are now judged almost entirely by recompilability and re-executability: whether the output builds and passes its shipped input/output tests. We show that these metrics can reward the wrong path: a function may recompile and pass every shipped test yet diverge on other legitimate inputs, and a disclosed vulnerability may disappear from the recompiled code with no visible trace of the crash. Neither failure is caught by existing suites.To address this gap, we propose Decompile-Diverge, a behavioral comparison oracle not relying on fixed or hand-crafted tests: for each function it synthesizes a driver, grows a fuzzing corpus from the reference, and reruns the decompiled code on the same inputs to detect changes in the function's behavior. Across eight systems in nine configurations on established LLM decompilation corpora, candidates that pass every shipped test still diverge from the original on our input corpus: 4.9% overall, and as many as 13% for a single system. On 300 real GitHub library functions and 287 CVE-grounded functions, recompilability and behavioral agreement can come apart: the strongest refinement LLM lifts Ghidra's build rate from 75% to 90%, while its Matched rate falls from 74% to 62%; on disclosed vulnerabilities, up to one tenth exhibit Crash Absence in its output. Source-level analysis traces this divergence to introduced fields, types, callees, and guards that replace the visible unknowns traditional tools leave behind.
summary_zh: 机器学习性能建模是长期维护软件的高难度场景：当前抽象层内置的假设会随着后续新模型、新系统的出现失效，迫使性能建模框架持续重构。与此同时，AI编码智能体的速度与能力已经足够高，完全重写整个库的成本比逐步修补代码偿还技术债务的成本更低。本文介绍SMART，这是一套面向机器学习系统的严谨符号性能建模库，其主分支几乎不包含手写代码：代码仓库是由自包含的自然语言设计文档组成的有向无环图（DAG），版本更新时编码子智能体仅根据设计文档重新生成实现，所有人工修改都体现为对设计文档的自然语言编辑，天然实现自文档化。两项核心机制保障重生成过程的可靠性：（1）设计文档采用分步示例的编写风格，可作为生成智能体的上下文演示样本；（2）定义了极简的递归算子中间表示（IR），内置基于SymPy符号库的代价表达式，支持面向大规模参数扫描的快速分析汇总模式，以及面向细粒度调度研究的慢速模调度模式。重生成的实现可复现人工审计的参考模型（包括在TPU集群切片上部署的DeepSeek-V3服务），精度达到舍入误差级别，证明设计文档而非代码可以成为机器学习系统协同设计工具的持久化载体。

title: Design Docs Are All You Need: An AI-native Machine-Learning Performance Tool
authors: Samuel Kushnir, Kimia Noorbakhsh, Kavya Sreedhar, Liqun Cheng, Ming Liu 等 (9 人)
abstract: Machine-learning performance modeling is a uniquely hostile terrain for long-lived software: the assumptions baked into today's abstractions are invalidated by tomorrow's models and systems, forcing perpetual refactoring of performance-modeling frameworks. Meanwhile, AI coding agents have become fast and capable enough that regenerating an entire library is cheaper than paying down the tech debt of incrementally patching it. We describe SMART, a rigorous symbolic performance-modeling library for ML systems whose main branch contains almost no code: the repository is a DAG of self-contained natural-language design docs, coding sub-agents regenerate the implementation from only the docs on new version updates, and every human change is a natural-language edit to a doc--self-documenting by construction. Two ingredients make regeneration reliable: (i) a design-doc style built around step-by-step worked examples that act as in-context demonstrations for the generating agents, and (ii) a minimal, recursively defined operator IR with symbolic (SymPy) cost expressions, a fast analytical roll-up mode for large sweeps, and a slow modulo-scheduling mode for fine-grained schedule studies. Regenerated implementations reproduce hand-audited reference models--including DeepSeek-V3 serving on a TPU pod slice--to round-off precision, suggesting that design docs--not code--can be the durable artifact for ML-systems co-design tools.

title: Who Should Grade My Work? Student Perspectives on Transparent AI-Assisted Writing Assessment in Higher Education
title_zh: 谁应该为我的作业打分？高等教育场景下透明AI辅助写作评估的学生视角
authors: Rayed AlGhamdi
abstract: The integration of GenAI tools into higher education assessment raises important questions about how students understand, interpret, and respond to AI-mediated evaluation. As instructors increasingly explore AI tools for providing feedback, prior research has examined whether GenAI-generated feedback improves writing performance and how students perceive its usefulness; comparatively little is known, however, about how students interpret such evaluation when they are explicitly informed that an AI system, rather than a human instructor, produced the feedback and the score. This study reports findings from a qualitative pedagogical inquiry conducted in an undergraduate technical communication course for computing students at a Saudi public university. Thirteen male undergraduate computing students completed an in-class handwritten writing task; the scanned submissions were evaluated by ChatGPT using a rubric-based prompt aligned with the task objectives. Students were then explicitly informed that ChatGPT had generated the score and feedback and were invited to reflect on the evaluation in writing. Inductive thematic analysis of these reflections identified four themes: perceived usefulness of feedback; awareness of AI's contextual and pedagogical limitations; conditional trust, distinguishing feedback utility from evaluative authority; and reflection on the institutional and pedagogical role of the human instructor. Participants accepted GenAI feedback as useful for surface-level revision but consistently positioned the human instructor as the appropriate authority over grading decisions. The study identifies this as a distinction between feedback utility and evaluative authority, two judgments that students treat as analytically separate rather than as opposite ends of a single approval scale...
