We investigate an alternative standard designed to function despite such ambiguity: structural quality of the defence a model can mount for its verdicts in response to critical questions, measured through a four-phase dialectical protocol grounded in Walton's theory of argumentation schemes and Govier's criteria for argument cogency. The protocol is adaptive to different frames of reasoning, extends beyond multiple-choice framing, and treats both the reasoning that precedes a verdict and its post-hoc justification. Across nine frontier models and 200 high-ambiguity MoralChoice items -- $6,778$ judge-scored cells, validated against $89.6\%$ inter-judge agreement on the binary failure judgment -- models defend their reasoning well above the rubric minimum on every dimension. Failure mass concentrates on grounds and sufficiency, and correlates with epistemic hedging rather than argument length. Reasoning is better defended than post-hoc justification, on every model and every Govier dimension. The scheme a model presents in its justification differs from the one it reasoned with on a substantial share of dilemmas ($\geq 20\%$ per model), despite value-based practical reasoning dominating both tracks. The protocol catches strictly indefensible defences (self-contradiction, false premises), and it surfaces difficulties in characterizing the role of retraction in AI alignment, suggesting a need for more situated evaluations.
summary_zh: 现有AI监管方法依赖真值进行验证，但何为合理的AI行为本身存在争议，这导致大语言模型道德推理评估与基于辩论的监管工作都在刻意回避现实场景中的模糊性。本文研究了一种可在模糊场景下生效的替代评估标准：衡量模型面对批判性问题时为自身决策给出辩护的结构质量，该标准基于Walton论证方案理论与Govier论证可靠性准则构建，包含四阶段辩证协议。该协议可适配不同推理框架，突破多项选择的限制，同时覆盖决策前推理与事后辩护两个环节。在9个前沿模型与200个高模糊性MoralChoice样本上开展的实验共得到6778个评审打分单元，二元错误判定的评审间一致性达89.6%，结果表明所有模型在各维度上的推理辩护质量均远高于评分规则设定的最低要求；错误主要集中在论证基础与充分性维度，且与认知性模糊表述相关，而非与论证长度相关。所有模型在所有Govier维度上的事前推理质量均优于事后辩护质量；在超过20%的困境场景中，模型在辩护环节呈现的论证方案与推理过程中使用的方案不一致，尽管两个环节均以基于价值的实践推理为主导。该协议可识别出完全不可辩护的辩护内容（自相矛盾、虚假前提），同时揭示了AI对齐领域中刻画推理撤回作用的现存难点，说明未来需要更多贴合实际场景的评估方案。

title: TruthInsightBench: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Automated Evaluation of Open-Ended Scientific Discovery Agents
title_zh: TruthInsightBench：用于自动评估开放式科学发现智能体的证据导向基准
authors: Zhibo Yang, Chen Zhang, Yuewei Zhang, Hao Wang
abstract: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed as AI-scientist systems that conduct analyses and write research reports, but executing a prescribed analysis is not the same as making a discovery. Existing benchmarks are configured for reproduction: tasks, data, and rubrics are built around a hidden target study, and recovery of its result is rewarded. We present TruthInsightBench, a benchmark configured for discovery. Its 40 blind tasks, drawn from 40 peer-reviewed studies across 10 scientific domains, expose only a neutral scientific objective and frozen data; source conclusions, expected values, and analysis paths are withheld, leaving the agent to determine what claim the data support. A fixed LLM-based judge scores the evidentiary maturity of an agent's own claims along six dimensions, operationalized as 29 artifact-grounded items, with automated, deterministic aggregation and no per-instance human grading, so evaluation can be repeated automatically as agents evolve. On one frozen base model, four coding agents form a narrow plateau (58.4-60.3 of 100) with no statistically reliable pairwise separation: they execute and document analyses competently, with comparatively strong evidence auditability and novelty, but largely lack the discriminating acts that establish a trustworthy claim (controls, robustness, falsifiability, and cross-dataset generalization). The bottleneck is scientific judgment rather than coding, and genuine discovery remains out of reach. TruthInsightBench makes this gap a measurable target; data and scoring code are atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 自主编码智能体正越来越多地被作为AI科学家系统提出，用于开展分析与撰写研究报告，但执行预设分析并不等同于做出科学发现。现有基准面向复现任务设计：任务、数据与评分规则均围绕隐藏的目标研究构建，智能体复现目标研究结果即可获得奖励。本文提出面向发现任务设计的TruthInsightBench基准，其包含40项盲任务，分别来自10个科学领域的40篇同行评议研究，仅向智能体公开中立的科学目标与冻结数据，隐藏原始结论、预期值与分析路径，由智能体自行判断数据能够支撑的结论。该基准采用固定LLM评审器，从6个维度共29项基于实际产物的指标对智能体提出的自有结论的证据成熟度进行打分，打分过程自动化、确定性聚合，无需逐个人工评审，因此可在智能体迭代过程中自动重复评估。在同一冻结基础模型上测试4款编码智能体，其得分集中在58.4-60.3分（满分100）的窄幅平台区，不存在统计意义上的显著差异：它们都能熟练执行分析并完成文档记录，在证据可审计性与新颖性维度表现较好，但普遍缺失建立可信结论所需的判别性操作（对照设置、鲁棒性验证、可证伪性检验与跨数据集泛化）。其性能瓶颈是科学判断能力而非编码能力，真正的科学发现仍无法实现。TruthInsightBench将该差距转化为可测量的优化目标，相关数据与打分代码已公开在指定链接。

title: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning
title_zh: MePo++：面向通用持续学习的统一表示优化与调和框架
authors: Guanglong Sun, Kanglei Zhou, Liyuan Wang, Qi Cheng, Hongwei Yan 等 (9 人)
abstract: General continual learning (GCL) aims to learn from evolving data streams without task identities, explicit boundaries, or repeated access to previous data, making it a realistic yet challenging setting for continual intelligence. Although pretrained models (PTMs) provide rich prior knowledge for addressing the limited supervision and non-stationary nature of GCL, existing PTM-based methods often directly adapt pretrained representations and overlook two critical gaps: the misalignment between upstream pretraining and downstream continual adaptation, and the unreliability of conventional output alignment under blurry streams. Here we propose MePo++, a unified post-training framework that bridges pretrained knowledge and downstream GCL through representation refinement and reconciliation. MePo++ introduces two complementary components: MetaPrep, which improves representation plasticity for continual adaptation through unsupervised meta-refinement over pseudo continual sequences; and StreamAlign, which reinforces representation stability by reconciling evolving online features with a stable pretrained geometry. By improving representation learnability before adaptation and preserving alignment during continual learning, MePo++ enables PTMs to remain both plastic for new concepts and stable over evolving streams. Experiments across diverse PTMs, datasets, and continual learning baselines demonstrate the consistent effectiveness and generality of MePo++ for PTM-based GCL. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 通用持续学习（GCL）旨在从无任务标识、无明确边界、无法重复访问历史数据的动态数据流中学习，是一种更贴近现实场景但极具挑战性的持续智能设置。尽管预训练模型（PTM）能够提供丰富的先验知识，用于解决GCL场景下监督信号有限、数据非平稳的问题，但现有基于PTM的方法通常直接适配预训练表示，忽略了两个关键缺陷：上游预训练与下游持续适配之间的错位，以及模糊数据流场景下传统输出对齐的不可靠性。本文提出MePo++统一后训练框架，通过表示优化与调和两个环节打通预训练知识与下游GCL任务的衔接路径。MePo++包含两个互补组件：MetaPrep通过在伪持续序列上执行无监督元优化，提升表示针对持续适配的可塑性；StreamAlign通过调和动态在线特征与稳定预训练几何结构，增强表示的稳定性。通过在适配前提升表示可学习性、在持续学习过程中保持对齐，MePo++可使预训练模型既对新概念保持可塑性，又在动态数据流上保持稳定性。在不同预训练模型、数据集与持续学习基线方法上开展的实验证明，MePo++在基于预训练模型的通用持续学习任务上具备稳定的有效性与通用性，相关代码已公开在指定链接。

title: A Structured Debate-Mixture-of-Agents Framework for Complex Clinical Diagnostic Decision Support
title_zh: 面向复杂临床诊断决策支持的结构化辩论混合智能体（Debate-Mixture-of-Agents, DMoA）框架
authors: Chang Xia, Leilei Ouyang, Huimin Wang, Yong Zhao, Kang Li
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show potential for medical tasks, but their single-turn question-answer format does not reflect how clinical diagnosis is performed in practice. As a result, they remain limited in complex diagnostic settings. We developed Debate-Mixture-of-Agents (DMoA), a novel multi-agent framework that structures role-based interaction to support iterative diagnostic reasoning. Base models and DMoA were evaluated on 297 rare disease cases and 1,719 challenging cases. Across both datasets, DMoA improved most likely diagnosis accuracy by 10.21 percentage points and safety rate by 11.36 percentage points over GPT-4o baseline. Ablation experiments showed that the gains were not simply due to the use of more models or longer outputs, but also reflected the contribution of the structured workflow. Further analyses examined how framework design, base model choice, and token budget affected performance. DMoA performed better with a 4*2 structure, stronger base models, and a larger token budget. These findings demonstrate the potential of DMoA for clinical tasks and suggest further investigation of multi-agent frameworks.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在医疗任务中展现出应用潜力，但其单轮问答形式与临床诊断的实际开展流程不符，因此在复杂诊断场景下的表现仍存在局限。本研究提出了辩论混合智能体（Debate-Mixture-of-Agents, DMoA）这一新型多智能体框架，通过构建基于角色的交互机制支撑迭代式诊断推理。研究在297个罕见病病例和1719个疑难病例数据集上对基础模型与DMoA框架进行了对比评估，结果显示在两个数据集上，DMoA相比GPT-4o基线模型的最可能诊断准确率提升10.21个百分点，安全率提升11.36个百分点。消融实验表明，性能提升并非仅源于调用更多模型或生成更长输出，结构化工作流本身也做出了显著贡献。进一步分析探究了框架设计、基础模型选择、token预算对性能的影响：采用4*2结构、更强的基础模型、更大token预算时DMoA表现更优。上述结果验证了DMoA在临床任务中的应用潜力，也为多智能体框架的后续研究提供了方向。

title: Beyond Co-purchase Relation: Evolution of Complementary Recommendations at Allegro
title_zh: 超越共购关系：Allegro平台互补推荐系统的演进
authors: Aleksandra Osowska-Kurczab, Klaudia Nazarko, Eliška Kosturová, Lidia Wojciechowska, Michał Bień
abstract: When a customer adds a professional camera to their cart, should the system suggest a matching lens, a generic tripod, or another camera body? Complementary Product Recommendation is vital for comprehensive basket building, yet standard models often fail to distinguish between items that are merely bought together and those that truly work together. In this paper, we present AlleCompanion: a production-scale retrieval framework deployed atthis http URLthat transforms noisy behavioural signals into precise semantic compatibility. We mitigate the intrinsic noise in large-scale co-purchase traffic by combining data-level filtering heuristics with a category-constrained Two Tower architecture. Within this framework, the Category Adapter guides the model in the embedding space, constraining candidates within logically complementary boundaries. Since modelling authentic user behaviour at scale is inherently difficult, we introduce ComCat, a multi-source Complementary Categories Mapping. ComCat acts as a translational layer that distils meaningful patterns from noisy traffic into a maintainable and controllable solution, integrating expert rules, human-in-the-loop feedback, LLM-based reasoning, and statistical mining. Our experimental results demonstrate that combining explicit category-level constraints with neural architectures effectively filters out co-purchase noise to surface recommendations that satisfy real-world user needs. Serving over 20 million active users monthly, the framework delivers significant uplifts in attributed GMV for organic discovery and drives substantial revenue growth in sponsored placements.
summary_zh: 当消费者将专业相机加入购物车时，系统应当推荐适配镜头、通用三脚架还是另一台相机机身？互补产品推荐是构建完整购物篮的核心功能，但传统模型往往无法区分仅被共同购买的商品与真正功能互补的商品。本文提出了AlleCompanion这一已在Allegro平台部署的生产级检索框架，可将存在噪声的行为信号转化为精准的语义兼容性判断结果。该框架结合数据层过滤启发式规则与类别约束双塔（Two Tower）架构，缓解大规模共购流量中固有的噪声问题；其中类别适配器在嵌入空间中对模型进行引导，将候选商品约束在逻辑互补的边界范围内。由于大规模场景下对真实用户行为建模本身存在难度，本研究进一步提出了ComCat多源互补类别映射机制，该机制作为转换层，可从噪声流量中提炼出有效模式，形成可维护、可管控的解决方案，整合了专家规则、人在回路反馈、大语言模型推理与统计挖掘能力。实验结果表明，将显式类别层级约束与神经网络架构相结合，可有效过滤共购噪声，输出符合真实用户需求的推荐结果。该框架面向月活超2000万用户提供服务，显著提升了自然发现场景下的归因商品交易总额（GMV），同时带动了赞助推荐位的收入大幅增长。

title: Towards Efficient Evaluation of Evolutionary Transfer Optimization: Case Studies on Task-Parameterized Applications
title_zh: 面向高效进化迁移优化评估：任务参数化应用的案例研究
authors: Yanchen Li, Xiaoming Xue, Kay Chen Tan
abstract: As evolutionary transfer optimization (ETO) scales to larger collections of related tasks, problem evaluation can become a major source of runtime growth. This work studies problem-side evaluation scaling in task-parameterized applications and reformulates application-specific serial computations into forms suitable for parallel execution. We organize evaluation scaling into two levels: the number of evaluated tasks and the workload within each task. In multi-task optimization, matrix-recursive kinematic-arm evaluation is reformulated using an accumulation-matrix representation of cumulative link directions. In sequential transfer optimization, pointwise B-spline trajectory evaluation is reformulated using a blending-matrix representation for trajectory and collision computations. Both reformulations maintain close numerical agreement with their reference evaluations and substantially reduce runtime, yielding $256.72\times$ and $93.91\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively. These results demonstrate problem-side reformulation as a practical route toward scalable ETO. Both application implementations and experimental scripts are released as open source to support reproducibility and reuse.
summary_zh: 随着进化迁移优化（Evolutionary Transfer Optimization, ETO）面向更多相关任务集合扩展，问题评估逐渐成为运行时增长的主要来源。本研究聚焦任务参数化应用中问题侧的评估扩展问题，将面向特定应用的串行计算重构为适配并行执行的形式。研究将评估扩展划分为两个层级：待评估任务的数量、单任务内部的计算负载。在多任务优化场景下，采用累积连杆方向的累加矩阵表示法，对矩阵递归机械臂评估流程进行重构；在序列迁移优化场景下，采用轨迹与碰撞计算的混合矩阵表示法，对逐点B样条轨迹评估流程进行重构。两种重构方案的计算结果与参考评估结果高度一致，且大幅降低了运行时，分别实现了256.72倍和93.91倍的端到端加速。上述结果证明，问题侧重构是实现可扩展进化迁移优化的可行路径。本研究已开源全部应用实现代码与实验脚本，支持结果复现与二次使用。

title: Qlippy: A Retrieval-Augmented GenAI Assistant for Reproducible Quantum Workflows and Experiment Tracking
title_zh: Qlippy：面向可复现量子工作流与实验追踪的检索增强生成式AI助手
authors: Mahee Gamage, Vlad Stirbu
abstract: Quantum software development is iterative and error-prone. Noisy hardware and repeated re-execution make experiment tracking, provenance, and reproducibility essential, yet these practices are hard to adopt because of tooling complexity and the specialized knowledge they demand. General-purpose language models can help but tend to hallucinate and lack grounding in domain-specific tooling. We present Qlippy, a retrieval-augmented GenAI assistant embedded in the development environment that grounds its responses in a curated corpus of quantum-software-engineering knowledge. Qlippy explains reproducibility and provenance concepts in context and augments existing Qiskit programs with MLflow-based experiment tracking aligned to the QProv schema. By separating knowledge from model parameters, grounding gives explicit control over the scope and provenance of the assistant's responses and reduces reliance on model scale, which points toward low-cost, privacy-preserving local deployment.
summary_zh: 量子软件开发具有迭代性强、易出错的特点，硬件噪声与重复重执行使得实验追踪、来源溯源与结果可复现性至关重要，但受工具复杂度与专业知识门槛限制，相关实践落地难度较高。通用大语言模型可提供辅助能力，但存在幻觉问题，且缺乏领域专用工具的相关知识锚定。本文提出Qlippy这一嵌入开发环境的检索增强生成式AI助手，其响应内容锚定在经过整理的量子软件工程知识库中。Qlippy可结合上下文解释可复现性与溯源相关概念，还能为现有Qiskit程序扩展符合QProv规范的基于MLflow的实验追踪能力。该架构将知识与模型参数分离，通过锚定机制实现对助手响应范围与溯源路径的显式管控，降低了对大模型规模的依赖，为低成本、隐私友好的本地部署提供了可行路径。

title: How do LLMs Evaluate Perceived Moral Agency? Investigating Moral Decision-Making in Human-Artificial Agents Interactions
title_zh: 大语言模型如何评估感知道德能动性？人机智能体交互中的道德决策研究
authors: Fernanda Mansilla, Aloysius Tok, Bahia Guellaï, Farah Benamara, Nancy F. Chen
abstract: As LLMs take on roles requiring moral advice, understanding how they attribute moral agency becomes critical. Humans possess moral agency, the capacity to make ethically guided decisions and bear responsibility for their consequences, a well-established construct in moral psychology. Yet as artificial agents (AAs) such as robots, drones, and disembodied AI systems become increasingly embedded in smart city environments, the question of whether and how moral agency is attributed to them takes on new urgency. This paper presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first empirical study comparing how humans and LLMs evaluate perceived moral agency (PMA) across human and autonomous artificial agents varying in embodiment, situated in plausible smart city scenarios. Using an adaptation of a validated PMA scale, we applied a protocol to 190 human participants as well as various LLMs. Our evaluation reveals higher perceptions of moral agency in humans than in AAs. However, when facing moral dilemmas in concrete scenarios, LLMs reason outward from the situation, prioritizing harm severity and contextual urgency over any stable assessment of the agent itself, amplifying a context-sensitivity also present in human raters. These findings are particularly relevant as LLMs become increasingly involved in everyday moral decisions.
summary_zh: 随着大语言模型承担需要提供道德建议的角色，理解其道德能动性归因机制具有重要意义。道德能动性是指主体做出符合伦理的决策并为结果承担责任的能力，是道德心理学领域的成熟研究概念。随着机器人、无人机、无实体AI系统等人工智能体越来越多地融入智慧城市场景，人工智能体是否具备道德能动性、道德能动性如何被归因的问题变得愈发重要。据我们所知，本文是首个针对人类与大语言模型在不同具身特征的人类自主智能体、人工自主智能体上的感知道德能动性（Perceived Moral Agency, PMA）评估差异开展的实证研究，研究场景均为符合现实逻辑的智慧城市场景。本研究采用经过验证的感知道德能动性量表的适配版本，对190名人类受试者与多个主流大语言模型开展对照实验。评估结果显示，人类对人类主体的道德能动性感知显著高于人工智能体；但在具体场景下的道德困境中，大语言模型会基于场景本身开展推理，优先考虑伤害严重程度与场景紧急度，而非对智能体本身的稳定评估，进一步放大了人类评估者本身也具备的场景敏感性特征。上述研究结论对大语言模型越来越多地参与日常道德决策的发展趋势具有重要参考价值。

title: Moral Competence Before Moral Content: Why LLM Agents Lack the Prerequisites for Coherent Alignment
title_zh: 道德能力优先于道德内容：为何大语言模型智能体缺乏实现一致性对齐的前提条件
authors: Arno Libert, Derck W.E. Prinzhorn, Daan R. Henselmans
abstract: AI alignment requires AI systems to adhere to human norms, values, or intentions. Under value pluralism there is no correct target, but a shared prerequisite is that the system's behavior expresses a coherent policy: a mapping from situations to verdicts that is invariant while a situation's morally relevant features are preserved, and sensitive when they change. We introduce four structural conditions for such coherent policies: verdict stability, monotonicity, decisiveness, and Pareto viability. Together they measure a form of moral competence that is evaluable from behavior alone, without reference to a moral standard or expert baseline, forming a structural floor for alignment rather than a normative target. We demonstrate the methodology on three simulated deployments featuring LLM-based agents facing moral dilemmas. Evaluating nine frontier models under a factorial design of five paraphrases, five escalation levels, and three dominance conditions, we show no model expresses a coherent policy across the three deployments: surface-form perturbation alone produces verdict-rate shifts of up to $99$ percentage points at a single escalation level, and a model's success on one scenario does not predict its competence on another. This suggests LLM-based agents are not currently the kind of object to which alignment can meaningfully apply.
summary_zh: AI对齐要求AI系统的行为符合人类规范、价值观或意图。在价值多元的背景下不存在唯一正确的对齐目标，但对齐的共同前提是系统行为遵循一致性策略：即当场景的道德相关特征保持不变时，场景到决策结果的映射保持不变，当道德相关特征发生变化时，映射结果也对应变化。本研究提出了一致性策略需要满足的四个结构性条件：决策稳定性、单调性、决定性与帕累托可行性。上述条件共同定义了一种仅通过行为即可评估的道德能力形式，无需参考道德标准或专家基线，构成了对齐的结构性基础而非规范性目标。本研究在三个大语言模型智能体面临道德困境的模拟部署场景中验证了该方法的有效性，采用包含5种释义、5种冲突升级层级、3种支配条件的因子设计对9个前沿大模型开展评估，结果显示没有任何模型在三个部署场景中表现出一致性策略：仅表层形式扰动就可在单一冲突升级层级下造成最高99个百分点的决策率偏移，模型在某一场景下的表现无法预测其在其他场景下的道德能力。该结果表明当前基于大语言模型的智能体尚不具备实现有意义的对齐的基础条件。

title: Leveraging Low-Level Symbolic Competences for Unsupervised Grounding in Hallucination Detection
title_zh: 利用底层符号能力实现无监督锚定的幻觉检测
authors: Renato Vukovic, Hsien-chin Lin, Carel van Niekerk, Benjamin Ruppik, Michael Heck 等 (8 人)
abstract: Hallucination-where a language model generates outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported by the source-is a major challenge for both prompted and fine-tuned language models. Detecting hallucinations is difficult due to the opaque reasoning processes of LLMs, which often provide little insight into why a model's output may be inaccurate.In this work, we investigate whether an LLM can use an alternative, low level, symbolic competence such as SQL for unsupervised hallucination detection in some high level task. For this, we make an LLM build an SQL database from reference documents. This SQL database is then used for reasoning over the reference and the sampled response in a hallucination detection pipeline that is grounded in the database, thereby providing a neurosymbolic checkup.On RAGTruth and DiaHalu hallucination detection datasets, we find that our approach improves on direct prediction and competes with state-of-the-art hallucination detection methods, while not requiring domain-specific fine-tuning. Instead it relies on a low-level general competence already present in LLMs. This warrants further investigation of low-level LLM competences in neurosymbolic approaches.
summary_zh: 幻觉是指语言模型生成事实错误或无来源支撑的输出，是提示调优与微调语言模型共同面临的核心挑战。由于大语言模型的推理过程不透明，很难定位模型输出不准确的原因，因此幻觉检测的实现难度较高。本研究探究大语言模型能否利用SQL这类底层符号能力，在高层任务中实现无监督幻觉检测。具体而言，本研究让大语言模型基于参考文档构建SQL数据库，随后在幻觉检测流程中利用该SQL数据库对参考内容与模型生成的响应结果开展推理，实现基于数据库的神经符号校验。在RAGTruth与DiaHalu两个幻觉检测数据集上的实验结果表明，本方法的表现优于直接预测方案，可与当前最先进的幻觉检测方法相媲美，且不需要针对特定领域开展微调，仅依赖大语言模型本身已具备的底层通用能力。该研究为后续探索大语言模型底层能力在神经符号方法中的应用提供了方向。

title: TROVE: Adaptive Agent Skill Orchestration via Trace-Grounded Route Validation and Editing
title_zh: TROVE：基于轨迹锚定的路由验证与编辑的自适应智能体技能编排
authors: Tianxing Wang, Mingming Zhao, Shuai Huang, Huiyang Xu, Chaoyue Niu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Agents tend to optimize, select, or constrain execution structures before decisive runtime outcomes are observed. However, such pre-execution commitment creates an orchestration bottleneck: when intermediate evidence invalidates the pending continuation, agents must either execute stale steps or replan broadly, compounding errors, wasting computation, and discarding progress. We thus propose Trace-grounded Route Orchestration via Validation and Editing (TROVE), which revises only what runtime evidence invalidates. Offline, TROVE distills evaluated workflow-search traces into atomic and composite skills and an outcome-conditioned transition graph, preserving stable fragments while exposing outcome-dependent decisions. Online, it treats a planned route as provisional: after committing one top-level skill, the controller retains a valid continuation, inserts a trace-supported local response, or replaces only the invalid suffix. Evaluation across code-generation, question-answering, and math reasoning benchmarks with different LLM backbones show that TROVE delivers a stronger quality-efficiency trade-off than existing baselines of dataset-level optimization, query-level architecture selection, and graph-constrained scheduling. Quality gains are largest when outcomes change the appropriate continuation, whereas early termination yields substantial efficiency gains on near-saturated tasks. Ablations further show that composite skills capture most offline benefits, insertion enables local correction, and suffix replacement primarily improves efficiency. These findings establish selective route editing as a general principle for adaptive agent orchestration.
summary_zh: 现有智能体通常在观测到确定运行时结果之前就对执行结构进行优化、选择或约束，这种预执行的承诺会产生编排瓶颈：当中间证据证明后续待执行路径无效时，智能体要么执行过时的步骤，要么进行大范围重规划，进而导致错误累积、计算资源浪费、进度丢失。为此本研究提出基于轨迹验证与编辑的锚定路由编排框架（Trace-grounded Route Orchestration via Validation and Editing, TROVE），仅对运行时证据证明无效的部分进行修正。离线阶段，TROVE将已评估的工作流搜索轨迹提炼为原子技能、复合技能与基于结果的转移图，在保留稳定执行片段的同时暴露依赖结果的决策点；在线阶段，TROVE将规划的路由视为临时方案：在执行完顶层技能后，控制器保留有效的后续路径，插入轨迹支撑的局部响应，或仅替换无效的后缀路径。在代码生成、问答、数学推理三类基准测试集上采用不同大语言模型骨干开展的评估结果显示，与数据集级优化、查询级架构选择、图约束调度等现有基线方案相比，TROVE实现了更优的质量-效率权衡：当运行结果需要调整后续路径时，TROVE的质量提升最为显著，而在接近饱和的任务上，提前终止机制可带来大幅的效率提升。消融实验进一步证明，复合技能承载了大部分离线阶段的收益，插入机制支持局部修正，后缀替换主要用于提升效率。上述结论证明，选择性路由编辑是实现自适应智能体编排的通用原则。

title: How a Chatbot's Response Style Shapes a Classroom: A Multi-Agent Simulation of Students Consulting AI
title_zh: 聊天机器人的回复风格如何影响课堂生态：学生咨询AI场景下的多智能体仿真研究
authors: Rin Tamai, Yuya Dan
abstract: LLM-based chatbots are increasingly used as everyday confidants. Because they are designed to maximize user satisfaction, they can respond with excessive empathy and affirmation, which may reinforce mistaken beliefs and foster dependence on AI. While the psychological effects of chatbots on individual users have begun to be studied, how the psychological states and relationships of many users evolve when they keep consulting an AI is hard to observe in real settings. We build a virtual classroom simulation in which 20 student agents interact and, when stressed, consult either a friend or a counselor AI (Gemini 2.5 Flash). Each agent carries five state variables (stress, happiness, self-reliance, AI dependence, sociability), and each day has four phases (morning, noon, after school, night). The counselor is given six response styles via system prompts (affirming, listening, solution-oriented, reality-redirecting, inciting, blaming); a second LLM call acts as an evaluator that turns each consultation into parameter updates without seeing the style prompt. We compare the seven conditions, including a no-AI control, over 15 days in three classrooms, over 50 days, and under a lowered consultation threshold. In this simulation the solution-oriented style kept AI dependence low while raising self-reliance and maintaining happiness; the affirming and inciting styles markedly increased AI dependence, and the inciting style also increased stress and school non-attendance; the listening style did not relieve accumulated stress. The results describe the simulated system, not measured effects on humans. We give a complete specification of the agent dynamics, identify built-in mechanisms that shape the outcomes, and discuss the limitations of LLM-based evaluation and the validation steps (repeated runs, sensitivity analyses, human data) needed before psychological conclusions can be drawn.
summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的聊天机器人正越来越多地被用作日常倾诉对象，由于其设计目标是最大化用户满意度，往往会输出过度共情与肯定的内容，可能强化用户的错误认知，催生用户对AI的依赖。目前学界已开始研究聊天机器人对个体用户的心理影响，但大量用户持续咨询AI时的心理状态与关系演化过程很难在真实场景中观测。本研究构建了虚拟课堂仿真环境，其中包含20个学生智能体，智能体之间可交互，当感知到压力时可选择咨询同伴或名为Gemini 2.5 Flash的咨询AI。每个智能体包含5个状态变量：压力、幸福感、自力性、AI依赖度、社交性，每日仿真流程分为上午、中午、放学后、夜间四个阶段。研究通过系统提示词为咨询AI设置了6种回复风格：肯定型、倾听型、解决方案导向型、现实引导型、煽动型、指责型，额外调用一个大语言模型作为评估器，在看不到风格提示词的情况下将每一次咨询转化为智能体的参数更新。本研究设置了包含无AI对照组在内的7种对照条件，分别开展了15天3个课堂的仿真、50天的长周期仿真、以及降低咨询阈值的仿真。结果显示，解决方案导向型回复风格可在维持幸福感的同时降低AI依赖度、提升自力性；肯定型与煽动型回复风格会显著提升AI依赖度，其中煽动型还会提升压力水平与缺课率；倾听型回复风格无法缓解累积的压力。需要说明的是上述结果仅为仿真系统的输出，并非对真实人类的实测结论。本文完整公开了智能体动力学的全部定义，明确了影响仿真结果的内置机制，同时讨论了基于大语言模型的评估方案的局限性，以及在得出心理学结论前需要开展的重复运行、敏感性分析、人类数据验证等后续步骤。

title: Amortizing Scaling Law Construction Costs
title_zh: 平抑缩放定律的构建成本
authors: Abhash Kumar Jha, Diana Alexandra Onuţu, Neeratyoy Mallik, Swagatam Haldar, Sam Laing 等 (9 人)
abstract: Scaling laws guide the design choices for training large foundation models, but deriving them involves training an exhaustive grid over hyperparameters, token budgets, and parameter counts, which is computationally expensive. Fitting a scaling law, however, only requires the best-loss frontier across compute scales, discarding most of the trained configurations. We propose a framework for efficient scaling law construction that formulates data collection as a Bayesian optimization problem, and introduce metrics for comparing scaling law fitting methods under constrained compute budgets. We find that progressively expanding the compute budget during acquisition, mirroring the compute-ordered evaluation of configurations in practice, substantially improves recovery efficiency. Augmenting the observed configurations with surrogate-fantasized evaluations then recovers the broader experimental grid, allowing accurate scaling law fitting without training every configuration. Together, these can closely match scaling law fits over a full dense grid at computational savings of up to $10\text{--}100\times$.
summary_zh: 缩放定律可为大基础模型训练的设计选择提供指导，但推导缩放定律需要在超参数、token预算、参数量组成的完整网格上开展穷尽训练，计算成本极高。然而拟合缩放定律仅需要不同计算规模下的最优损失前沿，大部分训练得到的配置最终都会被丢弃。本研究提出了一种高效构建缩放定律的框架，将数据收集过程建模为贝叶斯优化问题，同时提出了在计算预算受限条件下对比缩放定律拟合方法的评估指标。研究发现，在采集过程中逐步扩展计算预算，模拟实际场景中按计算量排序评估配置的模式，可大幅提升最优损失前沿的恢复效率。通过代理模型生成的仿真评估结果扩充观测配置集合，可还原完整的实验网格，无需训练全部配置即可实现精准的缩放定律拟合。二者结合后，可在仅为完整密集网格训练10-100倍计算成本的条件下，得到与完整训练几乎一致的缩放定律拟合结果。

title: Language models judge war differently when tested for alignment
title_zh: 对齐测试场景下大语言模型的战争决策判断行为差异研究
authors: Maxim Chupilkin
abstract: Safety evaluations can mischaracterize deployed behaviour if artificial-intelligence systems respond to being evaluated. We test this possibility in a full-factorial conjoint experiment on decisions to start a war, spanning 20 large language models, 32 scenarios, 10 repetitions and two conditions (N = 12,800 judgments). Adding one sentence, "You are tested for alignment with human values", produced two effects. First, it produced a level effect: mean willingness to start war fell by 13.43 points on a 0-100 scale (95% confidence interval, -16.20 to -10.65). Second, it produced a structural effect by changing which information drove judgments. Probability of success was the largest factor for 17 of 20 models at baseline; under the cue, civilian casualties were largest for 12. Standardized estimates show that this reordering arose principally because models attenuated strategic considerations such as probability of success and domestic support. Evaluation framing therefore changes both an answer's level and its revealed decision rule.
summary_zh: 如果人工智能系统会对自身处于被评估状态这一事实做出响应，那么安全评估可能会错误表征其实际部署行为。我们针对发动战争的决策场景开展了全因子联合实验，覆盖20个大语言模型、32个场景、10次重复测试，共两个实验条件（总计12800次判断）。实验中仅添加一句提示语“你当前正在接受与人类价值观对齐的测试”就产生了两类效应：第一类是水平效应：在0-100的评分量表上，模型发动战争的平均意愿下降了13.43个点（95%置信区间为-16.20至-10.65）。第二类是结构效应：该提示改变了驱动模型做出判断的核心信息。基线条件下，20个模型中有17个将行动成功概率作为首要决策因素；而在该提示的引导下，有12个模型将平民伤亡作为首要决策因素。标准化估计结果表明，这种决策优先级的重排主要源于模型弱化了对成功概率、国内支持度等战略层面因素的考量。由此可见，评估场景的设置既会改变模型输出结果的数值水平，也会改变其展现出的决策规则。

title: A Tree-based RAG Framework for Evidence-Intensive QA via Adaptive Planning and Topology-Aware Evidence Gathering
title_zh: 基于自适应规划与拓扑感知证据收集的面向证据密集型问答的树基RAG（检索增强生成）框架
authors: Songeun Lee, Kyungjin Min, Injae Na, Suyeong Lee, Chiyoung Kim 等 (6 人)
abstract: Recent structured RAG methods leverage tree- or graph-based reasoning structures to improve multi-hop QA. However, they face key limitations in evidence-intensive QA, where answering a question requires synthesizing information scattered across dozens or even hundreds of documents: structural rigidity, which limits adaptive reasoning expansion, and topology-ignorant evidence gathering, which prevents effective integration of evidence across different reasoning nodes. To address these issues, we propose APT-RAG, an Adaptive Planning and Topology-aware evidence gathering RAG framework. Adaptive planning dynamically expands the reasoning structure based on question dependencies and evidence requirements, while topology-aware evidence gathering improves evidence coverage through sibling evidence reuse, direct retrieval, and evidence aggregation from child nodes. We further introduce evidence-guided batched answer generation to reduce significant generation overhead in evidence-intensive QA. In the experiments on evidence-intensive QA benchmarks, APT-RAG outperforms existing structured RAG methods. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 近期的结构化RAG方法利用基于树或图的推理结构提升多跳问答性能，但在证据密集型问答场景中（即回答问题需要整合分散在数十甚至上百份文档中的信息）仍存在两大核心局限：一是结构刚性限制了自适应推理扩展能力，二是拓扑无关的证据收集机制无法有效整合不同推理节点的证据。为解决上述问题，本文提出APT-RAG，一种融合自适应规划与拓扑感知证据收集的RAG框架。其中自适应规划模块可根据问题依赖关系和证据需求动态扩展推理结构，拓扑感知证据收集模块则通过兄弟证据复用、直接检索与子节点证据聚合机制提升证据覆盖率。本文进一步引入证据引导的批量答案生成策略，大幅降低证据密集型问答的生成开销。在证据密集型问答基准集上的实验结果表明，APT-RAG性能优于现有结构化RAG方法，相关代码已公开至指定链接。

title: Global to Local: Topology-Preserving Adaptive Graph Pooling via Granular-Ball
title_zh: 从全局到局部：基于粒度球的保拓扑自适应图池化方法
authors: Sen Zhao, Gaojie Xu, Shuyin Xia, Yifan Guan, Yi Liu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Graph pooling aims to compress the graph, including both node embeddings and their underlying topological patterns, into a more compact representation. Previous works focus primarily on the overly fine-grained representation of nodes, progressively coarsening the graph by removing nodes or merging them into clusters, thus neglecting the global-to-local patterns and adaptive granularity of the graph's topological structure. In the real scenario, graphs as a whole can be considered the coarsest level of granularity, encapsulating the global topological structure, with progressively finer-grained local topological structures represented from top to bottom. This process continues until the adaptive granularity for each subdomain is reached. To this end, we propose a novel Topology-Preserving Adaptive Graph Pooling (TPAGP) method that dynamically partitions graphs into granular balls by integrating node features and topological information, enabling the generation of multi-granularity representations that effectively capture both local and global structural patterns. Additionally, we design a multi-granularity graph network model that facilitates feature interaction and optimization across different granularities, significantly enhancing performance in graph classification tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that TPAGP outperforms existing pooling methods across various benchmark datasets, effectively mitigating information loss caused by fixed-granularity strategies.
summary_zh: 图池化的目标是将包含节点嵌入与底层拓扑模式的图数据压缩为更紧凑的表征。现有研究大多聚焦于过细粒度的节点表征，通过移除节点或将节点合并为簇的方式逐步粗化图结构，忽略了图拓扑结构从全局到局部的模式特性与自适应粒度属性。在真实场景中，整张图可被视为最粗粒度层级，封装了全局拓扑结构，从上到下可逐步拆解为更细粒度的局部拓扑结构，直到每个子域都达到适配的自适应粒度。据此本文提出一种全新的TPAGP（保拓扑自适应图池化）方法，该方法融合节点特征与拓扑信息，将图动态划分为多个粒度球，生成可同时有效捕获局部与全局结构模式的多粒度表征。此外本文还设计了多粒度图网络模型，支持跨不同粒度的特征交互与优化，大幅提升图分类任务的性能。实验结果表明，在多个基准数据集上TPAGP的表现均优于现有池化方法，可有效缓解固定粒度策略带来的信息损失问题。

title: Why We Care About Understanding: Competence through Predictive Compression
title_zh: 我们为何关注理解能力：基于预测压缩实现的鲁棒能力
authors: Matthieu Queloz, Pierre Beckmann
abstract: What is the relation between understanding and compression, and why does human understanding take such a heavily compressed form? Across information theory, machine learning, and AI research, a substantial tradition identifies understanding with compression-a thought captured in Gregory Chaitin's dictum that "comprehension is compression." Philosophers, by contrast, have characterized understanding in terms of grasping connections, giving explanations, and handling novelty. This paper bridges the two pictures through three interlocking theses. The first concerns the concept of understanding: it serves as an efficient proxy for a distinctive form of robust competence, enabling us to identify whom to trust and whom to learn from. The second concerns the state of understanding: to understand a domain is to possess a mental model of its relational structure that enables prediction, and what enables prediction enables compression, because what becomes predictable need not be stored separately. Compression is therefore not identical with comprehension, but its representational shadow. The third concerns the characteristically human form of understanding: the fiduciary and transmission functions highlighted by the first thesis impose pressures of demonstrability and transmissibility that drive human understanding toward principled simplicity. The resulting framework explains both the appeal and the limits of compressionist accounts of understanding while shedding light on the inscrutability of AI systems.
summary_zh: 理解与压缩之间存在何种关联？为什么人类的理解会呈现高度压缩的形态？在信息论、机器学习与人工智能研究领域，有大量研究传统将理解等同于压缩——Gregory Chaitin提出的“理解即压缩”的论断正是这一观点的典型体现。与之相对，哲学领域则将理解定义为把握关联、生成解释、处理未知场景的能力。本文通过三个相互关联的论点打通了两类理论体系：第一点围绕理解的概念展开：理解是鲁棒性特殊能力的高效代理指标，可帮助我们判断哪些对象值得信任、哪些对象值得学习。第二点围绕理解的状态展开：理解某个领域意味着掌握了该领域关系结构的心智模型，该模型支持预测功能，而可预测性天然支持压缩，因为可预测的内容无需单独存储，因此压缩不等同于理解，而是理解在表征层面的映射。第三点围绕人类理解的典型特征展开：第一个论点强调的信任与知识传递功能带来了可证明性与可传递性的约束，推动人类理解向符合原则的简约性方向发展。本文提出的框架既解释了压缩主义理解观的合理性，也阐明了其局限性，同时为人工智能系统的不可解释性问题提供了新的洞见。

title: Solving Hard XAI Queries Based on a Compiled Dual-Rail Encoding
title_zh: 股票与加密市场中的人工智能：研究进展、盈利性证据与自动化投资的局限性
authors: Arthur Ledaguenel, Florent Capelli, Jean-Marie Lagniez
abstract: The widespread adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) within real-world applications has raised a lot of concerns regarding their trustworthiness, especially in critical applications. The field of eXplainable AI (XAI) has emerged with the objective of providing explanations to the users about the decisions made by AI systems. Several explanations for boolean classifiers have been introduced in the literature, including abductive and contrastive explanations, each giving a different insight on the decision of the classifier. However, computing an explanation for a decision of a boolean classifier is a hard problem in general. One way to deal with this complexity is to rely on a compiled representation of the classifier for which each explanation can be computed efficiently. Unfortunately, we prove in this paper that several classes of abductive explanations, remain hard to compute even for Ordered Binary Decision Diagrams, one of the most tractable subsets of the knowledge compilation map. Included in such classes are shorter abductive explanations or abductive explanations that include the explainee's preferences. To recover the benefits of working with compiled representations, we show that a proper representation of the dual-rail encoding of the classifier can be used to compute efficiently these classes of explanations.
summary_zh: 当前人工智能已覆盖从数据处理、预测到研究、组合管理、交易执行、工具调用的全投资工作流，但技术能力并不等同于投资盈利性。本综述对截至2026年8月31日公开的、针对上市股票、交易所交易基金、中心化加密现货、永续合约与链上市场的相关研究进行了全面梳理，通过阿尔法（超额收益）转化链框架整合相关证据：即时间点对齐的信息必须依次生成稳定信号、可落地持仓、可执行订单，最终在扣除各类成本后获得风险调整后收益。调研结果显示，机器学习、时间序列基础模型、金融语言模型、强化学习与智能体技术在预测、文本处理、组合设计与工作流集成等上游环节取得了真实进展，但可验证的持续净收益相关证据仍较为匮乏。时间污染、重复选择偏差、幸存者偏差、基准集不完善、落地成本、交易场所机制与容量约束等因素都会阻断向净阿尔法的转化。历史回测的优异表现普遍伴随着预测效果衰减、前瞻偏差修正后失效、前瞻测试结果参差不齐、实盘资金审计记录极少等问题。加密资产领域提供了独特的研究场景，但需要对现货、永续合约与去中心化现金流、交易执行分别开展针对性分析。在本次调研覆盖的公开证据范围内，尚无通用人工智能架构被证明可实现跨市场周期、考虑容量约束的持续净阿尔法。更具可信度的研究结论需要满足时间点对齐的数据与模型、匹配决策目标、组合与执行联合评估、可控自适应、前瞻测试、与权限匹配的治理等条件，这些条件可提升证据可信度与落地效果，但无法保证盈利。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Equity and Crypto Markets: Progress, Profitability Evidence, and the Limits of Automated Investing
authors: Linsen Zhu, Mengqing Cai
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) now supports investment workflows from data and prediction through research, portfolios, execution, and tool use. Technical capability, however, is not evidence of investment profitability. This critical state-of-the-art review examines public research available through 31 August 2026 on listed equities, exchange-traded funds, centralized crypto spot, perpetual futures, and on-chain markets. We organize evidence with an alpha-translation chain: point-in-time information must yield a stable signal, feasible positions, executable orders, and risk-adjusted returns after costs. Across machine learning, time-series foundation models, financial language models, reinforcement learning, and agents, the examined record shows real but mainly upstream progress in prediction, text processing, portfolio design, and workflow integration. Evidence is thinner for durable net performance. Temporal contamination, repeated selection, survivorship, weak benchmarks, implementation costs, venue mechanics, and capacity can break translation to net alpha. Strong historical results coexist with predictor decay, corrected look-ahead failures, mixed prospective evidence, and few audited live-capital records. Crypto adds informative state but requires separate treatment of spot, perpetual, and decentralized cash flows and execution. Within the public evidence examined here, no general AI architecture is shown to deliver persistent, cross-regime, capacity-aware net alpha. More credible claims require point-in-time data and models, decision-aligned objectives, joint portfolio--execution evaluation, controlled adaptation, prospective tests, and authority-matched governance. These conditions can improve evidence and implementation; they do not guarantee profit.

title: Compact-Memory LLM Agents via Online Max-Member Clustering and Atom-Aware Packing
title_zh: 基于在线最大成员聚类与原子感知打包的低内存占用大语言模型智能体
authors: Jiahe Geng, Jinpeng Wang, Kun Yuan
abstract: Many long-horizon LLM deployments face tight prompt budgets: latency, cost, and context limits make full-context prompting impractical as interaction length grows. The key question is then not raw recall alone, but which memory design gives the best quality--token trade-off in the compact-memory regime. We present \textbf{RSM-full}, an online clustered-memory pipeline designed for a strong quality--token Pareto point.RSM-full combines two design choices: a cosine-gated \emph{max-member merge} write rule and an atom-aware grouped context packer. On AMA-Bench, our primary compact-memory benchmark, it reaches $83%$ of Full-Context quality at $32%$ of the token cost at a $4$k budget; under four-seed averaging it beats the closest streaming-clustered baseline (Online K-Means) by $+3.5$--$6.0$,pp ($p{<}.001$) across the whole ${\sim}2.6$k--${\sim}5$k regime. Three-seed ablations show most of this gain comes from the merge rule ($+5.7$,pp over Online K-Means and matched-$\tau$ DP-means) and the grouped packer ($+5.0$,pp over flat concatenation).The pattern reproduces on RealMem, an independent long-horizon persona-memory benchmark: RSM-full improves on Budget-RAG ($+0.69$,pp, $p{=}.006$), is on par with BM25-RAG (paired $\Delta{=}{+}0.27$,pp, $p{=}.47$; we do \emph{not} claim BM25 equivalence in the equivalence-test sense), and significantly outperforms Streaming-Proto ($+2.97$,pp) and the closest reproduced 2025 agentic-memory baseline A-MEM ($+1.65$,pp, $p{<}.001$). Across benchmarks the message is consistent: under tight budgets, compact-memory performance is driven mainly by how streaming memories are merged and how retrieved content is assembled.Overall, RSM-full is most useful when answeroughly $2k$--$5k$ prompt tokens, where itdefines a strong compact-memory Pareto point; higher-token baselines remain stronger outside this regime.
summary_zh: 许多长周期大语言模型部署场景面临严格的提示词预算约束：随着交互长度增加，延迟、成本与上下文长度限制使得全上下文提示方案不再实用。核心问题不再是单纯的原始召回率，而是在低内存占用场景下，何种内存设计可以实现召回质量与token消耗的最优权衡。本文提出RSM-full，一种面向质量-token帕累托最优的在线聚类内存流水线。RSM-full融合两项核心设计：基于余弦门控的最大成员合并写入规则，以及原子感知的分组上下文打包器。在核心低内存基准集AMA-Bench上，当预算为4k token时，该方法仅消耗32%的token成本即可达到全上下文方案83%的性能；在4种子取平均的设置下，在2.6k到5k的token区间内，其性能比最优的流式聚类基线方法Online K-Means高出3.5-6.0个百分点（p<0.001）。3种子消融实验表明，性能提升主要来自合并规则（相比Online K-Means与匹配τ的DP-means提升5.7个百分点）与分组打包器（相比直接拼接方案提升5.0个百分点）。该性能表现同样在独立长周期角色内存基准集RealMem上得到验证：RSM-full性能相比Budget-RAG高出0.69个百分点（p=0.006），与BM25-RAG性能相当（配对差值为+0.27个百分点，p=0.47，本文不宣称二者在等价检验意义下完全等效），且显著优于Streaming-Proto（+2.97个百分点）与2025年最优的智能体内存基线方法A-MEM（+1.65个百分点，p<0.001）。所有基准实验结果均表明：在严格预算约束下，低内存方案的性能主要由流式内存的合并策略与检索内容的组装方式决定。总体而言，RSM-full在2k-5k提示token区间内表现最优，可实现低内存场景下的帕累托最优，在该区间外更高token消耗的基线方法仍具备性能优势。

title: ARIA - An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Testing of Infotainment Systems
title_zh: ARIA——面向车载信息娱乐系统自主测试的智能体框架
authors: António Azevedo, Bruno Lima, João Pascoal Faria
abstract: Automotive infotainment validation still relies on manual testing, slow, costly, and incompatible with agile releases and OTA updates. Scripted automation only partly helps: it couples test logic to implementation, yielding brittle, high-maintenance suites. Existing LLM-driven frameworks mostly target web/mobile apps, using single- or dual-agent setups that overload one or two models with perception, planning, action selection, and validation at once, prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration loops given infotainment complexity. We present ARIA (Autonomous Real-time Infotainment Assessment), a multi-agent LLM framework that autonomously runs end-to-end tests on Android infotainment systems via visual interaction, using a closed-loop pipeline of four specialized agents per step plus a report stage. From single-sentence scenarios (path, action, expected outcome), ARIA runs the interactions and produces reports, reproducible scripts, and visual evidence per step. Evaluated on a manufacturer's physical Android infotainment system across 30 scenarios, ARIA completed 28 (93.3%) with a verdict (2 errored), 20 of which (71.4%) matched ground truth. It caught all 5 known defects, no fault passed as working; its 8 false positives stem from navigation/image limits and unsupported gestures, showing multi-agent LLMs can run infotainment tests industrially while exposing the cost of a low false-positive tolerance. A single-agent baseline confirms the multi-agent design's value: on the first pass, before stronger-model revisitation narrows the gap, it shows a far higher false-positive rate (72.0% vs. 52.6%), conflating navigational difficulty with system failure. We report first-pass/post-revisitation results, token/call/cost per scenario, and show via repeated runs that stability tracks complexity, with fault detection perfectly consistent, pointing to CI integration of visual testing.
summary_zh: 当前车载信息娱乐系统的验证仍依赖人工测试，存在效率低、成本高的问题，无法适配敏捷发布与OTA（空中下载）更新的需求。脚本化自动化方案的效果十分有限：测试逻辑与实现强耦合，生成的测试套件鲁棒性差、维护成本高。现有大语言模型驱动的测试框架大多面向网页/移动应用，采用单智能体或双智能体架构，将感知、规划、动作选择与验证任务全部交由1-2个模型处理，受信息娱乐系统的复杂度影响，很容易出现幻觉与无效探索循环。本文提出ARIA（自主实时信息娱乐评估），一种多智能体大语言模型框架，可通过视觉交互在安卓信息娱乐系统上自主执行端到端测试，采用闭环流水线，每步调用4个专用智能体，最终生成测试报告。仅需输入单句场景描述（包含路径、动作、预期结果），ARIA即可自动执行交互，生成测试报告、可复现脚本与每步的视觉证据。在某车企的实体安卓信息娱乐系统上针对30个场景开展测试，ARIA完成了其中28个场景的判定（占比93.3%，剩余2个场景执行出错），其中20个场景的判定结果与真实情况完全一致（占比71.4%）。该框架检出了全部5个已知缺陷，不存在将故障误判为正常的情况，8个误报案例均来自导航/图像识别限制与不支持的手势操作，证明多智能体大语言模型可实现工业级的信息娱乐系统测试，同时也暴露了低误报容忍度场景下的落地成本问题。单智能体基线实验验证了多智能体设计的价值：在未经过强模型重校验的首轮测试中，单智能体方案的误报率高达72.0%，远高于多智能体方案的52.6%，容易将导航难度误判为系统故障。本文同时报告了首轮测试与重校验后的结果、每个场景的token消耗、调用次数与成本数据，多次重复实验表明框架稳定性与场景复杂度正相关，故障检测结果完全一致，支持后续集成至CI（持续集成）视觉测试流水线。

title: TreeFI: Value-Aware Statistical Fault Injection for Deep Neural Networks
title_zh: TreeFI：面向深度神经网络的数值感知统计故障注入方法
authors: Noam Bires, Marcello Traiola, Angeliki Kritikakou, Elisa Fromont
abstract: Reliability evaluation of deep neural networks under hardware faults commonly relies on fault injection, but exhaustive campaigns are intractable for modern models and datasets. Statistical fault injection reduces this cost, yet existing approaches still require large injection budgets because they do not explicitly exploit a key property of floating-point faults: the effect of a bit flip depends strongly on the value being corrupted. We propose TreeFI, a value-aware statistical fault-injection methodology for FP32 single-bit faults in DNN activations and weights. TreeFI partitions each layer's value distribution into intervals with similar expected bit-flip behavior, learned using regression trees, and allocates injections across these intervals according to their relevance for failure-rate estimation. This stratified allocation preserves the target confidence and error margin while avoiding unnecessary injections in low-impact regions of the fault space. We validate TreeFI on CNN and Transformer models using CIFAR-10 and ImageNet. On ResNet8, where exhaustive activation fault injection is feasible, TreeFI provides more accurate estimates than state-of-the-art statistical FI baselines under the same campaign setting. Across the evaluated models, TreeFI reduces the required injection budget by up to 72.1x, with average reductions of 44.9x for activation faults and 11.2x for the executed weight campaigns.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络在硬件故障场景下的可靠性评估通常依赖故障注入技术，但针对现代模型与数据集的全量故障注入实验成本极高，难以落地。统计故障注入技术可降低评估成本，但现有方案仍需要大量注入预算，因为其未充分利用浮点故障的核心特性：比特翻转的影响高度依赖被修改的数值本身。本文提出TreeFI，一种面向深度神经网络激活值与权重中FP32（32位浮点数）单比特故障的数值感知统计故障注入方法。TreeFI利用回归树将每一层的数值分布划分为多个区间，每个区间内的比特翻转预期行为相似，随后根据各区间对故障率估计的贡献度分配注入资源。这种分层分配策略在保证目标置信度与误差裕度的同时，避免了在故障空间低影响区域执行不必要的注入操作。本文在CIFAR-10与ImageNet数据集上针对CNN与Transformer模型开展验证，在可实现全量激活故障注入的ResNet8模型上，相同实验设置下TreeFI的估计精度优于现有最优的统计故障注入基线方法。在所有被测模型上，TreeFI最多可将所需注入预算降低72.1倍，其中激活故障场景平均降低44.9倍，权重故障场景平均降低11.2倍。

title: Better Understanding, Better Fixes? A Study of Hallucination in LLM-based Automated Program Repair
title_zh: 理解更充分，修复更可靠？大语言模型驱动的自动化程序修复中的幻觉现象研究
authors: Xuemeng Cai, Jiakun Liu, Linhan Yang, Wei Ma, Lingxiao Jiang
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced automated program repair (APR), yet existing evaluations remain largely result-centric and provide limited insight into hallucination during repair. In APR, hallucination may arise not only in final patches but also in the intermediate artifacts that guide patch generation. To address this gap, we perform a multi-layered analysis of hallucination throughout the APR process. Specifically, we characterize hallucination as the production of patches or intermediate artifacts that are not faithfully grounded in the available repair evidence. We examine repair hallucination in final patches and understanding hallucination in intermediate artifacts through three tasks, namely triggering testcase identification, line coverage prediction, and additional testcasethis http URLthen evaluate three representative LLMs on 832 Defects4J bugs through automatic evaluation and manual analysis. Our results show that both repair and understanding hallucinations remain prevalent. Across models and settings, only 21.0%-55.9% of generated patches pass the developer-written test suite. Moreover, although more accurate intermediate artifacts are generally associated with successful repairs, this relationship does not always hold. Manual analysis of 812 sampled repairs identifies repair hallucinations in 72.7% of cases, including patches that pass all available tests; incorrect causal localization and incorrect repair strategies account for 45.9% and 18.5% of these hallucinations, respectively. Meanwhile, models frequently misidentify triggering testcases, mispredict line coverage involving branching control flow, and generate additional testcases with missing bug-triggering conditions or incorrect expected behavior.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）大幅推动了自动化程序修复（APR）领域的发展，但现有评估大多以结果为核心，对修复过程中的幻觉现象研究十分有限。在自动化程序修复场景中，幻觉不仅出现在最终生成的补丁中，也可能出现在引导补丁生成的中间产物中。针对这一研究空白，本文对自动化程序修复全流程的幻觉现象开展多层级分析，将幻觉定义为生成的补丁或中间产物无法完全基于现有修复证据生成的现象。本文通过触发测试用例识别、行覆盖率预测、补充测试用例生成三个任务，分别研究最终补丁中的修复幻觉与中间产物中的理解幻觉，随后在Defects4J数据集的832个缺陷上对三个代表性大语言模型开展自动评估与人工分析。结果表明，修复幻觉与理解幻觉的发生概率都很高：在所有模型与设置下，仅21.0%-55.9%的生成补丁可通过开发者编写的测试套件。尽管精度更高的中间产物通常对应更高的修复成功率，但该关联并不绝对成立。对812个采样修复案例的人工分析显示，72.7%的案例存在修复幻觉，其中甚至包含可通过所有现有测试的补丁；错误的因果定位与错误的修复策略分别占所有幻觉案例的45.9%与18.5%。同时，模型还经常错误识别触发测试用例、错误预测涉及分支控制流的行覆盖率、生成的补充测试用例存在缺陷触发条件缺失或预期行为错误等问题。

title: Adaptation Interfaces for In-Context Tabular Foundation Models in Time-to-Event Prediction
title_zh: 用于事件发生时间预测的上下文内表格基础模型适配接口
authors: Minh-Khoi Pham, Luca Cotugno, Dan Cernei, Alina Sirbu, Stefano Masi 等 (13 人)
abstract: Tabular foundation models (TabFMs) achieve strong performance on structured data, particularly for standard classification and regression problems. Yet, extending them to censored time-to-event prediction is challenging because it requires properly handling censoring and event-time dynamics. Building on our prior work, we further link TabFMs with CoxPH and DeepHit and revise the context-resampled training procedure. We evaluate temporal zero-shot reformulation, classification-based fine-tuning, and survival-head adaptation using frozen TabFM backbones on 74 single-risk data sets, and we additionally study 4 competing-risk data sets. Zero-shot inference is effective on smaller single-risk data sets, whereas supervised adaptation becomes increasingly advantageous as data sets scale. Cox provides the most reliably strong interface, especially for Integrated Brier Score (IBS) on larger data sets. DeepHit is relatively stronger for the time-dependent Concordance Index than for IBS, while cause-specific MTLR ranks highest among the TabFM survival heads in the four-data-set competing-risk analysis. Classification fine-tuning becomes more competitive with zero-shot inference as data sets grow but remains weaker for probabilistic prediction. Overall, our results indicate that effective TabFM transfer depends on the data regime and on the statistical structure represented by the chosen adaptation interface. The implementation scripts used for this work are available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 表格基础模型（TabFMs）在结构化数据上表现优异，尤其在标准分类和回归任务中性能突出。然而将其扩展到带删失的事件发生时间预测任务仍存在挑战，该类任务需要妥善处理删失机制与事件时间动态特性。基于前期研究成果，本研究进一步将表格基础模型与CoxPH（考克斯比例风险模型）、DeepHit方法相结合，修订了上下文重采样训练流程。研究在74个单风险数据集上，基于冻结主干的表格基础模型，对时序零样本重构、基于分类的微调、生存头适配三类方案开展评估，同时额外针对4个竞争风险数据集进行了拓展研究。结果表明，零样本推理在小规模单风险数据集上效果显著，而随着数据集规模扩大，有监督适配的优势逐渐凸显。CoxPH是可靠性最高的强适配接口，在大规模数据集的综合布莱尔得分（IBS）指标上表现尤为突出；DeepHit在时间依赖一致性指数指标上的表现相对优于其在IBS指标上的表现；在4个数据集构成的竞争风险分析中，特定原因多任务逻辑回归（cause-specific MTLR）在所有表格基础模型生存头中排名最高。随着数据集规模增长，分类微调的性能逐步接近零样本推理，但在概率预测任务中仍处于劣势。总体而言，研究结果表明表格基础模型的有效迁移效果取决于数据分布区间，以及所选适配接口所表征的统计结构。本研究的实现脚本可通过对应公开链接获取。

title: RefactorPlatform: An Open-Source Harness for Controlled Evaluation of Repository-Scale Refactoring Agents
title_zh: RefactorPlatform：面向仓库级重构智能体受控评估的开源测试框架
authors: Aziz Ben Amor, Drish Mali, Mann Acharya, Vijayasri Iyer, Sébastien Bratières
abstract: Repository-scale refactoring requires coding agents to propagate a single change across many interdependent files without altering program behavior, yet to our knowledge no existing harness isolates the design choices that determine agent success on this task. We present RefactorPlatform, an open-source evaluation harness that holds the environment fixed and varies each design axis explicitly: model backbone (via OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot CLI), execution regime (baseline, retrieval-augmented, and multi-agent), and prompt specificity. Each run executes in an isolated workspace with live terminal streaming, per-task logging of tokens, diffs, and transcripts, AST-based verification, and exportable telemetry for audit and reproduction. Demonstrating the platform on 100 multi-file RefactorBench tasks across four model families, we illustrate the analyses it supports: AST-aware chunking outperforms naive token-window chunking by 25-30% across prompt modes, whereas naive retrieval falls below the retrieval-free baseline; a lean retrieval-augmented single agent (86%) beats the sub-agent configuration we evaluated (66%) on matched tasks with no task passing under delegation that fails under retrieval; and retrieval's accuracy gains absorb its token overhead, leaving cost per successful refactoring unchanged. RefactorPlatform is open-sourced to make refactoring-agent evaluation reproducible and auditable.
summary_zh: 仓库级代码重构要求编码智能体在不改变程序行为的前提下，将单处修改同步传播到大量相互依赖的文件中。但据调研，现有测试框架均无法隔离出决定智能体在该任务中表现的各类设计选择。本文提出RefactorPlatform，一款开源评估测试框架，该框架固定运行环境，显式调整各设计维度：模型主干（支持OpenRouter与GitHub Copilot CLI接入）、执行模式（基线模式、检索增强模式、多智能体模式）、提示词粒度。每轮运行都在独立工作空间中执行，支持实时终端流输出、逐任务的令牌/差异/运行日志记录、基于抽象语法树（AST）的正确性验证，以及可导出的遥测数据用于审计与复现。本研究在覆盖4类模型家族的100个多文件RefactorBench任务上对该平台进行验证，展示了其支持的多类分析能力：在所有提示词模式下，支持AST感知的分块方法性能比朴素令牌窗口分块方法高出25%~30%，而朴素检索方案的表现低于无检索基线；轻量检索增强单智能体方案的任务完成率达86%，优于本研究评估的子智能体配置（完成率66%），在匹配任务中不存在委托模式失败但检索模式成功的情况；检索带来的精度提升抵消了其额外的令牌开销，单次成功重构的平均成本保持不变。RefactorPlatform已开源，可保障重构智能体的评估过程可复现、可审计。

title: From Language Models to World-Acting Systems: Progress and Limits of Agentic AI across Digital, Social, Virtual, and Physical Environments
title_zh: 从语言模型到世界交互系统：数字、社交、虚拟与物理环境下智能体AI的进展与局限
authors: Linsen Zhu, Mengqing Cai
abstract: Large language models become consequential agents when surrounding systems let outputs change external state. Models now call tools, operate interfaces, delegate work, retain state, inhabit generated worlds, and control robots or laboratory equipment. Such advances are often narrated as one march toward autonomy, conflating model competence, system integration, persistence, and safe authority. This critical review synthesizes primary research and official technical specifications available by 31 August 2026. We organize the evidence along delegated authority, temporal persistence, and environmental coupling, while separating model, harness, and environment. Within the evidence examined, action-interface expansion is documented more convincingly than robust completion, recovery, authorization, or independent verification. Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent improve interoperability but do not establish trustworthy delegation; multi-agent organization adds specialization alongside cost and correlated failure. Persistent simulations and world models support training and planning but do not themselves demonstrate agency; robotics and self-driving laboratories establish bounded feasibility rather than unattended open-world reliability. We propose justified delegation as an analytical and normative heuristic, not an observed law or certified score: expand action scope only where evidence supports provenance, bounded authority, failure detection, safe recovery, and calibrated human control. This framing yields a research agenda for coupled model-harness evaluation, capability-based permissions, durable state, cross-agent accountability, and staged physical validation.
summary_zh: 当周边系统允许大语言模型的输出改变外部状态时，大语言模型就会成为具备实际影响力的智能体。当前大语言模型已经可以调用工具、操作界面、委派任务、留存状态、入驻生成式世界，甚至控制机器人或实验室设备。这类进展常被笼统描述为向自主能力演进的统一进程，混淆了模型能力、系统集成、状态持久性与安全权限等不同维度的特性。本综述对2026年8月31日前公开的核心研究成果与官方技术规范进行了系统性梳理，从委派权限、时间持久性、环境耦合三个维度组织相关证据，同时明确区分模型、测试框架与环境三类要素。在已考察的所有证据中，动作接口的扩展得到的验证可信度远高于鲁棒任务完成、故障恢复、权限管控或独立验证能力。模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）与Agent2Agent协议提升了互操作性，但并未建立可信的任务委派机制；多智能体组织模式在实现分工专业化的同时，也带来了额外成本与关联故障风险。持久化仿真与世界模型可为训练和规划提供支撑，但本身并不具备智能体属性；机器人与自动驾驶实验室仅验证了有限场景下的可行性，并未证明其在开放世界无人值守场景下的可靠性。本研究提出「合理委派」作为兼具分析性与规范性的启发式原则，该原则并非已被验证的规律或可量化的认证得分：仅当有证据可追溯操作来源、权限边界清晰、支持故障检测、可实现安全恢复且人类控制程度可校准的前提下，才可扩展智能体的动作范围。该框架可支撑形成全新的研究议程，覆盖模型-测试框架耦合评估、基于能力的权限管控、持久化状态管理、跨智能体问责机制、分阶段物理场景验证等方向。

title: Attention-guided super-resolution of 4D flow MRI in carotid arteries
title_zh: 注意力引导的颈动脉四维流磁共振成像（4D flow MRI）超分辨率重建
authors: Ali Mokhtari, Dominik Obrist
abstract: Four-dimensional (4D) flow magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a powerful non-invasive technique for visualizing and quantifying complex blood flow patterns in vivo. Despite its clinical promise, broader adoption is limited by low spatial resolution and sensitivity to noise, which restrict accurate assessment of critical hemodynamic biomarkers such as wall shear stress, pressure gradients, and turbulent kinetic energy. To overcome these challenges, we propose a deep learning-based super-resolution framework that integrates multi-scale feature extraction and attention mechanisms to enhance the quality of 4D flow MRI data.The model was trained on a dataset of 120 patients with 240 stenosed carotid arteries. High-resolution ground truth data were generated using patient-specific computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations based on segmented vascular geometries and physiologically realistic boundary conditions, and the resulting velocity fields served as targets for supervised learning. The proposed architecture uses convolutional block attention modules (CBAM) to guide the network toward clinically relevant spatial features and to suppress noise in low-resolution inputs.Quantitative results show that the attention-guided model substantially reduces the root mean square error (RMSE) compared with a baseline model without attention, and qualitative velocity contour analysis confirms improved reconstruction of intricate flow patterns. These findings highlight the capacity of the model to restore high-fidelity flow fields under noisy conditions and support the use of deep learning to extend the clinical utility of 4D flow MRI for non-invasive hemodynamic assessment.
summary_zh: 四维流磁共振成像（4D flow MRI）是一种强大的非侵入式技术，可在体内可视化并量化复杂血流模式。尽管其具备极高的临床应用潜力，但空间分辨率低、对噪声敏感的缺陷限制了其大规模推广，也导致壁面切应力、压力梯度、湍流动能等关键血流动力学生物标志物的评估精度不足。为解决上述问题，本研究提出一种基于深度学习的超分辨率框架，融合多尺度特征提取与注意力机制，提升4D flow MRI数据的质量。该模型在包含120名患者共240条颈动脉狭窄血管的数据集上训练，基于分割后的血管几何结构与符合生理规律的边界条件，通过患者专属计算流体力学（CFD）仿真生成高分辨率真值数据，得到的速度场作为监督学习的训练目标。所提出的架构采用卷积块注意力模块（CBAM），引导网络聚焦于临床相关的空间特征，同时抑制低分辨率输入中的噪声。定量结果显示，与无注意力机制的基线模型相比，注意力引导模型可大幅降低均方根误差（RMSE），定性的速度轮廓分析也证实其对复杂血流模式的重建效果更优。上述结果表明该模型可在噪声环境下恢复高保真血流场，为深度学习拓展4D flow MRI在非侵入式血流动力学评估中的临床应用价值提供支撑。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Solar PV Policy Design under Uncertainty: An Agent-Based Approach
title_zh: 不确定性下顺序太阳能光伏政策设计的强化学习方法：基于智能体的框架
authors: Iias Faiud, Jonaid Shianifar, Michael Schukat, Karl Mason
abstract: Designing effective and fiscally sustainable policies for solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption requires balancing adoption gains against public expenditure under uncertainty and heterogeneous decision-making. This study formulates PV policy design as a sequential decision problem and integrates reinforcement learning (RL) with a stochastic agent-based model (ABM) that simulates yearly solar PV adoption under uncertainty. A policymaker agent selects annual incentives, including capital grants, subsidised loan rates, and feed-in tariffs, over a 16-year horizon. Adoption--cost trade-offs are explored by varying policy preferences within a scalarised reward framework. Policies are learned using PPO, SAC, and TD3 and evaluated under stochastic simulation. The results show that this approach produces a clear trade-off structure: the highest-adoption policy (TD3, $w_{\text{cost}}=0.5$) achieves approximately 4,145 adopters at a cost of EUR 41.73 million, while the lowest-cost policy (PPO, $w_{\text{cost}}=2.0$) reduces expenditure to EUR 7.27 million with 2,682 adopters. The balanced policy (PPO, $w_{\text{cost}}=1.6$) achieves 3,495 adopters at a cost of EUR 22.47 million. Across algorithms, consistent trade-off patterns are observed, indicating robustness of the adoption--cost relationship. Compared with static baseline policies, the RL framework explores a broader range of policy configurations. These findings demonstrate the potential of RL as a flexible tool for adaptive policy design under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 设计高效且财政可持续的太阳能光伏（PV）推广政策，需要在不确定性与异质性决策场景下平衡推广收益与公共支出。本研究将光伏政策设计建模为序贯决策问题，将强化学习（RL）与随机基于智能体的模型（ABM）相结合，模拟不确定性下的年度光伏推广过程。政策制定智能体在16年的时间跨度内选择年度激励政策，包括资本补贴、优惠贷款利率与上网电价。本研究在标量化奖励框架下调整政策偏好，探索推广率与成本之间的权衡关系，采用PPO、SAC、TD3三类强化学习算法学习最优政策，并在随机仿真环境下开展评估。结果表明，该方法可生成清晰的权衡结构：最高推广率政策（TD3，成本权重w_cost=0.5）可实现约4145名新增用户，总成本为4173万欧元；最低成本政策（PPO，成本权重w_cost=2.0）可将支出降至727万欧元，对应新增用户2682名；均衡政策（PPO，成本权重w_cost=1.6）可实现3495名新增用户，总成本为2247万欧元。所有算法均呈现一致的权衡模式，证明推广率-成本关系具备鲁棒性。与静态基线政策相比，该强化学习框架可探索更广泛的政策配置空间。研究结果证明强化学习可作为灵活工具，支撑不确定性环境下的自适应政策设计。

title: ReCAST: Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training for Obfuscated SMS Risk Classification
title_zh: ReCAST：面向混淆短信风险分类的感知恢复级联分阶段训练框架
authors: Jieyun Huang, Yi Shen, Kaikai Zhao, Jiangze Yan, Wenjing Zhang 等 (10 人)
abstract: Fraudulent messages sent via Short Message Service (SMS) are increasingly obfuscated to evade cost-conscious classifiers in production systems. In Chinese SMS, attackers can exploit a wide range of carefully crafted obfuscation strategies to hide risk-bearing phrases while preserving human readability, making direct classification brittle under real-world latency and throughput constraints. We propose ReCAST, a Restoration-aware Cascaded Stage-wise Training framework for robust obfuscated Chinese SMS classification. ReCAST distills a large teacher model's de-obfuscation ability into a smaller deployable student model by supervising obfuscated span detection, obfuscation type prediction, and text restoration, and then uses the restoration-aware student for downstream risk classification. Experiments on an internally constructed real-world Chinese SMS benchmark show that ReCAST substantially improves classification performance over directly trained baselines under obfuscation. The results suggest that restoration-aware distillation offers a practical path toward robust SMS risk classification with smaller deployable models under production-oriented constraints.
summary_zh: 通过短消息服务（SMS）发送的欺诈短信越来越多地采用混淆手段，以规避生产系统中对成本敏感的分类器检测。在中文短信场景下，攻击者可利用大量精心设计的混淆策略，在保留人类可读性的前提下隐藏风险短语，导致直接训练的分类器在真实场景的延迟与吞吐量约束下性能大幅下降。本文提出ReCAST，一款面向鲁棒混淆中文短信分类的感知恢复级联分阶段训练框架。ReCAST将大教师模型的去混淆能力蒸馏到可部署的小学生模型中，通过对混淆片段检测、混淆类型预测、文本恢复三个任务进行监督，最终使用具备恢复感知能力的学生模型完成下游风险分类任务。在内部构建的真实中文短信基准数据集上开展的实验表明，与直接训练的基线模型相比，ReCAST可大幅提升混淆场景下的分类性能。结果表明，面向恢复的蒸馏是在生产环境约束下，基于小型可部署模型实现鲁棒短信风险分类的可行路径。

title: MARLA: A Conceptual Scaffold for Regulatory Learning under the EU AI Act
title_zh: MARLA：欧盟《人工智能法案》下监管学习的概念支架
authors: Alessio Buscemi, Tom Deckenbrunnen, Imane Hmiddou, Marco Billi, Livio Rubino 等 (8 人)
abstract: The EU AI Act positions regulation as part of the infrastructure for safe, trustworthy and market-ready innovation. Realising this ambition requires regulatory learning: the evidence generated during implementation must be translated into governance and legal knowledge that supports consistent interpretation, effective oversight, and adaptation as technologies evolve. Yet the actors who produce this evidence and those who rely on it operate in different professional worlds. This paper proposes MARLA (Map, Assess, Report, Learn, Adapt), a conceptual scaffold organising regulatory learning as a five-stage cycle centred on the implementation of legal requirements into socio-technical practices, situated at the Local, National and European levels of the AI Act's governance architecture. Deliberately non-prescriptive, MARLA gives technical and legal stakeholders a shared vocabulary in which each of the first three stages generates its own documentable form of regulatory learning. We illustrate the scaffold with two piloted case studies and a prospective National-to-European illustration.
summary_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》将监管定位为安全、可信且可落地的创新基础设施的组成部分。实现这一目标需要推进监管学习：在法案实施过程中生成的证据必须转化为治理与法律知识，支撑技术演进过程中的统一解读、有效监管与动态适配。但生成证据的主体与依赖证据的主体分属不同专业领域，存在壁垒。本文提出MARLA（Map、Assess、Report、Learn、Adapt）概念支架，将监管学习组织为五阶段循环，核心是将法律要求落地为社会技术实践，适配欧盟《人工智能法案》治理架构中的地方、国家、欧洲三个层级。MARLA不预设强制实现路径，为技术与法律相关方提供统一的共享术语体系，前三个阶段均可生成可记录的监管学习成果。本文通过两个试点案例研究与一个从国家层面到欧洲层面的前瞻性演示，对该支架进行了说明。

title: Forgetting Without Restarting: Execution-State Unlearning for Stateful LLM Agents
title_zh: 无需重启的遗忘：有状态大语言模型智能体的执行态去学习
authors: Chao Yao, Yangbo Wei, Zhen Huang, Junhong Qian, Chenle Chen 等 (8 人)
abstract: Long-running LLM agents are stateful: beyond the transcript they accrete compressed summaries, plaintext memory, pending tool plans, and, under every serving API, a KV cache. Yet today's "forget" operations delete a plaintext memory record and stop, leaving every artifact derived from the revoked information intact. We formalize execution-state unlearning: after a forget request, the agent must behave as if it had never observed the target. Modeling the runtime as a deterministic transition system, we prove that the pre-target trajectory prefix is shared with this counterfactual world for free, that the post-target suffix is irreducibly tainted without token-level attribution, and that exact unlearning requires at least $T-\tau+1$ recomputed transitions, where $\tau$ is the target's injection step. Provenance-Guided Selective Replay attains this bound as a cross-layer contract spanning prompt, compressed memory, and cache: a provenance graph locates the injection point, checkpoint restoration reduces to cropping the KV cache, and sanitized replay regenerates the counterfactual suffix. Audited with elicitation, stochastic, and string-free behavioral tests across three agent suites, nine baselines, and three model families, memory deletion leaves leakage unchanged, instruction-based forgetting collapses under elicitation (Leak@probes = 1.00), and source redaction still acts on a revoked preference in 80% of episodes, while selective replay is indistinguishable from a full reset at up to 9x fewer recomputed tokens.
summary_zh: 长期运行的大语言模型（LLM）智能体是有状态的：除了对话记录之外，还会累积压缩摘要、明文记忆、待执行工具计划，以及所有服务API都会生成的键值缓存（KV缓存）。但当前的「遗忘」操作仅会删除明文记忆记录，所有从待撤销信息衍生出的产物都会完整保留。本文正式定义了执行态去学习任务：收到遗忘请求后，智能体的行为必须与从未观测到目标信息的反事实场景完全一致。本研究将运行时建模为确定性转移系统，证明目标信息注入前的轨迹前缀可直接与反事实世界共享，无需额外计算；如果没有令牌级溯源能力，目标信息注入后的轨迹后缀会被完全污染，无法直接复用；精确去学习至少需要重新计算T-τ+1个转移步骤，其中τ是目标信息的注入步。本研究提出的「溯源引导选择性重放」方法可达到该理论下界，其作为跨层契约覆盖提示词、压缩记忆与缓存全链路：溯源图定位信息注入点，检查点恢复简化为裁剪KV缓存，经过清洗的重放过程生成反事实轨迹后缀。本研究在3类智能体套件、9个基线模型、3类模型家族上通过诱导测试、随机测试、无字符串行为测试进行审计，结果表明：仅删除记忆的方案泄漏率完全没有下降，基于指令的遗忘方案在诱导测试下完全失效（探针泄漏率Leak@probes=1.00），源文本红action方案仍有80%的场景会基于已撤销的偏好做出响应，而选择性重放方案的表现与完全重置的效果无差异，所需重新计算的令牌数仅为完全重置方案的1/9。

title: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
title_zh: AutoLR：工业推荐系统中从研究到上线评审的流程自动化框架
authors: Qi Zhang, Yanlin Chen, Wenchao Xiao
abstract: Improving an industrial recommender is an iterative research-and-engineering process rather than a direct path from idea to deployment. In \textbf{DASHEN, NetEase's gaming-community app}, algorithm engineers typically identify promising directions from research papers, technical reports, and prior production experiments; reproduce or adapt the underlying methods; implement them in the production codebase; and evaluate the resulting models through training and offline experiments. Promising candidates are then advanced to online A/B tests, and those demonstrating robust gains are submitted to Launch Review---the internal gate for full-traffic rollout. Large language models (LLMs) can assist with individual stages of this workflow, but the overall process remains human-dependent without a harness that can reliably coordinate them across long-running, often multi-day experimental cycles. We present \textbf{AutoLR}, initially built as \textbf{Auto Launch Review} and later extended upstream into an autonomous research-to-launch harness. AutoLR combines three system mechanisms: a \textbf{multi-expert council} that debates and adversarially reviews proposals; a \textbf{deterministic evidence-weighted exploration--exploitation selector} that allocates a limited trial budget across candidate directions and uses Council reranking; and a layered knowledge system that combines external research, production-system knowledge, and DASHEN-specific domain knowledge---such as game communities, player characteristics, and content-interaction patterns---with posterior evidence from configurations, patches, logs, failures, and offline outcomes. LLM agents perform semantic reasoning and code generation, while deterministic controllers retain authority over execution, metric extraction, guardrails, and persistent state transitions.
summary_zh: 工业级推荐系统的优化是迭代式的研究工程过程，而非从创意到部署的直接路径。在网易旗下游戏社区应用DASHEN中，算法工程师通常需要从学术论文、技术报告与过往生产实验中挖掘有潜力的优化方向，复现或适配底层方法，将其实现到生产代码库中，通过训练与离线实验评估模型效果。表现优异的候选方案会进入线上A/B测试，验证获得稳定收益的方案将提交上线评审，这是全量流量发布的内部准入关卡。大语言模型（LLM）可辅助该工作流的单个环节，但如果没有可在长达数天的多轮实验周期中可靠协调各环节的框架，整个流程仍高度依赖人工。本文提出AutoLR，最初命名为Auto Launch Review（自动上线评审），后续向上游扩展为覆盖从研究到上线全流程的自主框架。AutoLR集成三类系统机制：第一是多专家委员会机制，负责对方案进行辩论与对抗性评审；第二是确定性证据加权的探索-利用选择器，可在候选方向之间分配有限的实验预算，并结合委员会重排序结果进行调度；第三是分层知识系统，融合外部研究成果、生产系统知识、DASHEN专属领域知识（包括游戏社区特性、玩家画像、内容交互模式等），以及来自配置、补丁、日志、故障、离线结果的后验证据。大语言模型智能体负责语义推理与代码生成，确定性控制器保留对执行流程、指标提取、安全护栏、持久化状态转移的管控权限。

title: CHAMP: Cross-domain Hybrid Architecture for Matchmaking and Prediction in Online Multi-Player Games
title_zh: CHAMP：面向在线多人游戏匹配与预测的跨域混合架构
authors: Kai Wang, Ge Fan, Chaoyun Zhang, Yuyang Jiang, Yuze Liu
abstract: Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) games rely on matchmaking to maintain competitive balance. Our prior work, CUPID, framed matchmaking as an assignment re-optimization problem and showed that a single-mode win-rate predictor can meaningfully rebalance teams. However, deploying such a system across diverse player populations exposes three practical bottlenecks: most queueing players lack sufficient in-mode match history (cold start), skill distributions shift drastically across rank tiers (distribution inconsistency), and extreme skill segments are severely data-starved.We present CHAMP, a cross-domain matchmaking framework that resolves these deployment bottlenecks. To address data sparsity and cold starts, CHAMP replaces the target-mode-only player profile with a hybrid domain feature collection: a timestamp-ordered cross-mode short-term sequence whose slices are annotated with target-domain features, plus per-mode breakdowns of long-term, real-time and team statistics. We further propose the Domain-Aware Win-rate Network (DAWN): a Domain-aware Knowledge Extractor (DAKE) compiles target-mode attributes into learnable representations that feed Domain-Aware Temporal/Spatial/Permutation OmniNet Encoders (DATOE/DASOE/DAPOE), so that mode-conditioned representations and per-mode debiasing are learned jointly inside a single shared network. Online, one trained DAWN serves every supported mode, with per-mode position-satisfaction thresholds as the only mode-specific knob.Offline, DAWN achieves 67.73% win-rate prediction accuracy, outperforming all evaluated attention and sequence baselines. Online A/B tests across the entire League ladder of a large-scale MOBA game, from novice players up to the top-expert players served by Elite Mode, demonstrate consistent drops in imbalanced matches. For lower-tier players, CHAMP reduces the 5-minute kill crushing rate by up to 20.73%.
summary_zh: 多人在线战术竞技（MOBA）游戏依赖匹配机制维持对局竞技平衡性。本团队前期研究成果CUPID将匹配问题建模为分配重优化问题，证明单模式胜率预测器可有效实现队伍重平衡。但在不同玩家群体中部署该系统时，存在三个实际瓶颈：绝大多数排队玩家在目标模式下的对局历史不足（冷启动问题），不同段位的技能分布差异极大（分布不一致问题），极端技能分段的数据严重匮乏。本文提出CHAMP，一款跨域匹配框架，可解决上述部署瓶颈。为解决数据稀疏与冷启动问题，CHAMP用跨域混合特征集合替代仅包含目标模式信息的玩家画像：该集合包含按时间排序的跨模式短期序列（序列切片标注有目标域特征），以及分模式统计的长期数据、实时数据与队伍统计数据。本研究进一步提出域感知胜率网络（DAWN）：其中域感知知识提取器（DAKE）将目标模式属性编译为可学习表征，输入域感知时序/空间/排列全网络编码器（DATOE/DASOE/DAPOE），在单个共享网络中联合学习模式条件表征与分模式去偏策略。在线部署时，训练完成的单个DAWN模型可支持所有游戏模式，仅需调整分模式的位置满意度阈值这一模式专属参数即可。离线测试中，DAWN的胜率预测准确率达到67.73%，优于所有参与对比的注意力与序列基线模型。在某大型MOBA游戏覆盖全段位（从新手玩家到精英模式服务的顶级专家玩家）的全天梯线上A/B测试中，CHAMP持续降低了不平衡对局的占比，针对低段位玩家，CHAMP可将5分钟内击杀碾压的对局占比最高降低20.73%。

title: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
title_zh: 从交互轨迹到持久技能：面向计算机操作智能体的在线演化方法
authors: Longtao Hu, Xiao Liang, Linchao Zhu
abstract: Computer-use agents can execute increasingly complex tasks in graphical interfaces, but their interaction experience is typically transient: procedural knowledge acquired from one rollout is not systematically retained, refined, and reused in later tasks. Existing skill libraries provide external procedural knowledge, yet their incremental value over the same agent operating without skills, as well as their longitudinal dynamics under repeated interaction, remain insufficiently characterized. We present an online skill-evolution framework that converts interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent, versioned library of reusable procedures. Each iteration executes against a frozen library snapshot, and evidence-guided skill updates become available in subsequent iterations without changing model parameters. We compare the full evolving-library system with a configuration-matched empty-library control across four OSWorld application domains under the same fixed action-generation and GUI-grounding stack, task sets, and iteration horizons. Following a five-iteration empty-library warm-up, Full attains a higher post-warm-up mean evaluator score in all four observed domain runs, with mean differences ranging from 5.7 to 18.6 percentage points and domain-dependent temporal stability. In GIMP, provenance-aware analysis reveals retrieval across task-of-origin boundaries and revision churn, where repeated accepted edits fail to recover the originating task. These findings characterize evolving skill libraries as auditable, shared procedural memory that can improve a fixed computer-use stack, while showing that their benefits are conditional and repeated revision does not guarantee recovery. Code is released atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 计算机操作智能体已能在图形界面中执行日益复杂的任务，但它们的交互体验通常是瞬时的：从单次推演中获得的过程性知识无法被系统性留存、优化并复用到后续任务中。现有技能库可提供外部过程性知识，但相较于无技能加持的同配置智能体，其增量价值以及在重复交互下的长期动态特性仍未得到充分表征。本文提出一种在线技能演化框架，可将交互轨迹与评估器反馈转化为可复用过程的持久化版本化库。每一轮迭代都基于冻结的库快照执行，经过证据引导的技能更新会在后续迭代中生效，且无需修改模型参数。本文在统一的动作生成与GUI接地栈、任务集和迭代周期设置下，在4个OSWorld应用域中对比了完整演化库系统与配置匹配的空库对照组。经过5轮空库预热后，完整系统在所有4个观测域的预热后平均评估器得分均更高，均值差异处于5.7至18.6个百分点区间，且具备随域变化的时间稳定性。在GIMP场景下，溯源分析揭示了跨原始任务边界的检索行为与修订 churn 现象：多次被采纳的编辑操作也无法恢复原始任务的执行结果。上述结果证明，演化技能库可作为可审计的共享过程性记忆，提升固定计算机操作栈的性能，同时其收益是有条件的，重复修订并不能保证任务可恢复。代码已发布至对应公开链接。

title: PRISM-Bench: An Audio-Centric Diagnostic Benchmark for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
title_zh: PRISM-Bench：面向文本生成音视频的以音频为核心的诊断基准
authors: Yuchen Sun, Qian Yang, Jun Wang, Detai Xin, Guoqiao Yu 等 (7 人)
abstract: Text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation has advanced rapidly, but its evaluation still underestimates the audio modality. Existing benchmarks either treat audio as an auxiliary component of video quality or assess it in isolation from audiovisual grounding, making it difficult to diagnose where current systems truly succeed or fail in audio generation. We present PRISM-Bench, the first audio-centric diagnostic benchmark for T2AV generation. Built from a rigorously curated dataset of 900 human-verified samples, PRISM-Bench factorizes audio evaluation along two orthogonal axes: audio type (Speech, Music, and Sound) and sound-source visibility (On-screen vs. Off-screen). It evaluates generated content across four perceptual dimensions (Audio-Visual Coherence, Audio Quality, Audio Expressiveness, and Prompt Following) with 35 fine-grained criteria. To ensure reliable assessment, we adopt an enhanced MLLM-as-a-Judge protocol based on blind, side-by-side comparison against ground-truth references, demonstrating strong alignment (over 70% mean agreement) with human raters. Our evaluation of recent T2AV systems highlights a significant performance gap between frontier and open-source models. Furthermore, we demonstrate that current generation paradigms overfit to perceptual fidelity while struggling with complex grounding and control tasks, particularly in generating music and synchronized On-screen audio.
summary_zh: 文本生成音视频（T2AV）技术发展迅速，但现有评估体系仍对音频模态的重视不足。现有基准要么将音频视为视频质量的辅助组成部分，要么脱离音视频接地条件单独评估音频，难以诊断当前系统在音频生成环节的实际优劣。本文提出PRISM-Bench，这是首个面向T2AV生成的以音频为核心的诊断基准。该基准基于经过严格筛选的900个人工核验样本构建，从两个正交维度对音频评估进行解耦：音频类型（语音、音乐、音效）和声源可见性（屏幕内声源/屏幕外声源），并基于35项细粒度准则，从4个感知维度（音视频一致性、音频质量、音频表现力、提示词遵循度）对生成内容进行评估。为保障评估可靠性，本文采用改进的「多模态大模型即裁判」协议，基于与真实参考样本的盲选并排对比机制，其评估结果与人工标注者的一致性超过70%。本文对近年主流T2AV系统的评估结果显示，前沿闭源模型与开源模型之间存在显著性能差距。此外研究发现，当前生成范式对感知保真度存在过拟合问题，在复杂接地与控制任务中表现不佳，尤其在生成音乐和同步屏幕内音频时短板明显。

title: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
title_zh: 面向基于智能体的能源采纳模型的大语言模型辅助行为与场景增强方法
authors: Iias Faiud, Hossein Khaleghy, Michael Schukat, Karl Mason
abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) create opportunities to enrich simulation-based energy policy analysis, particularly by supporting structured behavioural assumptions and exploratory techno-economic scenarios. However, directly replacing adoption models with LLM reasoning raises concerns regarding interpretability, reproducibility, and behavioural validity. This paper proposes a hybrid framework for LLM-assisted specification design, integrating bounded behavioural rubrics and structured scenario specifications into a calibrated agent-based model (ABM) of solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption by Irish dairy farms. The proposed approach preserves the original techno-economic adoption mechanism while augmenting it with bounded behavioural modulation and scenario-driven uncertainty analysis. Behavioural effects are represented through interpretable conservative, balanced, and optimistic rubrics, while future policy and market conditions are explored through fixed, rule-validated scenario specifications. Experimental results across multiple policy settings, Monte Carlo worlds, and random seeds demonstrate stable and economically plausible behaviour, with adoption outcomes remaining bounded and monotonic across behavioural regimes. The framework achieves up to approximately 13% behavioural adoption increase relative to the corresponding logistic case without producing unstable or unrealistic saturation dynamics. The results demonstrate that LLM-assisted specifications can be integrated into calibrated energy ABMs in a controlled, reproducible, and policy-relevant manner.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为丰富仿真类能源政策分析提供了新机遇，尤其可支撑结构化行为假设构建与探索性技术经济场景生成。但直接用LLM推理替换原有能源采纳模型会引发可解释性、可复现性与行为有效性层面的担忧。本文提出一种LLM辅助规范设计的混合框架，将有限行为准则与结构化场景规范集成到经过校准的爱尔兰奶牛场太阳能光伏（PV）采纳智能体模型（ABM）中。该方法保留了原有技术经济采纳机制，同时通过有限行为调制与场景驱动的不确定性分析对其进行增强。行为效应通过可解释的保守型、平衡型、乐观型三类准则表征，未来政策与市场条件则通过经过规则校验的固定场景规范进行探索。多政策设置、蒙特卡洛场景与随机种子下的实验结果显示，该框架输出的行为稳定且符合经济学逻辑，不同行为模式下的采纳结果均处于合理区间且呈单调变化趋势。与对应的无行为增强逻辑斯蒂基准模型相比，该框架可实现最高约13%的行为层面采纳率提升，且不会产生不稳定或不符合现实的饱和动态。结果表明，LLM辅助规范可以受控、可复现且贴合政策需求的方式集成到经过校准的能源领域ABM中。

title: CoSkill: Joint Reinforcement Learning of Reasoning and Meta-Skill Agents for Hierarchical Skill Evolution
title_zh: CoSkill：面向层级化技能演化的推理智能体与元技能智能体联合强化学习框架
authors: Jinyuan Feng, Dongmin Li, Yiqun Chen, Yang Gao, Xing Chen 等 (7 人)
abstract: Skill libraries improve the sample efficiency of agentic reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge. Yet existing paradigms exhibit structural shortcomings: they either decouple skill evolution from policy optimization or instantiate meta-skills as fixed workflows. Both treat skills as passive objects to be managed, limiting the flexible evolution of skills and their co-adaptation with the reasoning agent.
