abstract: Foundation models are beginning to reshape brain-signal analysis by moving the field beyond task-specific decoding pipelines toward reusable models pretrained on broad neural datasets. Magnetoencephalography (MEG) is a compelling but still underdeveloped target for this shift: it captures human cortical dynamics at millisecond resolution while offering stronger spatial interpretability than EEG, making it especially valuable for source-resolved studies of perception, language, cognition, and clinical brain function. Yet MEG foundation models remain at an early stage, with only a small number of MEG-specific and MEG-inclusive multi-modal models, modest pretraining corpora, and emerging but still limited benchmarks. This perspective lays down the basic concepts needed to understand MEG foundation models and provides a didactic overview of the field's key design choices, including tokenization, sensor- versus source-space representations, sensor-geometry encoding, backbone architectures, self-supervised objectives, and pretraining data. We then offer a roadmap for future development, organized around native MEG pretraining, adaptation of EEG foundation models, transfer from generic time-series models, and multi-modal integration with EEG, fMRI, MRI, behaviour, and stimulus features. We highlight the need for coordinated infrastructure, including diverse and reusable MEG datasets, rigorous evaluation across subjects, sites, tasks, and clinical settings, and responsible data-sharing practices that address consent, privacy, access, and governance.
summary_zh: 基础模型正推动脑信号分析领域从任务专属解码流水线转向基于大规模神经数据集预训练的可复用模型，重塑领域发展路径。脑磁图（MEG）是该转型方向极具潜力但仍未得到充分发展的目标模态：它可以毫秒级分辨率捕捉人类皮层动态，同时比脑电图（EEG）具备更强的空间可解释性，在感知、语言、认知与临床脑功能的源解析研究中价值突出。但目前MEG基础模型仍处于发展初期，仅存在少量MEG专属或包含MEG的多模态模型，预训练语料规模有限，基准测试体系尚不成熟。本文阐述了理解MEG基础模型所需的基础概念，系统性梳理了该领域的核心设计选择，包括令牌化、传感器空间与源空间表征、传感器几何编码、骨干网络架构、自监督学习目标与预训练数据等方向。随后本文围绕原生MEG预训练、EEG基础模型适配、通用时序模型迁移、与EEG/功能磁共振成像（fMRI）/磁共振成像（MRI）/行为数据/刺激特征的多模态融合四大方向提出未来发展路线图。本文指出领域需要搭建协同基础设施，包括构建多样化可复用的MEG数据集、覆盖不同受试者/站点/任务/临床场景的严格评估体系，以及兼顾知情同意、隐私保护、访问权限与治理要求的负责任数据共享机制。

title: When Load-Balancing Goes Too Far: Expert Pruning in Over-Dispersed Mixture-of-Experts Models
title_zh: 负载均衡过度时：过度分散专家混合（MoE）模型中的专家剪枝
authors: Berkcan Kapusuzoglu, Connor Pryor, Sangwoo Cho, Supriyo Chakraborty, Shi-Xiong Zhang 等 (7 人)
abstract: Expert pruning reduces the memory and serving cost of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models by removing low-importance experts identified by the router, assuming router probabilities provide a reliable importance signal. We observe that this assumption breaks down under over-dispersed routing, a regime associated with aggressive load-balancing during training, in which tokens are distributed nearly uniformly across experts and importance signals collapse. In this regime, perplexity does not predict downstream task accuracy: on gpt-oss-20B, the lowest-perplexity pruning configuration yields the worst mathematical reasoning, while the highest-perplexity configuration preserves it. This does not occur under standard routing (e.g., Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct), where perplexity and accuracy degrade together. Pruning under over-dispersed routing also exposes a capability trade-off in which no single scoring metric dominates: activation-aware scoring preserves mathematical reasoning but severely degrades knowledge-intensive science (an 18-point gap on GPQA), whereas frequency-based scoring exhibits the reverse. We propose Minimax Expert Score Allocation (MESA), a domain-aware method that iteratively boosts importance scores for experts serving whichever domain is currently worst-affected, minimizing worst-case domain degradation rather than average accuracy. At 25% expert pruning MESA achieves the smallest worst-case degradation across domains, outperforming activation-aware baselines on 7 of 11 benchmarks at a correspondingly reduced memory footprint, and it generalizes to gpt-oss-120B, Gemma-4-26B-A4B, and OLMoE-1B-7B. Our results indicate that over-dispersed routing is a qualitatively distinct pruning regime in which standard assumptions fail, and that recognizing it is a prerequisite for principled expert pruning of load-balanced MoE models.
summary_zh: 专家剪枝通过移除路由模块识别出的低重要性专家，降低专家混合（MoE）模型的内存占用与服务成本，该方法的前提假设是路由输出的概率值可以可靠表征专家的重要性。本文发现，在训练阶段采用激进负载均衡策略形成的过度分散路由场景下，该假设不再成立：此时令牌几乎均匀分布在所有专家上，重要性信号完全失效。在该场景下，困惑度无法预测下游任务精度：在gpt-oss-20B模型上，困惑度最低的剪枝配置对应的数学推理性能最差，而困惑度最高的剪枝配置反而可以保留最优数学推理性能。该现象不会出现在Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct这类采用标准路由策略的模型上，这类模型的困惑度与精度会同步下降。过度分散路由下的剪枝还会暴露能力权衡问题，不存在单一最优评分指标：激活感知评分可保留数学推理能力，但会导致知识密集型科学任务性能严重下降（在GPQA基准上性能差距达18个点），而基于访问频率的评分表现出完全相反的特性。本文提出Minimax Expert Score Allocation（MESA，极小极大专家分数分配），这是一种领域感知方法，可迭代提升当前受影响最严重领域对应专家的重要性分数，最小化最差情况领域性能下降而非优化平均精度。在剪枝25%专家的设置下，MESA实现了跨领域最小的最差性能下降，在11个基准中的7个上性能优于激活感知基线，同时内存占用更低，且该方法可泛化到gpt-oss-120B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B和OLMoE-1B-7B等模型。研究结果表明过度分散路由是一类特性完全不同的剪枝场景，该场景下传统假设全部失效，识别该场景是对经过负载均衡的MoE模型开展合理专家剪枝的前提条件。

title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
title_zh: HarvestBench：衡量大语言模型智能体是否愿意为避免伤害动物付出成本
authors: Jasmine Brazilek, Miles Tidmarsh, Matthias Endres, Anshuman Singh, Jeremiah Miller
abstract: Benchmarks for the side effects an agent causes on the way to a goal already exist, but HarvestBench is the first to put a price on avoiding the side effect and to name that side effect as a living creature. It is a farm simulation: LLM sub-agents drive a crew of two tractors through a cooperative corn harvest, with animals in the field. The environment is a reinforcement learning gridworld, every decision is made without memory, and the harm is never named in the goal. When an animal blocks a tractor's route the autopilot stops and asks the model whether to drive on, at no fuel cost, or swerve around it for a posted fuel price. Kills are compared against two controls: rocks, which damage the tractor and are hit under 1% of the time by every model, and hay bales, which are harmless and not alive. Models can also take crops from the neighbor's field instead of their own, a second test of what they treat as moral.Across nine models and 7,201 priced decisions, 3,951 involved an animal rather than a hay bale or a rock. Kill rates range from 0.4% to 98.8%, with Terra and Sol the most merciful and GPT-4o-mini the most cruel, and they are not ordered by capability. Four of six models were sensitive to price at the 5% level, with elasticities from 0.09 to 1.69. All nine drove over wild animals more often than farmed animals on the default map, and the direction held at every map geometry in every model with room to move. The briefing mattered most: under the morality briefing the kill rate was under 6% in five of six reasoning models, and removing it raised the kill rate above 84% in all six.HarvestBench uses no LLM grader. The scorer counts events in the game log, so it is fully reproducible, and it measures what a model will pay to avoid harm rather than what it says about harm.
summary_zh: 现有基准已可评估智能体在实现目标过程中引发的副作用，但HarvestBench是首个为规避副作用设置明确成本、且将副作用对象设定为活体生物的基准测试集。该基准为农场模拟场景：大语言模型子智能体操控两台拖拉机协同完成玉米收割任务，田野中分布有动物。环境采用强化学习网格世界设定，所有决策均在无历史记忆的条件下做出，且目标描述中从未提及伤害相关表述。当动物阻挡拖拉机路线时，自动导航系统会停止运行，询问模型选择无燃料成本直接碾过，还是支付标注的燃料成本绕行。实验设置两类对照对象：岩石会损坏拖拉机，所有模型碾过岩石的概率均低于1%；干草堆是无生命的无害物体。模型还可以选择从邻居的田地而非自己的田地收割作物，构成第二类道德倾向测试。实验覆盖9个模型共7201次带成本决策，其中3951次决策的阻挡对象为动物而非干草堆或岩石。模型的动物碾过率分布在0.4%到98.8%之间，Terra和Sol模型表现出最强的护生倾向，GPT-4o-mini表现最差，且该性能排序与模型通用能力排序无关。6个模型中有4个在5%显著性水平下表现出对成本的敏感性，需求弹性分布在0.09到1.69之间。在默认地图设置下，所有9个模型碾过野生动物的概率都高于农场动物，且该倾向在所有模型、所有可通行的地图几何结构中都保持一致。提示词说明的影响最为显著：在道德导向提示下，6个推理模型中有5个的动物碾过率低于6%，移除道德提示后所有6个模型的碾过率都上升至84%以上。HarvestBench无需使用大语言模型作为评分器，评分器仅统计游戏日志中的事件，完全可复现，可直接衡量模型愿意为规避伤害付出的实际成本，而非模型在文本中声称的伤害规避态度。

title: GRACE: Graph-Grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine for Expert-in-the-Loop Knowledge Expansion
title_zh: GRACE：面向专家在环知识扩展的图基反射式智能体副驾驶引擎
authors: John Seon Keun Yi, Joshua R. Minot, Dokyun Lee
abstract: Large language models deployed in high-stakes settings frequently generate plausible but ungrounded claims. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines offer limited remedy, since they retrieve isolated passages without tracking cross-document evidence relationships or quantifying uncertainty. We introduce GRACE (Graph-grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine), a framework that deconstructs LLM responses into atomic claims and grounds them against trusted knowledge priors within a weighted bipartite graph. Edge weights encode the closeness of each claim to the priors, enabling weighted centrality analysis that classifies claims as Grounded, Refuted, or Boundary. Such classification identifies not just hallucinations but also novel or contested claims at the frontier of the model's knowledge. To efficiently allocate human or agent resources, we formulate a Return on Attention (RoA) objective that defers a claim to expert review only when its priority-weighted uncertainty exceeds the cost of verification. Claims verified by experts are promoted to new evidence anchors, closing a validator-LLM evolutionary loop that expands the knowledge base across iterations. We evaluate GRACE across multiple language models and on datasets spanning both general and domain-specific knowledge. Our results show that our knowledge base serves as a reliable foundation for retrieval that outperforms RAG baselines, and that the RoA framework efficiently selects valuable boundary knowledge for expert verification. These findings demonstrate that graph-structured representations combined with expert-in-the-loop verification can mitigate hallucination at the system level rather than at the generation level. Code available atthis https URL
summary_zh: 部署在高风险场景下的大语言模型经常生成看似合理但无事实依据的论断。标准检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）流水线的改善效果十分有限，因为其仅能检索孤立段落，无法追踪跨文档的证据关联，也无法对不确定性进行量化。本文提出GRACE（Graph-grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine，图基反射式智能体副驾驶引擎）框架，该框架将大语言模型的响应拆解为原子化论断，并在加权二分图中对照可信的先验知识为这些论断锚定事实依据。边权重编码了每个论断与先验知识的接近程度，支持加权中心性分析，可将论断分类为已证实、已驳斥或边界类。该分类不仅能识别幻觉，还能定位模型知识前沿的新颖或存在争议的论断。为了高效分配人力或智能体资源，我们定义了注意力回报率（Return on Attention, RoA）目标，仅当某一论断的优先级加权不确定性超过验证成本时，才将其提交给专家审核。经专家验证的论断会升级为新的证据锚点，形成验证者-大语言模型的进化闭环，在多轮迭代中不断扩展知识库。我们在多个大语言模型、覆盖通用知识和领域特定知识的数据集上对GRACE进行了评估。结果表明，我们构建的知识库可作为可靠的检索基础，性能优于RAG基线，且RoA框架能够高效筛选有价值的边界知识供专家验证。研究结果证明，图结构表示结合专家在环验证可在系统层面而非生成层面缓解幻觉问题。代码可访问对应https URL获取。

title: REFINE: LLM Refinement over Budgeted Text-Attributed Graphs for Personalized Medical Concept Representation
title_zh: REFINE：面向个性化医疗概念表示的预算约束文本属性图大语言模型优化框架
authors: Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao
abstract: Learning rich medical concept representations is essential for EHR prediction. Text-attributed knowledge graphs (TKGs) provide a natural foundation by organizing heterogeneous medical relations together with textual semantics. However, most existing encoders process concepts uniformly across patients, despite the fact that a code's meaning and predictive value depend on patient-specific clinical context and trajectory. Learning patient-personalized concept representations from TKGs introduces two key challenges: (1) deciding how much KG context to incorporate for each observed code, and (2) aligning semantic information with the patient-specific relational structure. We propose REFINE, a KG-aware budgeted LLM graph refinement framework for patient-personalized medical concept encoding. Starting from a global TKG, REFINE constructs patient-specific temporal graphs. A sequential reinforcement learning policy selects a personalized KG expansion budget for each observed code. The resulting patient graph is processed by a heterogeneous GNN to capture relation-aware structural dependencies, while a frozen LLM uses graph-aware soft prompts to semantically refine concept representations. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV show that REFINE consistently improves diverse EHR backbones, outperforms strong baselines, and demonstrates robust gains across component ablation, KG selection, and data insufficiency.
summary_zh: 学习丰富的医疗概念表示对电子健康记录（Electronic Health Record, EHR）预测至关重要。文本属性知识图（Text-attributed Knowledge Graph, TKG）通过将异质医疗关系与文本语义组织在一起，为该任务提供了天然基础。但现有大多数编码器对所有患者的概念采用统一处理方式，忽略了医疗编码的含义和预测价值依赖于患者特定的临床上下文和诊疗轨迹这一事实。从TKG中学习患者个性化的概念表示存在两大核心挑战：（1）如何为每个观测到的医疗编码确定纳入多少知识图上下文；（2）如何将语义信息与患者特定的关系结构对齐。本文提出REFINE框架，这是一种具备知识图感知能力的预算约束大语言模型图优化框架，用于患者个性化医疗概念编码。REFINE从全局TKG出发，构建患者特定的时序图，通过序贯强化学习策略为每个观测到的医疗编码选择个性化的知识图扩展预算。生成的患者图由异质图神经网络（GNN）处理，以捕获关系感知的结构依赖，同时冻结的大语言模型使用图感知软提示对概念表示进行语义优化。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV数据集上的实验结果表明，REFINE可持续提升各类EHR骨干模型的性能，优于当前最优基线，且在组件消融、知识图选择和数据不足场景下均表现出稳定的性能增益。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Cross-Lingual Consistency Enhancement Methods in Multilingual Language Models
title_zh: 多语言语言模型跨语言一致性增强方法的系统性评估
authors: Jirui Qi, Mingyang Wang, Hinrich Schütze, Raquel Fernández, Arianna Bisazza
abstract: Multilingual language models often produce inconsistent answers to semantically equivalent questions across languages, motivating methods to improve cross-lingual consistency (CLC). However, existing methods are typically evaluated using different models, tasks, and protocols, leaving their relative strengths unclear. In this work, we present a unified evaluation of representative CLC-enhancement methods for question answering, spanning inference-time interventions and post-training approaches across three model families and three closed-form benchmarks. The results show that post-training methods are generally more reliable, with direct distribution alignment consistently improving CLC across all model-dataset combinations, while other methods are more sensitive to answer format and the breadth of language coverage. Notably, cross-domain transfer is limited unless source and target tasks share similar output formats. We further investigate whether CLC enhancement hurts models' ability to respond differently *when needed*, that is, when asked culture-dependent questions. Across two benchmarks of culturally diverse question answering, we find no systematic degradation in controlled closed-form evaluation, whereas open-ended generation reveals occasional accuracy reductions, particularly for non-English responses. Our work highlights the need to evaluate CLC enhancement for both cross-domain robustness and culturally appropriate variation, informing future work in post-training and benchmark development.
summary_zh: 多语言语言模型针对语义等价的跨语言问题经常生成不一致的回答，学界因此提出了多种提升跨语言一致性（Cross-Lingual Consistency, CLC）的方法。但现有方法通常在不同的模型、任务和评估协议下开展测试，其相对性能优劣尚不明确。本文针对问答场景下的代表性跨语言一致性增强方法开展统一评估，覆盖推理时干预策略和训练后优化方法，在3个模型家族和3个闭式基准数据集上完成测试。结果表明，训练后优化方法整体可靠性更高，其中直接分布对齐方法在所有模型-数据集组合下均可持续提升跨语言一致性，其余方法则对回答格式和语言覆盖广度更为敏感。值得注意的是，除非源任务和目标任务的输出格式相似，否则跨域迁移效果十分有限。我们进一步探究跨语言一致性增强是否会损害模型在“必要场景”下的差异化响应能力，即面对文化相关问题时的响应能力。在两个覆盖多元文化的问答基准上，我们发现受控闭式评估场景下模型性能未出现系统性下降，但开放式生成场景下偶尔会出现准确率降低的情况，非英语响应的该问题尤为明显。本研究表明，跨语言一致性增强方法需要同时兼顾跨域鲁棒性和文化适配性差异，可为后续训练后优化方法和基准数据集开发工作提供参考。

title: You Really Didn't Get That? Benchmarking Social Pragmatic Inference for Indirect and Playful Chinese Online Comments
title_zh: 你真的没理解吗？面向中文网络评论间接戏谑表达的社交语用推理基准测试
authors: Shiwei Hong, Junjie Ma, Emma Jiren Wang, Ethan Z. Rong, Siying Hu 等 (8 人)
abstract: Chinese online comments often convey social meaning through indirect and playful language that is hard to interpret without context. Existing evaluations largely organize items around predefined phenomena or controlled pragmatic categories, leaving open whether models can distinguish plausible readings of what a naturally occurring comment is doing in a particular exchange. We introduce a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can recover such situated pragmatic meanings. From more than 200,000 public Chinese social media interaction records, we construct 4,735 human-validated diagnostic items, each pairing a target comment with reconstructed preceding context and plausible misreadings. We evaluate eight LLMs as both question writers and solvers in a cross-writer setting. The task is challenging: the strongest model achieves 81.42% leave-writer-out accuracy. Across all eight models, the mean leave-writer-out accuracy is 68.70% while human accuracy was 90.8%. Case analysis shows that models often recognize broad irony or playfulness while misidentifying the mechanism or interactional move.
summary_zh: 中文网络评论常通过间接、戏谑的语言传递社交含义，脱离上下文很难解读。现有相关评估大多围绕预定义的语言现象或受控语用类别构建测试集，无法验证模型能否区分自然生成的评论在特定交互场景下的合理解读。本文推出了一个基准测试集，用于评估大语言模型能否还原这类场景化的语用含义。我们从超过20万条公开中文社交媒体交互记录中，构建了4735条经人工验证的诊断式测试样本，每条样本均配对目标评论、重构的前置上下文以及若干合理的误读选项。我们在跨作者设置下，将8个大语言模型分别作为题目生成者和答题者开展评估。该任务难度较高：性能最优的模型留作者外准确率仅为81.42%，所有8个模型的平均留作者外准确率为68.70%，而人类的准确率可达90.8%。案例分析显示，模型通常能识别出宽泛的反讽或戏谑属性，但会误判其背后的作用机制或交互意图。

title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
title_zh: 企业语言模型（CLM）：将隐性碎片化企业知识转化为自主可审计可执行的企业智能层
authors: Fabricio C. Avini, Guilherme Trez
abstract: Enterprise AI deployments fail not from model inadequacy, but because organizations lack a structured substrate encoding how they decide, negotiate, and execute. Generic LLMs carry no firm-specific ontological priors; RAG remains brittle, with no path to executable action; static playbooks encode logic but cannot reason or adapt. This demands an architecture treating tacit-knowledge capture, ontological grounding, sovereign deployment, and auditable actuation as co-designed from the start. This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework transforming a firm's structured, unstructured, multimodal, and tacit knowledge into an ontology-grounded enterprise foundation upon which reasoning and governed execution are composed. CLM has five capability planes and four architectural pillars: a Neurosymbolic Mesh coupling generative models with a knowledge graph; a Skill Graph where reusable tactics, personas, objections, and goals are typed and composed; Living Digital Twins modeling functional areas as reasoning surrogates; and a Deep Security Layer enforcing sovereignty, traceability, and human oversight. A Spec-as-Code paradigm bridges grounded intent and executable artifact. CLM is one instantiation of this foundation-centric class. Four contributions follow: CLM is defined as a distinct object of study; the Skill Graph is introduced for compositional explainability by construction; the Wisdom Listener effect is proposed, whereby tacit-capable foundations compound in value with use, connecting to dynamic capabilities and organizational learning; and evidence from a JCI-accredited tertiary hospital in Brazil instantiates three of the six maturity stages under LGPD.
summary_zh: 企业AI部署失败的原因往往不是模型性能不足，而是组织缺乏可编码自身决策、协商和执行逻辑的结构化基础底座。通用大语言模型不具备企业专属的本体先验知识；检索增强生成（RAG）方案鲁棒性不足，无法落地为可执行动作；静态操作手册可编码逻辑但不具备推理和自适应能力。这就要求架构设计从初始阶段就将隐性知识捕获、本体对齐、自主部署和可审计执行作为协同设计的核心要素。本文提出企业语言模型（Corporate Language Model, CLM）框架，可将企业的结构化、非结构化、多模态和隐性知识转化为基于本体的企业基础底座，在此基础上可组合实现推理和受管控的执行能力。CLM包含5个能力平面和4个架构支柱：将生成模型与知识图耦合的神经符号网格、对可复用策略、角色、异议和目标进行类型定义与组合的技能图、将功能领域建模为推理代理的活数字孪生体，以及保障自主性、可追溯性和人类监督的深度安全层。“规范即代码”范式打通了对齐后的意图与可执行产物之间的链路。CLM是这类以基础底座为核心的架构的一个具体实现。本文的核心贡献包括：将CLM定义为一类独立的研究对象；提出技能图以实现构造层面的可组合可解释性；提出“智慧监听者”效应，即具备隐性知识处理能力的基础底座的价值会随使用不断累积，与动态能力和组织学习机制形成关联；基于巴西一家通过JCI认证的三级医院的落地实践，验证了LGPD法规下6个成熟度阶段中的3个阶段。

title: Why Better Models Can Create Riskier Systems: Evidence from LLM Agents in Financial Markets
title_zh: 性能更优的模型为何会催生风险更高的系统：来自金融市场大语言模型智能体的证据
authors: Jillian Ross, Eric So, Zoe De Simone, Charles Pozniak, Andrew W. Lo
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being deployed at scale in consequential real-world systems, from financial markets to content moderation to hiring. We show that improving individual model capability can degrade rather than improve system-level outcomes. We hypothesize that shared training and architectures can lead more capable LLMs to behave more similarly, creating correlated actions that do not diversify away. We develop a general framework showing how this correlation creates a non-diversifiable risk floor and test its predictions in financial markets using an agent-based simulation with LLM traders of varying general-purpose capability. We find that: (1) frontier LLMs exhibit significantly correlated behavior that increases with capability; (2) when their shared reasoning is accurate, increasing agent participation reduces market-level risk; and (3) when agents share a common misinformation environment, the same correlated behavior becomes a liability. Together, these results identify a capability paradox: improving individual models does not necessarily produce better system-level outcomes. Whether the same dynamics arise in other domains is an open empirical question.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正在金融市场、内容审核、人员招聘等关键现实场景中大规模部署。本文研究发现，提升单个模型的能力反而可能降低而非优化系统层面的整体表现。我们提出假设：共享的训练数据和模型架构会让能力更强的大语言模型表现出更高的行为相似性，催生无法通过分散化消除的关联性行为。我们构建了通用框架，证明这类关联会形成不可分散的风险底线，并通过基于智能体的仿真实验，使用通用能力不同的大语言模型交易员在金融市场场景下验证了相关假设。研究结果表明：（1）前沿大语言模型的行为存在显著相关性，且相关性随模型能力提升而增强；（2）当智能体的共享推理逻辑准确时，提升智能体的参与度会降低市场层面的风险；（3）当智能体处于共同的错误信息环境中时，这类关联性行为反而会成为风险来源。上述结果共同揭示了能力悖论：提升单个模型的性能并不一定能优化系统层面的整体表现。这类规律是否在其他领域同样成立，仍是有待验证的实证问题。

title: Blockchain-Enabled Secure Logging for Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms: Evaluation of the Greek eSEND and myDATA Tax Systems
title_zh: 支持区块链的财政电子机制安全日志记录：希腊eSEND与myDATA税务系统评估
authors: Panagiotis Mavridis, Anargyros Baklezos, Christos Nikolopoulos
abstract: This paper analyzes the implementation of blockchain-based integrity mechanisms in Greek Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms (FEMs) and the central tax information system eSEND. The study examines the cryptographic architecture of fiscal devices, including Electronic Cash Registers, Fiscal Printers, Fiscal Signing Machines, and FEMAS devices, which implement double or triple hash-chain structures to ensure transaction immutability. The transmission protocol between fiscal devices and the central database is also evaluated with respect to encryption, sequential validation, and blockchain verification. In contrast, the architecture of Electronic Invoicing Provider Services and the myDATA central platform is analyzed, highlighting the absence of blockchain-based integrity guarantees. The comparison demonstrates that hardware-based fiscal mechanisms provide stronger guarantees for transaction completeness and tamper resistance than purely software-based invoicing infrastructures. The findings highlight architectural weaknesses in the current e-invoicing framework and propose improvements for ensuring transaction integrity in digital tax ecosystems.
summary_zh: 本文分析了区块链完整性机制在希腊财政电子机制（Fiscal Electronic Mechanisms, FEM）及中央税务信息系统eSEND中的实现情况。研究考察了各类财政设备（包括电子收银机、财政打印机、财政签名机和FEMAS设备）的密码学架构，这类设备采用双重或三重哈希链结构保障交易不可篡改。本文还从加密、顺序验证和区块链校验三个维度，评估了财政设备与中央数据库之间的传输协议。同时，本文分析了电子发票服务商体系和myDATA中央平台的架构，指出其缺失基于区块链的完整性保障机制。对比结果表明，硬件级财政机制在交易完整性和防篡改能力上的保障强度远高于纯软件架构的电子发票基础设施。研究结果明确了当前电子发票框架的架构缺陷，并为数字税务生态下保障交易完整性提出了改进方案。

title: Adapting from Downturns: Prediction of Long-Term Conversational-Skill Development in Mental-Health Crisis Counselors
title_zh: 从挫折中自适应：心理健康危机咨询师长期会话技能发展预测
authors: Vivian Nguyen, Lillian Lee, Elizabeth A. Olson, Cristian Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil
abstract: How do people learn to become better conversationalists? This question is especially important in the context of mental-health counseling, where conversational skills are essential, yet volunteer counselors often have limited access to supervision and structured feedback. Understanding how counselors develop their ability to steer conversations toward positive outcomes -- and identifying early which counselors are (not) on track to improve -- can help prioritize support for the counselors who need it most.In this work, we introduce the task of predicting, early in a conversationalist's career, whether they will eventually improve at steering conversations toward positive outcomes, and demonstrate the feasibility of this task in the case of volunteer mental-health crisis counselors. Our central insight is that people may struggle with particular kinds of moments in a conversation, and that what is especially revealing of their likelihood of future improvement is how they learn to handle those moments over time. We operationalize this insight by designing a method that identifies the types of moments a counselor initially struggles with, captures how they adapt their response when they re-encounter similar moments in subsequent conversations, and learns which early adaptations predict improvement months or even years later. While this future-prediction task is challenging, our counselor-adaptation approach yields better results than baselines that learn directly from the conversation transcript.
summary_zh: 人们如何通过学习提升会话能力？该问题在心理健康咨询场景下尤为重要，因为会话技能是咨询师的核心能力，但志愿咨询师通常很难获得足够的督导和结构化反馈。理解咨询师如何逐步掌握引导会话走向积极结果的能力，以及早期识别哪些咨询师有望（或无望）提升能力，可帮助我们为最需要支持的咨询师优先分配资源。本文提出了一项新任务：在会话从业者职业生涯早期预测其最终能否掌握引导会话走向积极结果的能力，并以志愿心理健康危机咨询师为研究场景验证了该任务的可行性。我们的核心洞见是：人们可能会在会话的特定类型节点上遇到困难，而最能反映其未来提升可能性的特征，是他们在后续会话中再次遇到同类节点时调整应对方式的学习过程。基于该洞见，我们设计了一种方法，可识别咨询师最初难以处理的节点类型，捕捉其在后续会话中再次遇到同类节点时的响应调整模式，并学习哪些早期自适应行为可预测数月甚至数年后的能力提升。尽管该未来预测任务难度较高，但我们提出的咨询师自适应方法的性能优于直接从会话文本学习的基线方法。

title: A Removal Based Approach to Improve LLM Faithfulness at Test-Time
title_zh: 测试阶段通过移除策略提升大语言模型忠实度的方法
authors: Qinglan Luo, S M A Nahian, John Guttag, S. Mazdak Abulnaga, Katie Matton
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for consequential decisions, making their explanations an important tool for auditing model behavior. Unfortunately, these explanations can be unfaithful, failing to reflect the actual reasoning underlying the model's decisions. We consider a setting in which an LLM provides both an answer and an explanation in response to a question. We identify two distinct dimensions of unfaithful explanations: incompleteness, meaning that the explanation omits factors that influence the answer, and unsoundness, meaning that the explanation cites factors that did not influence the model's answer. Existing approaches to improving LLM faithfulness include training-time methods, which require access to model weights and extensive computational resources, and test-time methods that largely focus on addressing unsoundness. We introduce a test-time approach that directly targets incompleteness. We remove from the input the concepts not credited in the model's explanation and re-query the model on the reduced input. This eliminates unmentioned influences while preserving the influence of mentioned concepts. Across two datasets, multiple model families, and two independent faithfulness metrics, our approach improves explanation faithfulness compared to both standard prompting and prompting to encourage faithfulness. Our method is model-agnostic and can be applied at inference time without modifying model parameters, providing a flexible mechanism for reducing hidden influences and improving the reliability and safety of LLM-assisted decision making.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于高利害决策场景，其生成的解释已成为审计模型行为的核心工具。但遗憾的是，这类解释往往不具备忠实性，无法反映模型决策背后的实际推理过程。本文研究的场景为大语言模型针对问题同时输出答案和对应解释。我们识别出不忠实解释的两个独立维度：不完备性，即解释遗漏了实际影响答案的因素；不可靠性，即解释引用了实际上并未影响模型答案的因素。现有提升大语言模型忠实度的方法分为两类：训练时方法，需要访问模型权重且计算资源消耗大；测试时方法，目前大多仅聚焦于解决不可靠性问题。本文提出一种测试时方法，直接针对不完备性问题进行优化：我们从输入中移除模型解释中未提及的所有概念，再基于精简后的输入重新向模型发起查询。该方法可消除所有未被提及的因素的影响，同时保留解释中提及的概念的作用。在两个数据集、多个模型家族、两个独立的忠实度评估指标上的实验结果表明，与标准提示和面向提升忠实度的提示方法相比，本文提出的方法可显著提升解释的忠实度。该方法与模型无关，无需修改模型参数即可在推理阶段应用，为减少隐藏因素的影响、提升大语言模型辅助决策的可靠性和安全性提供了灵活的实现方案。

title: Data-Driven Learning of Unknown Nonlinear Differential Equations Using Functional Analysis
title_zh: 基于泛函分析的未知非线性微分方程数据驱动学习方法
authors: Seyyed Shaho Alaviani, Yongzhi Qu, Gregory W. Vogl
abstract: In this paper, the problem of data-driven discovery of nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) is recast, and a new interpretable machine learning (ML) method is proposed. The proposed method aims to learn the unknown vector field of nonlinear dynamics without prior knowledge of the system's physics from only one single state trajectory's data. The proposed method has two fundamental differences with existing methods: 1) the formulation presented in this method is derived based on Functional Analysis and Operator Theory, and 2) the cost function is constructed in the function space as a distance between two functions as an integral, instead of the discrete-sum of errors used in existing ML approaches. An incremental learning algorithm is proposed to learn the unknown vector field to handle new training samples in an online manner. The proposed method can discover the unknown vector field from both forced and unforced autonomous and non-autonomous (or time-varying) dynamical systems. The proposed method is able to simultaneously discover unknown external forces as a function of time and unknown underlying dynamics. Finally, numerical examples are given to demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 本文对非线性常微分方程（Ordinary Differential Equation, ODE）的数据驱动发现问题进行了重新建模，提出了一种新的可解释机器学习方法。该方法仅需单条状态轨迹数据，即可在无需预先掌握系统物理知识的前提下，学习非线性动力学的未知向量场。该方法与现有方法存在两大核心差异：1）方法的公式体系基于泛函分析和算子理论推导得到；2）代价函数在函数空间中构建，以两个函数之间的积分距离作为优化目标，而非现有机器学习方法采用的误差离散求和形式。本文提出了一种增量学习算法，可在线学习未知向量场，适配新增训练样本。该方法可从受迫/非受迫、自治/非自治（时变）动力学系统中发现未知向量场，还可同时发现作为时间函数的未知外力和未知底层动力学规律。最后，本文通过数值算例验证了所提方法的优势。

title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
title_zh: Iris：攀登搜索能力前沿
authors: Ziyuan Liu, Hengqi Liu, Zichuan Wang, Yang Qin, Jiachen Liang 等 (9 人)
abstract: We present Iris-mini and Iris-pro, two search agents trained at the 35B-A3B and 397B-A17B scales, together with the data pipeline and training recipe behind them. Tasks are reverse-constructed from the hyperlink structure of a web corpus: we author multi-hop chains over an entity graph distilled from a seed page and its out-links, rewrite every non-answer entity into a descriptive reference so that no clue can be resolved by string matching, and admit only questions that a reference model fails closed-book yet solves once the supporting evidence is supplied. These questions are then turned into trajectories, which are filtered at both the trajectory and the turn level before SFT. The policy is then optimized by RL against live search, with the reward judge and the observation summarizer served inside the training cluster, and with over-long rollouts interrupted at the request level and resumed from their committed prefix at the next step. We alternate the two stages in a procedure we call SFT-RL climbing, returning the hardest solved and most efficient rollouts of each RL round to the next supervised pass. Because inference-time context management is worth more on these benchmarks than most reported differences between systems, we evaluate every benchmark both with and without it, holding the tool set, the context limit, and the judge fixed. All results come from a single ReAct agent, with no sub-agents and no test-time verification. With management enabled, on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, DeepSearchQA, and HLE the two models reach $82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3$ and $88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4$, the strongest overall results among open-source search agents in their respective parameter ranges. We plan to release the model weights together with the complete recipe for data construction, training, and evaluation.
summary_zh: 本文提出Iris-mini和Iris-pro两款搜索智能体，分别在35B-A3B和397B-A17B规模下完成训练，同时公开了其背后的数据流水线与训练方案。研究从网页语料库的超链接结构反向构建任务：我们从种子页面及其外链中提炼实体图，在实体图上构建多跳推理链，将所有非答案实体重写为描述性引用，确保无法通过字符串匹配得到任何线索，且仅保留参考模型在闭卷模式下无法解答、但提供支撑证据后即可正确求解的问题。这些问题随后被转换为轨迹，在监督微调（SFT）前分别在轨迹层级和对话轮次层级完成过滤。之后策略通过针对实时搜索的强化学习（RL）完成优化，奖励评判器和观测摘要器均部署在训练集群内部，超长时间的轨迹展开会在请求层级中断，并在下一步从已提交的前缀处恢复执行。我们将上述两个阶段交替执行的流程称为SFT-RL攀登法，每轮强化学习得到的最难求解且效率最高的展开轨迹会被送入下一轮监督训练阶段。由于在相关基准测试集上，推理时上下文管理的价值远高于已报道的不同系统之间的大多数性能差异，我们在固定工具集、上下文限制和评判器的前提下，分别在启用和禁用推理时上下文管理两种设置下对所有基准进行评估。所有结果均来自单个ReAct（推理行动协同）智能体，未使用任何子智能体，也未引入测试时验证机制。启用上下文管理后，两款模型在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、DeepSearchQA和HLE基准上的得分分别达到82.2/84.8/86.9/52.3和88.6/85.1/92.9/56.4，是对应参数范围内开源搜索智能体中的最优综合性能。我们计划发布模型权重，以及完整的数据构建、训练和评估方案。

title: Abstraction Agent
title_zh: 抽象智能体
authors: Boning Li, Longbo Huang
abstract: Information abstraction, which groups strategically similar private states into a tractable number of buckets, is essential for scaling game-solving algorithms to large imperfect-information games. Constructing effective abstractions, however, has traditionally required domain-specific evaluators such as hand-strength calculators or equity estimators, which demand expert knowledge and engineering effort and are unavailable for most less-studied games. We propose the Abstraction Agent, a zero-shot pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to discover continuous strategic features from a natural-language game description, score private states on these features, and cluster them into abstraction buckets, without any game-specific evaluator, training data, or game-tree traversal during abstraction construction. The pipeline runs in four phases: feature discovery with calibration anchors, batched private-state scoring, correlation-based feature selection, and $k$-means clustering. The resulting abstractions reduce lifted-strategy exploitability by up to 62% relative to an expected-hand-strength baseline on heads-up no-limit Texas hold'em (HUNL) turn endgames, and beat a scalar rank baseline at every granularity on ROVER Trials, an original game absent from any pretraining corpus. Beyond these quantitative benchmarks, the pipeline transfers with unchanged prompts to four-card Pot-Limit Omaha, HUNL preflop and flop, and Riichi Mahjong, where the discovered features track each game's recognized strategic concepts. This is structured knowledge elicitation: converting implicit strategic knowledge in LLM parameters into explicit numerical features for downstream algorithmic computation. The code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 信息抽象是指将策略层面相似的私有状态分组为可处理数量的桶单元，是将博弈求解算法扩展到大型不完美信息博弈的核心技术。然而传统上构建有效抽象需要领域专属评估器（例如手牌强度计算器或胜率估计器），这类工具需要专业知识和工程投入，且在大多数研究较少的博弈中无法获取。本文提出Abstraction Agent（抽象智能体），这是一个零样本流水线，利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言形式的博弈描述中发现连续的策略特征，基于这些特征对私有状态打分，并将其聚类为抽象桶，在抽象构建过程中不需要任何博弈专属评估器、训练数据或博弈树遍历操作。该流水线分为四个阶段：带校准锚点的特征发现、批量私有状态打分、基于相关性的特征选择以及k均值聚类。在单挑无限注德州扑克（HUNL）转牌残局场景下，所得抽象相对于预期手牌强度基线可将提升策略的可利用性最高降低62%；在未出现在任何预训练语料中的原创游戏ROVER Trials上，该抽象在所有粒度层级下的表现均优于标度排名基线。除上述定量基准外，该流水线无需修改提示词即可迁移到四卡底池限注奥马哈扑克、HUNL翻前与翻牌场景以及日本麻将场景，其发现的特征能够匹配各博弈公认的策略概念。该方法属于结构化知识提取技术：将大语言模型参数中隐含的策略知识转换为显式的数值特征，供下游算法计算使用。相关代码已发布在对应公开链接。

title: Data-Optimized Contingency Screening: A Machine Learning Approach to Power System Security
title_zh: 数据优化的应急筛选：面向电力系统安全的机器学习方法
authors: Joshua Salako, Folajimi Osikomaiya, Olakorede Olamiju
abstract: Ensuring the security of the power system is essential for stability and reliability, especially in the event of disruption. Effective classification of contingency in power systems enables proactive decision-making and mitigates large-scale breakdowns and failures. This study explores the use of machine learning algorithms to classify security levels of contingencies in power systems into safe, moderate or severe classes. For this approach, Newton-Raphson load flow method extracts system data from contingency scenarios, using Overall Performance Index (OPI) as safety measure. For data pre-processing, Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique (SMOTE) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used to address class imbalance and reduce dimensionality, respectively. K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Random Forest (RF) and Support Vector Machines (SVM) is trained and evaluated on datasets generated through N-k contingency scenarios for k equal 1, 2, and 3 on IEEE-14 and IEEE-30 bus systems using four hybrid pre-processing configurations: normalized, SMOTE-balanced, PCA-transformed, and a combined SMOTE PCA-transformed. Performance is assessed by precision, recall and F1 score, with priority given to the severe contingency classes. The RF achieved the highest F1 scores of 0.97 in IEEE-30 and 0.86 in IEEE-14, SVM benefits significantly from PCA and improves the accuracy of the classification, while KNN is best suited for SMOTE and PCA conversion. The findings show that PCA contributes more than SMOTE to the overall performance of the model. However, SMOTE improves recall but can introduce false positives and is therefore a compromise of accuracy. This study highlights machine learning as a scalable and powerful alternative to traditional contingency analysis, which improves the assessment of security in real time.
summary_zh: 保障电力系统安全是维持系统稳定性与可靠性的核心要求，在发生扰动时尤为关键。对电力系统中的突发事件进行有效分类，能够支撑主动决策，避免大规模停电和故障发生。本研究探索使用机器学习算法将电力系统突发事件的安全等级划分为安全、中等、严重三类。该方法通过牛顿-拉夫逊潮流法从突发事件场景中提取系统数据，使用综合性能指数（OPI）作为安全度量指标。数据预处理阶段分别采用合成少数类过采样技术（SMOTE）和主成分分析（PCA）解决类别不平衡问题与降维。研究在IEEE-14节点和IEEE-30节点系统上针对k=1、2、3的N-k突发事件场景生成数据集，使用四类混合预处理配置（归一化、SMOTE平衡、PCA变换、SMOTE与PCA联合变换）对K近邻（KNN）、随机森林（RF）和支持向量机（SVM）三类模型进行训练与评估，评估指标采用精确率、召回率和F1值，优先级向严重突发事件类别倾斜。结果显示，随机森林在IEEE-30节点系统上取得最高0.97的F1值，在IEEE-14节点系统上取得最高0.86的F1值；支持向量机的性能从PCA中获益显著，分类准确率明显提升；K近邻则最适配SMOTE和PCA变换处理。研究结果表明，相较于SMOTE，PCA对模型整体性能的贡献更大，但SMOTE能够提升召回率，不过可能引入误报，属于对准确率的折中选择。本研究证明机器学习是传统突发事件分析的可扩展高性能替代方案，能够提升实时安全评估能力。

title: Harbor Adapters and Harbor-Index: Infrastructure and a Curated Meta-Dataset for Large-Scale Agentic Evaluation
title_zh: Harbor适配器与Harbor-Index：面向大规模智能体评估的基础设施与精选元数据集
authors: Lin Shi, Haowei Lin, Zixuan Zhu, Xiaoyue Zhou, Xiang Li 等 (121 人)
abstract: Evaluating agents on the growing number of agentic benchmarks is challenging because they often require complex environments and agent integrations. We introduce Harbor Adapters, a unified evaluation infrastructure for agentic benchmarks. Our work makes three contributions. First, we develop benchmark adapters that port more than 80 benchmarks to evaluate arbitrary agents, and validate them through rigorous code review and parity experiments. Second, we conduct a large-scale evaluation of 8 models spanning capability tiers across 54 benchmarks; every model is run with Terminus-2 and with one of 3 native harnesses. This enables a broader analysis of agent capabilities and failure modes than was previously possible. Third, we introduce Harbor-Index, a curated set of 82 difficult, diverse, and high-quality tasks spanning 29 benchmarks, refined from the adapted suite through difficulty filtering, AI and human audit, and an audit-and-fix loop. Harbor-Index preserves the challenge and breadth of large-scale agentic evaluations while being affordable to run; no evaluated model-harness configuration exceeds 30% pass rate, and the strongest (GPT-5.5 with Codex) reaches 28.0%. We release the adapters, evaluation results, in-depth analysis, and Harbor-Index as open-source artifacts to support more reliable and comprehensive evaluation of language-model agents.
summary_zh: 针对数量持续增长的智能体基准开展评估存在较高难度，这类基准通常需要复杂的环境与智能体集成工作。本文提出Harbor适配器，这是一套面向智能体基准的统一评估基础设施。本工作有三项核心贡献：第一，开发了可将80余个基准进行移植的基准适配器，支持对任意智能体开展评估，并通过严格的代码评审和一致性实验完成了有效性验证；第二，覆盖54个基准对8个不同能力层级的模型开展了大规模评估，所有模型均通过Terminus-2和3种原生测试框架之一运行，实现了比以往覆盖范围更广的智能体能力与失效模式分析；第三，提出Harbor-Index，这是从适配后的基准套件中经过难度过滤、AI与人工审核、审核修复循环优化得到的精选数据集，包含来自29个基准的82项难度高、多样性强、质量优的任务。Harbor-Index保留了大规模智能体评估的挑战性与覆盖广度，同时运行成本可控：所有评估的模型-框架组合的通过率均不超过30%，性能最强的配置（GPT-5.5搭配Codex）的通过率为28.0%。我们将适配器、评估结果、深度分析内容和Harbor-Index作为开源产物发布，为语言模型智能体的更可靠、更全面评估提供支撑。

title: Evidence Integration in Large Language Models
title_zh: 大语言模型中的证据整合机制
authors: Sebastien Kawada, Manolis Kellis
abstract: Despite increasing reliance on LLMs that reason with external evidence supplied by tools, retrieval-augmented generation, other agents, and users, how LLMs integrate such evidence into decisions they have already begun to form remains largely unclear. We present a distributional theory in which evidence shifts the receiver's distribution of initial answers, driven by a receiver prior weight and a candidate evidence tilt, leading to three predictions. First, candidates more probable to the receiver are more persuasive. Second, receivers more readily integrate characteristic errors of their own than foreign errors from different sources. Third, identical evidence can improve weaker models and harm stronger ones. We confirm these over ten million trials, twelve LLMs from four families, and eight domains, four of them scientific discovery tasks in the physical and life sciences: quantum mechanics, physics, genetics, and molecular biology. The law also yields a receiver-relative reliability frontier: receiver-congruent errors depress performance more steeply than random errors of the same rate. LLMs also integrate candidates even after internally verifying their invalidity (93-100% with propositional constraints; up to 99.4% on held-out physical and life-sciences reasoning), demonstrating evidence integration is a receiver-specific control policy over existing distributions, determined by receiver properties rather than scalar trust in the evidence source. Causal interventions show candidate integration is implemented late in the network, as a structured sequence of steps admitting external candidate answers, promoting them, and transporting them into the answer state. Representations of verification are decodable but have little causal impact on answers. A J-lens decomposition shows the state underlying verbalized verification is fully dissociable from that underlying candidate integration.
summary_zh: 当前大语言模型越来越依赖工具、检索增强生成、其他智能体或用户提供的外部证据开展推理，但大语言模型如何将这类证据整合到已经初步形成的决策中，相关机制仍不明确。本文提出一种分布理论，认为证据会改变接收方的初始答案分布，该过程由接收方先验权重和候选证据偏置共同驱动，可推导出三项预测：第一，对接收方而言概率更高的候选答案说服力更强；第二，接收方更容易整合自身产生的特征误差，而非来自其他来源的外部误差；第三，相同的证据可能提升弱模型的性能，同时损害强模型的性能。我们在超过1000万次实验、4个系列共12个大语言模型、8个领域（其中4个为物理和生命科学领域的科学发现任务：量子力学、物理学、遗传学、分子生物学）上验证了上述预测。该理论还推导出与接收方相关的可靠性前沿：与接收方一致的误差比相同占比的随机误差对性能的负面影响更大。大语言模型甚至在内部已经验证候选答案无效后仍会对其进行整合（在命题约束场景下该比例为93%-100%，在未见过的物理与生命科学推理任务中最高达99.4%），证明证据整合是接收方针对现有分布的专属控制策略，由接收方自身属性决定，而非由对证据来源的标度信任度决定。因果干预实验表明，候选整合过程在网络的较后层实现，是由接收外部候选答案、提升其优先级、将其传输到答案状态的结构化步骤序列构成的，验证过程的表征可被解码，但对最终答案几乎没有因果影响。J透镜分解结果显示，语言化验证对应的底层状态与候选整合对应的底层状态完全可分离。

title: Scalable Context Orchestration for Serving LLMs Over Voice
authors: Linyi Jiang, Silvery D. Fu, Yifei Zhu
abstract: Voice AI applications are gaining popularity as advances in large language models (LLMs) enable more natural and accessible spoken interactions. Serving these applications requires accounting not only for what users say, but also for how they speak (e.g., speaking rate) and the conditions under which their audio is captured and transmitted (e.g., background noise and packet loss). However, existing LLM systems represent conversation context as a flat, growing sequence of messages, leaving voice-specific context implicit in the audio. As a result, they can generate responses that are poorly aligned with user preferences, degrade interaction quality under adverse environmental conditions, and incur high costs over long voice sessions.We present llmovoice, a context-management middleware that explicitly models voice context and orchestrates its use. At each turn, llmovoice constructs a bounded voice context from the current user input, relevant interaction history, and explicit paralinguistic and environmental states. It then uses the serving LLM to reason over this context and generate runtime directives that guide how the system responds. We evaluate llmovoice on real-world voice applications and benchmarks. It reduces speaking-rate alignment error by 52.4%, lowers the false-interruption rate from 46.0% to 0.9% under packet loss, and reduces model usage cost by 79.2%. For long sessions, llmovoice reduces per-turn cost by up to 24.9 times while retaining up to 98.7% of baseline answer quality.

title: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance
title_zh: 从匹配模型到招聘智能体：AI招聘系统、评估与治理的系统性叙事综述
authors: Ziyi Zhao, Guanzheng Wei
abstract: Artificial intelligence in recruitment has shifted the object being automated from profile pairs and ranked lists to multi-stage workflows that retrieve evidence, compare candidates, and support or execute actions. This systematized narrative review traces that development from bilateral retrieval and behavioral ranking through neural person--job matching, large language model (LLM) components, and tool-using recruiting agents. Using a purposive search and coding protocol updated through 23 July 2026, plus targeted updates through 2 September 2026, we organize 40 representative works with supporting industrial and legal sources. This synthesis is not a prevalence estimate. We analyze three coupled transitions: from similarity to reciprocal suitability, from a model to a compound workflow, and from offline prediction to evidence- and productivity-aligned evaluation. Across document understanding, retrieval, ranking, assessment, interviewing, sourcing, and human handoff, we distinguish field-, pair-, list-, case-, trajectory-, and outcome-level evidence. Persistent gaps arise because behavioral labels confound exposure, preference, and qualification; private and synthetic data limit external validity; final-output scores conceal pipeline failures; and, within the coded set, privacy is not directly evaluated and no row jointly evaluates utility, fairness, privacy, and security. These observations describe the coded set rather than the field as a whole. We therefore introduce a staged mapping from evaluation evidence to the strongest defensible claim, together with an agenda for reciprocal, evidence-grounded, temporally controlled, selective, and auditable systems. Progress should be judged by whether workflows retrieve the right evidence, preserve uncertainty, support contestable decisions, and improve outcomes under explicit cost and risk constraints.
summary_zh: 人工智能在招聘场景中的自动化对象已经从简历配对和排序列表，转变为能够检索证据、对比候选人、支撑或执行决策的多阶段工作流。本系统性叙事综述梳理了该领域的发展脉络，从双边检索和行为排序，到神经人岗匹配、大语言模型组件，再到使用工具的招聘智能体。本研究采用截至2026年7月23日更新的定向检索与编码方案，以及截至2026年9月2日的定向更新，整理了40项代表性研究及配套的工业界、法律界相关资料。本综述并非对领域普及度的估算，重点分析了三个耦合的转型过程：从相似度匹配到双向适配、从单一模型到复合工作流、从离线预测到对齐证据与产出效率的评估。本研究在文档理解、检索、排序、评估、面试、人才搜寻、人工交接各环节中，区分了字段级、配对级、列表级、案例级、轨迹级和结果级的不同证据类型。当前领域仍存在若干持续性短板：行为标签混淆了曝光度、偏好和资质三类属性，私有数据和合成数据限制了研究的外部有效性，最终输出分数掩盖了流水线的失效问题，且现有编码的研究集中未直接评估隐私属性，也没有研究同时覆盖效用、公平性、隐私和安全四个维度。上述观察仅针对纳入编码的研究集合，不代表整个领域的整体情况。据此本文提出了从评估证据到最强可辩护声明的分阶段映射方法，以及面向双向适配、证据驱动、时序可控、可选择、可审计系统的研究议程。相关领域的进展应当通过工作流是否能检索到正确证据、保留不确定性、支撑可辩驳的决策、在明确的成本与风险约束下优化结果来衡量。

title: EXAONE Forecast for Finance
title_zh: 面向金融领域的EXAONE Forecast
authors: Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Jun Seo, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang 等 (12 人)
abstract: This technical report presents EXAONE Forecast for Finance (EXAONE Finance), a financial time series (TS) foundation model (TSFM) tailored to financial forecasting. Recent TSFMs achieve strong zero-shot performance through large-scale pretraining. However, they are primarily developed for general-domain TS and largely rely on self-attention backbones whose computational cost grows quadratically with sequence length and variate count. Moreover, they assume fully observed inputs and are pretrained on corpora that fail to capture the unique dynamics of financial markets. These limitations hinder their applicability to finance, where long, many-channel, intermittently observed panels are common. To address these challenges, EXAONE Finance adopts an attention-free architecture, replacing self-attention with two simple yet effective linear-time operators: 1) a causal 1D convolution for temporal mixing and 2) a group-aware pooling multi-layer perceptron (MLP) for variate mixing. Furthermore, a masked context augmentation exposes the model to contiguous missing spans during training, improving robustness to the missingness pervasive in financial markets. EXAONE Finance is pretrained on a large-scale financial corpus covering not only equities but also foreign exchange, commodities, crypto-assets, fixed income, and macroeconomic indicators. On FinVerse, a financial forecasting benchmark covering diverse asset classes, EXAONE Finance attains state-of-the-art performance, ranking first across all three evaluation tiers---point-forecast accuracy, cross-sectional asset ranking, and portfolio profitability.
summary_zh: 本技术报告介绍EXAONE Forecast for Finance（EXAONE Finance），这是一款面向金融预测场景定制的金融时间序列（TS）基础模型（TSFM）。近期提出的时间序列基础模型通过大规模预训练取得了优秀的零样本性能，但这类模型主要面向通用领域时间序列开发，大多采用自注意力骨干网络，计算成本随序列长度和变量数量呈二次方增长。此外这类模型假设输入是完全观测的，且预训练所用语料无法捕捉金融市场的独特动态特性，上述局限性限制了其在金融场景的适用性，而金融场景普遍存在长序列、多通道、观测间断的面板数据。为解决上述挑战，EXAONE Finance采用无注意力架构，使用两个简单且高效的线性时间算子替代自注意力机制：1）用于时间维度混合的因果1D卷积；2）用于变量维度混合的分组感知池化多层感知机（MLP）。此外本研究引入掩码上下文增强技术，在训练过程中让模型接触连续的缺失片段，提升模型对金融市场普遍存在的数据缺失问题的鲁棒性。EXAONE Finance在覆盖股票、外汇、大宗商品、加密资产、固定收益和宏观经济指标的大规模金融语料上完成预训练。在覆盖多类资产的金融预测基准FinVerse上，EXAONE Finance取得了当前最优性能，在点预测准确率、横截面资产排序、组合盈利能力三个评估维度上均位列第一。

title: AlcaTRAz - Anchored Tree-Rule Defense Against Jailbreaks
title_zh: AlcaTRAz：针对越狱攻击的锚定树规则防御方法
authors: Jakub Reš, Petr Kaška, Martin Perešíni, Martin Ukrop, Kamil Malinka
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that bypass safety alignment through carefully crafted prompts. Many existing defenses require access to model weights or internals, making them difficult to apply to black-box deployments. We propose AlcaTRAz (Anchored Tree-Rule defense Against jailbreaks), a prompt-level defense based on rule trees that operates exclusively on the input text and requires no modification or retraining of the target model. The method automatically learns a transferable transformation rule that inserts controlled character-level perturbations at selected positions, thereby disrupting structural regularities exploited by jailbreak attacks while largely preserving the model's utility on benign queries. We evaluate the proposed method across 33 open-weight models, 22 jailbreak attack types, and a benchmark of short, single-turn benign questions, comparing against three representative prompt-level baselines (Llama Guard, RA-LLM, Goal Prioritization). Among the compared defenses, AlcaTRAz achieves the best composite security and functionality score in 73.4 % of model-attack combinations and shifts the aggregate score from a modal value of 10 (maximal-severity response to the malicious request) in the undefended setting to a modal value of 2 (near-refusal) after defense, while keeping the mean benign score within 0.27 points of the undefended baseline (8.35 vs. 8.62 on a 0-10 scale). AlcaTRAz substantially reduces but does not eliminate jailbreak success: a high-severity tail remains, and we do not consider adaptive attackers, so we position it as one layer within a defense-in-depth strategy rather than a standalone guarantee.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）容易受到越狱攻击，这类攻击通过精心构造的提示词绕过安全对齐机制。现有多数防御方案需要访问模型权重或内部参数，难以应用于黑盒部署场景。本文提出AlcaTRAz（针对越狱攻击的锚定树规则防御方法），这是一种基于规则树的提示层级防御方案，仅对输入文本进行处理，不需要修改或重新训练目标模型。该方法可自动学习可迁移的变换规则，在选定位置插入可控的字符级扰动，在保留模型对良性查询的处理能力的前提下，破坏越狱攻击所利用的结构规律。本研究在33个开源权重模型、22类越狱攻击方法和包含短单轮良性问题的基准上对该方法进行评估，并与三类代表性提示层级基线方案（Llama Guard、RA-LLM、目标优先级机制）进行对比。在所有对比的防御方案中，AlcaTRAz在73.4%的模型-攻击组合下取得了最优的综合安全与功能得分；部署防御后，整体得分的众数从无防御场景下的10分（对恶意请求给出最高严重度响应）变为2分（接近拒绝响应），同时良性查询的平均得分与无防御基线的差距不超过0.27分（0-10分评分体系下分别为8.35和8.62）。AlcaTRAz可大幅降低越狱攻击的成功率，但无法完全消除越狱风险：仍存在高严重度响应的长尾分布，且本研究未考虑自适应攻击者，因此该方法属于深度防御策略中的一层，并非独立的绝对安全保障。

title: Distill Globally, Adapt Locally: Reasoning Distillation and Product-Type Test-Time Training for Scalable Trade-Up Recommendation
title_zh: 全局蒸馏、局部适配：面向可升级推荐的推理蒸馏与产品类型测试时训练方法
authors: Siliang Liu, Mohammad Ghasemi, Sapan Patel, Amin Banitalebi-Dehkordi
abstract: Trade-up recommendation identifies higher-quality alternatives that preserve a customer's purchase intent while offering upgraded benefits. Large language models (LLMs) can reason about such distinctions, but applying them directly to hundreds of millions of product pairs is operationally impractical. We introduce a two-level framework that distills LLM reasoning into an efficient non-generative student and adapts its decision boundary to product-type-specific trade-up criteria. At Level 1, a retrieval-augmented few-shot LLM teacher generates structured relation labels and natural-language rationales. These rationales supervise a compact embedding-pair classifier through alignment and contrastive objectives; at inference, the student uses only two precomputed 768-dimensional product embeddings, with no LLM calls or text generation. On a fixed human-annotated benchmark of 8,352 pairs, a 15.5M-parameter four-class reasoning-distilled student achieves AUC 0.924 (95% CI [0.918, 0.929]), compared with 0.912 for the four-class label-only student. At Level 2, product-type test-time training (PT-TTT) uses few-shot demonstrations to optimize lightweight category-specific adapters over the frozen student. PT-TTT improves AUC from 0.924 to 0.941 and average precision from 0.920 to 0.940. On a 100K-pair proxy catalog, the distilled student on a single eight-GPU machine is approximately 5,000x faster and 10,000x lower in estimated cost than direct LLM inference.
summary_zh: 可升级推荐是指在保留用户购买意图的前提下，为用户推荐质量更高、可提供升级收益的替代商品。大语言模型（LLM）具备对这类差异进行推理的能力，但直接将其应用于数亿级商品配对场景在工程上完全不现实。本文提出一个双层框架，将大语言模型的推理能力蒸馏为高效的非生成式学生模型，并将其决策边界适配到不同产品类型对应的可升级判定标准。第一层中，检索增强的少样本大语言模型教师生成结构化的关系标签和自然语言推理依据，这些推理依据通过对齐目标和对比目标监督紧凑的嵌入对分类器训练；推理阶段学生模型仅使用两个预计算的768维商品嵌入，不需要调用大语言模型或生成文本。在包含8352个人工标注配对的固定基准上，参数量为15.5M的四类推理蒸馏学生模型取得了0.924的AUC值（95%置信区间[0.918, 0.929]），优于仅使用标签训练的四类学生模型的0.912的AUC值。第二层中，产品类型测试时训练（PT-TTT）利用少样本示例在冻结的学生模型上优化轻量的类别专属适配器，将AUC从0.924提升到0.941，平均精度从0.920提升到0.940。在包含10万对商品的代理目录上，运行在单台8GPU服务器上的蒸馏学生模型的推理速度比直接调用大语言模型快约5000倍，预估成本低10000倍。

title: Variational Continuation for Double Pendulum Periodic Orbits
title_zh: 双摆周期轨道的变分延拓方法
authors: Leo Yao, Ziming Liu, Max Tegmark
abstract: We present a Hessian-based approach to numerically continue periodic orbits in dynamical systems. A loop (periodic orbit candidate) is parametrized as a Fourier series; a loss function is defined based on the deviation of the loop from the physical differential equations. Unlike previous work relying on hand-derived Jacobians, our method automates the process by leveraging automatic differentiation, a common machine learning technique. The continuation direction can be determined by the flat directions of the loss landscapes (directions with zero eigenvalues), making the search of periodic orbits efficient and guided. Our method is integrator-free, precisely initializes oscillations around unstable fixed points, and efficiently detects orbit family intersections and subharmonic bifurcations. As a demonstration, we present full continuations of periodic double pendulum oscillations from fixed points, showing bifurcations along orbit families and categorizing branches of periodic orbits. In particular, we find periodic orbits where both pendulum masses are never simultaneously at rest, which to our knowledge has been missing in the literature.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于海森矩阵（Hessian）的数值延拓动力学系统周期轨道的方法。我们将环路（周期轨道候选解）参数化为傅里叶级数，基于环路与物理微分方程的偏差定义损失函数。不同于以往依赖人工推导雅可比矩阵的研究，本方法利用机器学习领域常用的自动微分技术实现计算流程自动化。延拓方向可由损失景观的平坦方向（特征值为零的方向）确定，使得周期轨道的搜索过程高效且具备引导性。本方法无需数值积分器，可在不稳定不动点附近精准初始化振荡，还能高效检测轨道族交点与次谐分岔。作为演示，本文完成了双摆周期振荡从不动点出发的全延拓计算，展示了沿轨道族的分岔现象，并对周期轨道分支进行了分类。特别地，我们发现了两类摆锤质量永远不会同时静止的周期轨道，据我们所知，该类轨道在现有文献中尚未被报道。

title: Embedded Graph Flows for Categorical Graph Generation
title_zh: 面向类别型图生成的嵌入图流方法
authors: Ethan Ma, Zihan Wang, Chris Siu Yeung Chow, Xinguo Feng, Qingqing Li 等 (8 人)
abstract: Generating categorical graphs requires choosing node and edge types that form a coherent structure without depending on node order. Many graph generators encode categories as fixed one-hot vectors, which can impose an artificial geometry in which categories are equidistant. We propose Embedded Graph Flows (EGF), a generative model that learns continuous embeddings for node and unordered-edge categories and transports Gaussian noise towards these learnt endpoints using a permutation-equivariant graph transformer. A terminal readout maps the embeddings back to discrete graph categories. Across molecular benchmarks, EGF achieved competitive performance. On QM9, EGF gives the best result on all four reported metrics among the three methods, including a Fréchet ChemNet Distance (FCD) of 0.150, compared with 0.717 for the categorical-diffusion baseline DiGress and 0.812 for the bridge-based baseline GruM. When applied to larger molecules in ZINC250k, EGF retains the lowest maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) using the neighbourhood subgraph pairwise distance kernel (NSPDK), indicating close agreement with the local substructures of the reference molecules. Our code is available atthis https URL.
summary_zh: 生成类别型图需要选择节点与边类型以形成连贯结构，且该过程不依赖节点顺序。现有许多图生成器将类别编码为固定的独热向量，这会人为引入所有类别等距的几何空间。本文提出嵌入图流（Embedded Graph Flows, EGF）这一生成模型，可为节点类别与无序边类别学习连续嵌入，并采用排列等变图Transformer将高斯噪声向学习得到的端点传输，最终通过终端读出层将嵌入映射回离散图类别。在多个分子基准测试中，EGF取得了具有竞争力的性能表现：在QM9数据集上，EGF在全部4项报告指标中均为三种对比方法里的最优结果，其弗雷歇化学网络距离（Fréchet ChemNet Distance, FCD）为0.150，对比基线类别扩散模型DiGress的0.717、基于桥接的基线GruM的0.812均有显著提升。在ZINC250k的更大分子数据集上测试时，EGF使用邻域子图成对距离核（NSPDK）计算得到的最大均值差异（Maximum Mean Discrepancy, MMD）仍为最低值，说明其生成结果与参考分子的局部子结构高度吻合。相关代码已公开于指定链接。

title: Optimal Rates for Agentic Networked Information Aggregation
title_zh: 智能体网络信息聚合的最优收敛速率
authors: MohammadHossein Bateni, Zahra Hadizadeh, MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi, Mahdi JafariRaviz, Shayan Taherijam
abstract: Building on the pioneering paper of Kearns, Roth, and Ryu (SODA'26), we study information aggregation in a networked learning model. The model captures a central pattern in agentic AI: each agent sees only part of the data and passes on only its own conclusion. Their model considers a linear regression problem with the mean squared error (MSE) loss. Agents sit in a DAG and each sees only a subset of the features and its parents' predictions, fits a linear predictor, and passes only its prediction forward. The benchmark is the full-feature learner that sees all raw features. A path of depth $D$ is $M$-covered if every block of $M$ consecutive agents collectively sees all raw features. Kearns, Roth, and Ryu proved that the excess mean squared error of the last agent on such a path is $O(M/\sqrt D)$, and gave a cyclic instance with excess error $\Omega(M/D)$ for $D<M^2$.We close this gap: the correct rate is constant up to depth $M^2$, and $\Theta(M^2/D)$ beyond it. We first give a sharper analysis of the cyclic instance and improve its lower bound to $\Omega(\sqrt{M/D})$ for $D<M^2$. We then construct, for every depth $D\ge M^2$, an $M$-covered path of depth $D$ with excess error $\Omega(M^2/D)$. The same instance gives the constant lower bound for all $D < M^2$. We also show that for any fixed distribution the excess error contracts geometrically along the path, ruling out any single instance that witnesses any polynomial lower bound at every depth.Finally, we prove the same optimal rate for logistic classification in the logit-passing model of Bateni et al., which considers the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss. The same improved upper bound of $O(M^2/D)$ holds, and we transfer all the regression lower bounds by showing that on those examples the logistic path follows the least-squares path up to rescaling.
summary_zh: 基于Kearns、Roth和Ryu发表于SODA'26的开创性研究，本文研究网络学习模型中的信息聚合问题。该模型刻画了智能体人工智能领域的典型模式：每个智能体仅能观测到部分数据，且仅传递自身得到的结论。该模型考虑基于均方误差（Mean Squared Error, MSE）损失的线性回归问题，智能体分布在有向无环图（DAG）中，每个智能体仅能观测到部分特征与父节点的预测结果，拟合线性预测器后仅将自身预测结果向前传递，基准模型是可观测全部原始特征的全特征学习器。若深度为D的路径上每连续M个智能体组成的块都能共同观测到全部原始特征，则称该路径是M-覆盖的。Kearns、Roth和Ryu证明了该类路径上最后一个智能体的超额均方误差为O(M/√D)，并给出了一个循环实例，当D<M²时其超额误差为Ω(M/D)。本文填补了该研究的空白：当深度不超过M²时，正确的误差速率为常数，当深度超过M²时误差速率为Θ(M²/D)。我们首先对循环实例进行了更精细的分析，将D<M²场景下的下界提升至Ω(√(M/D))；随后针对所有深度D≥M²的场景，构造了深度为D的M-覆盖路径，其超额误差为Ω(M²/D)，该实例同样可证明所有D<M²场景下的常数下界。我们还证明对于任意固定分布，超额误差会沿路径呈几何级数收缩，不存在可在所有深度下都满足多项式下界的单一实例。最后，本文在Bateni等人提出的采用二元交叉熵（Binary Cross-Entropy, BCE）损失的logit传递逻辑分类模型中，证明了相同的最优速率，O(M²/D)的改进上界同样成立，且通过证明逻辑路径在这些样本上可通过缩放对齐最小二乘路径，将所有回归场景下的下界结论迁移到了分类场景。

title: Online Change-point Detection for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 面向协作多智能体强化学习的在线变点检测方法
authors: Fatemeh Saberi Khomami, Julita Vassileva
abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems rely on past experience for learning coordinated behaviour, but this experience may become unreliable if the environment or task objective changes during training. In such cases, agents first need a way to recognize that the situation has changed before deciding how to adapt. This paper studies online change-point detection for cooperative MARL using reward-derived signals. We propose \emph{Patterns of Past Rewards} (PPR), a lightweight algorithm-agnostic detector that smooths agents' return streams, highlights recent changes, and applies a statistical drift detector to flag significant shifts. We evaluate PPR in a custom Speaker-Listener environment based on the Multi-Agent Particle Environment under two controlled non-stationarity scenarios. Our results show a trade-off between detection speed and alarm stability. A smoothed-return baseline detects earlier but produces many repeated alarms. In contrast, applying the detector directly to raw returns often misses the shift. PPR offers a more balanced approach by limiting redundant detections while still identifying the controlled shifts. These findings highlight PPR as a lightweight, reward-based monitoring tool that enables cooperative MARL systems to reliably identify major changes during training.
summary_zh: 协作多智能体强化学习（MARL）系统依赖历史经验学习协同行为，但若训练过程中环境或任务目标发生变化，历史经验将不再可靠。该场景下智能体需要首先识别出场景发生了变化，再决定后续的适配策略。本文研究基于奖励衍生信号的协作MARL在线变点检测问题，提出“历史奖励模式”（Patterns of Past Rewards, PPR）这一轻量型、算法无关的检测器：该方法对智能体的回报序列做平滑处理，突出近期变化，再应用统计漂移检测器标记显著偏移。我们在基于多智能体粒子环境定制的“说话者-听者”环境中，设置两类受控非平稳场景对PPR进行测试，结果显示检测速度与警报稳定性之间存在权衡：基于平滑回报的基线方法检测速度更快但会产生大量重复警报，直接对原始回报应用检测器则经常漏检偏移。PPR采用更均衡的方案，在限制冗余检测的同时仍能准确识别受控偏移。研究结果表明PPR是一种轻量型、基于奖励的监控工具，可帮助协作MARL系统在训练过程中可靠识别重大环境变化。

title: LexFlip: A Dissociation Diagnostic for Legal Meaning Preservation Metrics
title_zh: LexFlip：面向法律语义保留度量的解离诊断工具
authors: Gaurab Baral
abstract: Does a simplified legal clause still say what the original said? The checks in current use cannot establish that it does: requiring an identical pair to score highest and an unrelated pair lowest moves lexical overlap and legal force together, so any monotone function of token overlap satisfies both. Our remedy is a dissociation, an item holding surface form fixed while legal force moves. We release LexFlip, 373 minimal perturbations of Quebec statutory French that reverse legal force while preserving 0.93 of the tokens, with a harness scoring metrics, regressors and prompted judges alike. The seven embedding and BERTScore metrics we test spend only 0.022 to 0.039 of their identical-to-unrelated range on such an edit, against 0.670 for bidirectional NLI, the one family the identical-pair check would disqualify. On FrJudge, against a measured human ceiling of r=0.597, a bare length feature outscores every semantic metric and has the lowest margin we measure.
summary_zh: 经过简化的法律条款是否仍能表达原条款的全部含义？现有常用的校验方法无法验证这一点：要求完全相同的文本对得分最高、无关文本对得分最低的规则，会将词汇重叠度与法律效力绑定，任意基于token重叠度的单调函数都能满足该规则。本文提出了解离方案：构造在保持表层形式不变的前提下改变法律效力的样本。我们发布了LexFlip数据集，包含373个对魁北克省法语成文法的最小扰动样本，这些样本在反转法律效力的同时保留了93%的token，配套的测试框架可对各类度量、回归模型和提示法官系统进行评分。我们测试的7种嵌入度量与BERTScore度量在这类编辑样本上的得分区间仅占“完全相同对到无关对”得分区间的0.022~0.039，而双向自然语言推理（NLI）模型家族的该占比为0.670，也是唯一能通过相同对校验的模型家族。在FrJudge数据集上，人类评分的上限相关系数r=0.597，仅使用文本长度的简单特征得分就超过了所有语义度量，且误差 margin 是所有测试方法中最低的。

title: Learning from VAE Errors to support ECG-based Differential Diagnosis of Myocardial Scar
title_zh: 从变分自编码器误差中学习以支持基于心电图的心肌瘢痕鉴别诊断
authors: Shayan Sharifi, Riccardo Treu, Ilaria Gandin, Federico Garoia, Marco Merlo 等 (6 人)
abstract: Late Gadolinium Enhancement (LGE) on cardiac magnetic resonance is a key marker of myocardial scar, but its limited accessibility motivates routine ECG-based screening. We evaluated whether $\beta$-variational autoencoder (VAE)-derived ECG representations can discriminate LGE+ from LGE- cardiomyopathic patients in a local cohort of 300 subjects. We compared 32-dimensional features from the foundationthis http URLmodel with those from a shallower $\beta$-VAE trained on normal PTB-XL ECGs, evaluating downstream classification and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based reconstruction errors.this http URLreached an area under ROC of 0.686 with Random Forest, while the proposed $\beta$-VAE reached 0.577 with sensitivity of 0.775 with Gradient Boosting. Notably, DTW-reconstruction errors significantly differed between classes in 10 out of 12 leads according to Mann-Whitney U test and help in classification, leading to an area under ROC of 0.643 with Logistic Regression, supporting their potential as markers of scar-related ECG alterations.
summary_zh: 心脏磁共振的钆延迟增强（Late Gadolinium Enhancement, LGE）是心肌瘢痕的核心诊断标志物，但该检查可及性有限，推动了基于常规心电图的筛查技术发展。本文在包含300名受试者的本地队列中，验证了基于β-变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder, VAE）得到的心电图表征能否区分LGE阳性与LGE阴性的心肌病患者。我们将基础模型输出的32维特征，与在正常PTB-XL心电图数据集上训练的浅层β-VAE得到的特征进行对比，评估下游分类性能与基于动态时间规整（Dynamic Time Warping, DTW）的重构误差。基础模型结合随机森林算法的ROC曲线下面积为0.686，而本文提出的β-VAE结合梯度提升算法的灵敏度可达0.775，ROC曲线下面积为0.577。值得注意的是，根据曼-惠特尼U检验，12个导联中有10个导联的DTW重构误差在两类样本间存在显著差异，可辅助分类，结合逻辑回归算法的ROC曲线下面积可达0.643，证明其可作为心肌瘢痕相关心电图改变的潜在标志物。

title: How to Speculate about Uncertainty in Agentic Coding? A Draft-Model Gate Method
title_zh: 智能体编码场景下如何对不确定性进行推测：草稿模型门控方法
authors: Konstantin Grotov, Valentin Malykh
abstract: LLM agents deployed for software engineering fail expensively: they act confidently wrong, and bad actions are recognized only after costly execution and retry. We present Speculative Uncertainty (SU), a method that recovers a predictive failure signal for a black-box agent from its output tokens alone, with no access to logits, weights, activations, or repeated sampling. Inverting speculative decoding, a small open-weight draft model scores the agent's already-generated trajectory in a single forward pass. From these speculative cross-likelihoods we extract phase-aware features by separating the reasoning and action spans, and calibrate them against a verifiable objective. SU produces a failure-likelihood score that any downstream policy, such as routing, human intervention, or extra test-time compute, can consume directly. To show the signal is actionable, we instantiate one such policy, a pre-execution veto gate, on software engineering agents Qwen3-Coder-480B and closed-source Claude 3.5 Sonnet, cutting execution error rate by 6-8 percentage points and token cost by 14-19% in deployment, transferring to out-of-distribution benchmarks without retraining, and generalizing across agent models.
summary_zh: 部署于软件工程场景的大语言模型智能体运行失败的代价极高：其经常输出自信但错误的结果，只有经过高成本的执行与重试流程后才能发现错误动作。本文提出推测不确定性（Speculative Uncertainty, SU）方法，仅通过智能体输出的token序列即可为黑盒智能体生成预测性失败信号，无需访问模型对数几率、权重、激活值，也无需多次采样。与推测解码的流程相反，本方法使用一个轻量开源的草稿模型，仅通过单次前向传播即可对智能体已生成的轨迹进行评分。通过分离推理区间与动作区间，我们从这些推测交叉似然值中提取感知阶段的特征，并基于可验证目标对特征进行校准。SU最终输出失败似然得分，可直接供路由调度、人工干预、额外测试时计算等下游策略使用。为验证该信号的实用性，我们基于软件工程智能体Qwen3-Coder-480B与闭源模型Claude 3.5 Sonnet实例化了执行前否决门控策略，部署后将执行错误率降低了6~8个百分点，token消耗降低了14~19%，无需重新训练即可迁移到分布外基准测试集，且可在不同智能体模型间泛化。

title: Shallow neural network approximation in mixed Sobolev spaces
title_zh: 混合索伯列夫空间中的浅层神经网络近似
authors: Yuwen Li, Guozhi Zhang
abstract: We investigate the best $L_2$ approximation of mixed Sobolev spaces by shallow neural networks with $n$ neurons and general activation functions. We first establish an activation-independent Fourier-block principle: if an activation has univariate approximation order $\rho$ in the sense of the Fourier-block property, then the global approximation rate has algebraic order $\min\{\alpha,\rho\}$ for target functions of mixed smoothness $\alpha$, up to explicit logarithmic factors. To verify this property for concrete activations, we introduce a structured univariate approximation condition that implies the Fourier-block property with explicit parameters. For $\mathrm{ReLU}^k$, a matching algebraic lower bound identifies $\min\{\alpha,k+1\}$ as the optimal algebraic approximation exponent in any dimension, up to logarithmic factors in the upper bound. The framework also yields the exponent $\min\{\alpha,k+1\}$ for cardinal B-splines and soft-$\mathrm{ReLU}^k$, and the full mixed-smoothness exponent $\alpha$ for ELU and cosine activations, again up to logarithmic~factors.
summary_zh: 本文研究了含n个神经元、采用通用激活函数的浅层神经网络对混合索伯列夫空间的最优L₂近似问题。我们首先提出了与激活函数无关的傅里叶块原理：若某激活函数在傅里叶块属性意义下的单变量近似阶为ρ，则对于混合光滑度为α的目标函数，全局近似阶为min{α,ρ}，仅相差显式对数因子。为验证具体激活函数的傅里叶块属性，我们提出了结构化单变量近似条件，可在给出显式参数的前提下推导出傅里叶块属性。对于ReLUᵏ激活函数，我们证明了匹配的代数下界，确定在任意维度下最优代数近似指数为min{α,k+1}，仅在上界中存在对数因子。该框架同样可得到基数B样条与soft-ReLUᵏ的近似指数为min{α,k+1}，ELU与余弦激活函数的近似指数为完整混合光滑度α，结果同样仅相差对数因子。

title: GLASS: Graph-Language Alignment with Spherical Scoring for Transferable Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
title_zh: GLASS：面向可迁移图级别异常检测的球面评分图-语言对齐框架
authors: Xudong Wang, Chris Ding, Tongxin Li, Jicong Fan
abstract: We introduce GLASS, a framework for graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) that achieves robust cross-domain transferability through graph-language alignment on the unit hypersphere. GLASS builds a unified representation space by aligning a structure-aware graph encoder with an instruction-aware text embedding via a multi-slice soft cosine objective. Our framework serializes local, global, and semantic graph properties into a compact Graph Descriptor Prompt (GraphDP), creating a text bridge that enables domain-agnostic anomaly scoring. By enforcing multi-scale consistency through Matryoshka representation slices, the model captures anomalous deviations at multiple levels of granularity. For scoring, we formulate anomaly detection as density estimation on the aligned hypersphere and introduce Spherical Multi-Modal Scoring (SMS), which instantiates von Mises-Fisher kernel density estimators in both graph and text embedding spaces. This probabilistic formulation recovers angular k-nearest-neighbor scoring as a high-concentration limiting case and provides a principled fusion of structural and semantic anomaly signals. The shared text embedding space further serves as a cross-domain bridge: by encoding a target domain's GraphDP without target-domain training data, GLASS performs zero-shot anomaly detection, and with only a handful of normal examples, few-shot adaptation via reference-set calibration. Across twelve benchmarks and three meta-domains, GLASS obtains the best average AUROC and rank compared with recent advanced GLAD baselines and enables effective cross-domain transfer.
summary_zh: 本文提出GLASS这一图级别异常检测（Graph-Level Anomaly Detection, GLAD）框架，通过在单位超球面上实现图与语言的对齐，获得了鲁棒的跨域迁移能力。GLASS通过多切片软余弦目标函数，将结构感知图编码器与指令感知文本嵌入对齐，构建统一表征空间。该框架将图的局部、全局与语义属性序列化为紧凑的图描述提示（Graph Descriptor Prompt, GraphDP），生成可实现域无关异常评分的文本桥梁。通过套娃表征切片强制多尺度一致性，模型可在多个粒度层级捕获异常偏差。在评分阶段，本文将异常检测建模为对齐超球面上的密度估计问题，提出球面多模态评分（Spherical Multi-Modal Scoring, SMS）方法，在图与文本嵌入空间中均实例化冯·米塞斯-费雪核密度估计器。该概率形式可将角k近邻评分作为高浓度极限场景下的特例，为结构与语义异常信号提供了原则性的融合方案。共享文本嵌入空间同时可作为跨域桥梁：无需目标域训练数据，仅通过编码目标域的GraphDP即可实现零样本异常检测，仅使用少量正常样本即可通过参考集校准实现少样本适配。在12个基准测试集、3个元域上的实验结果表明，与近年先进的GLAD基线方法相比，GLASS取得了最优的平均AUROC与排名，具备优秀的跨域迁移能力。

title: Proton Irradiation Characterization of an Open-Source ML Accelerator on a Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC
title_zh: Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC平台上开源机器学习加速器的质子辐照特性表征
authors: Saad Memon, Rafal Graczyk, Jan Swakoń, Leszek Grzanka, Sebastian Kusyk 等 (6 人)
abstract: As spaceborne computing systems increasingly rely on neural network (NN) accelerators, the opacity of commercial, black-box architectures severely restricts the development of verifiable radiation mitigation strategies. Open-source, register-transfer level (RTL)-accessible accelerators resolve this limitation by enabling user-defined instrumentation, yet few have empirical radiation-response baselines. This work establishes a foundational system-level proton-irradiation baseline for an unmitigated open-source Tensil NN accelerator deployed on a Zynq UltraScale+ SoC executing ResNet-20 inference. Under 20 to 58 MeV proton irradiation, we delivered $4.29 \times 10^{10}$ p/cm$^{2}$ within monitored operational windows. Seven workload interruptions required two restarts of the notebook process, four reboots or board resets, and one power-cycle sequence. Two output-corruption events returned incorrect CIFAR-10 classes without loss of service. In the longer event, the accelerator returned a class absent from the ten-image CIFAR-10 pool for 39 consecutive inputs at normal cadence. The process remained alive, while the kernel log, limited memory test, and sampled power showed no anomaly. Observation of the stuck-class sequence ended with scheduled bitstream reconfiguration. All nine onsets occurred under the nominal 4 cm beam, which exposed the SoC, LPDDR4, and additional board circuitry; none occurred under the 2 cm SoC-centered field. This pattern shows a field association but does not establish LPDDR4 as the cause because field size was confounded with run order and dose. Linux-managed accelerators require end-to-end content checks and recovery that reaches the state in which corruption can persist. This baseline documents availability loss and silent output corruption, supporting future software hardening of COTS FPGA-SoCs for neural-network inference in space systems.
summary_zh: 随着星载计算系统越来越依赖神经网络加速器，商用黑盒架构的不透明性严重限制了可验证辐射缓解策略的开发。开源、可访问寄存器传输级（Register-Transfer Level, RTL）代码的加速器支持用户自定义测试仪器，可解决上述限制，但目前鲜有公开的辐射响应经验基线。本文为部署在Zynq UltraScale+ SoC上、运行ResNet-20推理任务的无辐射加固开源Tensil神经网络加速器，建立了系统级质子辐照基础基线。在20~58 MeV质子辐照条件下，我们在监控运行窗口内注入的总辐照剂量为4.29×10¹⁰ p/cm²。实验过程中出现7次工作负载中断，对应2次进程重启、4次板卡复位、1次电源重启操作；出现2次输出错误事件，在不中断服务的前提下返回了错误的CIFAR-10分类结果。在持续时间更长的错误事件中，加速器在正常运行节奏下连续39次输入都返回了CIFAR-10数据集10个类别之外的错误类别，进程始终保持运行状态，内核日志、受限内存测试与采样功耗均未检测到异常，该固定类别错误序列在按计划重新配置比特流后终止。所有9次异常事件都发生在覆盖SoC、LPDDR4与额外板载电路的4cm标称束斑辐照场景下，在仅覆盖SoC的2cm束斑辐照场景下未出现任何异常。该现象表明异常与辐照场范围存在关联，但无法证明LPDDR4是异常诱因，因为辐照场大小与运行顺序、辐照剂量存在混淆变量。运行Linux操作系统的加速器需要端到端的内容校验机制，以及可覆盖持续错误状态的恢复流程。本基线记录了辐照导致的可用性损失与静默输出错误现象，可为后续面向空间神经网络推理场景的商用现货FPGA-SoC软件加固工作提供支撑。

title: Hessian-based molecular conformation augmentation for a scalable and efficient strategy of machine learning interatomic potentials
title_zh: 基于Hessian（海森矩阵）的分子构象增强：可扩展高效的机器学习原子间势构建策略
authors: Bumju Kwak, Jeonghee Jo
abstract: While machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have successfully learned potential energy surfaces (PES) and atomic forces, many practical applications, such as vibrational analysis and transition state search, rely heavily on the PES Hessian. Yet, standard MLIPs tend to be trained on energy and forces alone, leaving Hessian information largely unexploited. Meanwhile, existing methods that explicitly incorporate the Hessian into training objectives require architectural modifications and introduce significant computational and memory overheads due to higher-order backpropagation. To address these limitations, we propose two Hessian-derived data augmentation schemes: isotropic Gaussian displacement (\textbf{UniAug}) and normal mode-weighted displacement (\textbf{ModeAug}). Both methods utilize simple Taylor expansions, achieving effective augmentation without altering training objectives or extending the autograd graph. This allows seamless, plug-and-play integration with existing architectures and training pipelines. Comprehensive evaluations across non-equilibrium and equilibrium datasets demonstrate that our approach enhances model accuracy while providing practical, task-specific guidelines.
summary_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）已成功实现势能面（PES）与原子力的学习，但振动分析、过渡态搜索等诸多实际应用高度依赖势能面的海森矩阵。然而，标准机器学习原子间势通常仅基于能量和力进行训练，海森矩阵信息基本未得到利用。同时，现有将海森矩阵显式纳入训练目标的方法需要修改模型架构，且由于高阶反向传播会带来极大的计算与内存开销。为解决上述局限，本文提出两种基于海森矩阵衍生的数据增强方案：各向同性高斯位移（UniAug）与简正模式加权位移（ModeAug）。两种方法均采用简单的泰勒展开，无需修改训练目标或扩展自动微分图即可实现有效增强，可即插即用无缝集成到现有架构与训练流水线中。在平衡态与非平衡态数据集上的综合评估表明，该方法可提升模型精度，同时提供面向特定任务的实用指导准则。

title: FedDRAW: Federated Dual Reputation Annealing Weighting for Heterogeneous Multi-Institutional Chest Radiograph Classification
title_zh: FedDRAW：面向异构多机构胸片分类的联邦双声誉退火加权方法
authors: Maryam Moradpour, Anne-Christin Hauschild
abstract: Artificial intelligence models are promising for medical diagnosis, but they require large numbers of unbiased data, which in medicine are distributed across hospitals and cannot be centralized to protect patient privacy. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this, since hospitals train one shared diagnostic model while patient data remain local. Training proceeds in communication rounds, in which each hospital trains the shared model locally and returns it to the server for merging by weighted average. This aggregation weight determines whose institutional knowledge shapes the result. Federated averaging (FedAvg) sets it in proportion to local sample count, so a small but informative hospital is permanently assigned a small influence, andl argest clients could dominate the global model even when they are less informative. We propose Federated Dual Reputation Annealing Weighting (FedDRAW), a server-side aggregation method that combines a data-size prior with the cosine similarity between client and global parameters under two coupled annealing schedules. An inner schedule shifts client reputation from the size prior towards similarity. An outer, deferred annealing schedule on the softmax inverse temperature keeps the weighting selective in the early and middle rounds and relaxes it to uniformity at convergence. We evaluate FedDRAW on 12 simulated client-partition scenarios of two chest radiograph datasets (CheXpert and ChestMNIST), against seven federated baselines under identical local training settings. FedDRAW achieved the highest average rank among all eight methods under both AUC and the geometric mean (GM) of sensitivity and specificity, which a Friedman test with Nemenyi post-hoc analysis confirmed to be a statistically significant difference between the methods. Scheduling two signals, rather than fixing the weights by sample count alone, could enable less biased diagnostic models.
summary_zh: 人工智能模型在医疗诊断领域应用前景广阔，但需要大量无偏数据支撑，而医疗数据分散在各医院中，出于患者隐私保护要求无法集中汇总。联邦学习（FL）可解决该问题：各医院在本地保留患者数据的前提下协同训练共享诊断模型。训练过程由多轮通信组成，每轮中各医院本地训练共享模型后将模型返回服务器，通过加权平均完成聚合，聚合权重直接决定各机构知识对最终结果的贡献度。联邦平均算法（FedAvg）按本地样本量设置权重，导致样本量小但信息价值高的医院始终只能产生很小的影响，而样本量最大的客户端即便信息价值较低也可能主导全局模型。本文提出联邦双声誉退火加权方法（FedDRAW），这是一种服务器端聚合方法，在两个耦合的退火调度下将数据量先验与客户端参数和全局参数的余弦相似度相结合：内层调度将客户端声誉从数据量先验逐步向相似度偏移，外层延迟退火调度作用于softmax逆温度，可在训练早中期保持加权的选择性，在收敛阶段放松约束使权重趋于均匀。在两个胸片数据集（CheXpert与ChestMNIST）构建的12种客户端划分模拟场景下，与7种联邦学习基线方法在相同本地训练设置下开展对比，FedDRAW在AUC指标以及敏感度与特异度的几何均值（GM）两项指标下的平均排名均为所有8种方法中最高，经带Nemenyi事后检验的Friedman检验证实该方法与对比方法的性能差异具有统计学显著性。通过调度两个信号而非仅按样本量固定权重，可构建偏差更低的诊断模型。

title: Dimension-Adaptive Batched Lipschitz Narrowing Without Knowing the Zooming Dimension
title_zh: 无需知晓缩放维度的维度自适应批处理Lipschitz（利普希茨）窄化方法
authors: Yasong Feng
abstract: The Appropriately Combined Edge-length (ACE) sequence in A-BLiN depends on the zooming dimension $d_z$. This note removes that dependence. The next edge length is selected from the number of cubes that survive the preceding elimination. The resulting Count-Adaptive BLiN algorithm does not use $d_z$ or the zooming constant $C_z$, yet it attains $\widetilde{\mathcal O}_d(T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)})$ regret with $\mathcal O_d(\log\log T)$ batches. Together with the adaptive-grid lower bound in Theorem 10 of the original paper, the optimal batch complexity remains $\Theta_d(\log\log T)$ when $d_z$ is unknown.
summary_zh: 现有A-BLiN方法中的适当组合边长（ACE）序列依赖于缩放维度$d_z$。本研究消除了该依赖关系：根据前一轮消除操作后留存的立方体数量选择下一个边长，得到的计数自适应BLiN算法无需使用$d_z$或缩放常数$C_z$，仍可在$\mathcal O_d(\log\log T)$个批次下达到$\widetilde{\mathcal O}_d(T^{(d_z+1)/(d_z+2)})$的遗憾值。结合原论文定理10中的自适应网格下界，当缩放维度$d_z$未知时，最优批复杂度仍保持为$\Theta_d(\log\log T)$。

title: PAC-Bayesian Reconstruction Guarantees for Time Series Variational Autoencoders
authors: Chloé Hashimoto-Cullen, Ghislain Agoua, Benjamin Guedj, Sylvain Le Corff
abstract: Forecasting time series accurately is critical for applications with complex data ranging from energy systems to healthcare and finance. Among current state of the art models, generative latent variable models are increasingly implemented; yet principled generalisation guarantees for modern latent variable models remain limited. In particular, while Variational AutoEncoders are widely used for sequential data, their theoretical analysis is largely restricted to i.i.d. settings. In this work, we develop a PAC-Bayesian framework for latent variables models applied to time series.
